blocks.text: 1800W Hot Air Gun with Extra Nozzle STEARNEL SDL-8600

The 1800W Hot Air Gun is a practical and powerful heating tool designed for a wide range of workshop, maintenance, electronics, and household applications. It delivers strong hot airflow for jobs that require controlled heating, making it suitable for heat shrink tubing, adhesive softening, sticker removal, plastic shaping, drying, paint loosening, and general repair work. With its handheld design and simple control layout, this tool is a useful choice for technicians, hobbyists, and maintenance users who need a reliable heat source in daily work.

This 1800W Hot Air Gun is built to provide fast heat performance with convenient handling. The body design allows comfortable grip during operation, while the air outlet is shaped for concentrated hot air delivery to the target area. The tool also includes adjustable operation levels, helping the user choose the most suitable heating mode depending on the material and application. This makes it useful for jobs that require more control than open flame tools, especially when working on plastics, cables, sleeves, adhesives, or repair tasks.

The 1800W Hot Air Gun can be used in electronics benches, service workshops, DIY projects, and light industrial tasks. It is suitable for heating applications where direct, focused hot air is needed without physical contact. The included extra nozzle improves airflow direction for more precise work, especially when heating smaller areas or trying to reduce heat spread to surrounding parts.

Its construction combines a practical outer body with a metal nozzle section designed to handle high working temperatures. The ergonomic handle shape helps improve control during use, while the hanging loop makes storage easier when the tool is not in operation. For users who need a simple hot air tool for repair, installation, removal, loosening, forming, and controlled heating work, the 1800W Hot Air Gun is a practical and effective option.

blocks.text: 20mm High Temperature Heat Resistant Kapton Tape Polyimide – 30 Meter Roll

Kapton Tape, also known as Polyimide Tape, is an electrically insulating heat resistant tape that has many uses for 3D printers. Designed for high temperature masking applications, including the protection of printed circuit board gold finger contacts during wave soldering, heater bed in 3D printer. Kapton tape is a usable print surface for printing ABS/PLA thermal plastic on a Heated Bed for 3D printer. Featured by Sharvi Electronics For ABS to stick to Kapton, the Kapton needs to be hot (different sources mention minimum temperatures between 80-130 °C). Also the Kapton should be free of grease, grease can be removed with acetone or a propane torch.

name: PIC16F84A Microcontroller

blocks.text: This is an 18 pin IC, the description of each pin are given below: ?
It has thirtheen GPIO pins and each pin can be used either as digital input or digital output.
These 13 GPIO pins are shared with PORTA and PORTB.
PORTA consists of 5 pins from RA0-RA4 and PORTB has 8 pins from RB0-RB7.

These 13 GPIO pins can be independently configured either as digital input or as digital output. Also, each pin can either supply or can absorb a maximum of 25mA current per pin. So, accordingly, every pin can drive a?LED?easily but cannot drive any dc motor or relays. Because, current requirement for LED is generally less than 10mA and dc motor requires greater than 25mA.? ?If you want to interface relay or dc motor, you have to use current driver ICs. Like??motor driver IC?to interface motor and?relay driver IC?to interface single of multiple relays.? The mentioned 13 I/O pins are assembled into two groups known as ports.
Port A:?contains 5 pins which are 1, 2, 3, 17 & 18 on pinout or RA0, RA1,RA2,RA3,RA4.
Port B:?contains 8 pins which are 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 & 13 or RB0, RB1, RB2, RB3, RB4, RB5, RB6, RB7.

Pin 4:?This is an active low pin known as MCLR (Memory Clear). Obviously, this pin is used to reset the device . Whenever it is kept low while connecting to the ground then it reset the device. Circuit below shows the reset circuit in blue color highlighted region. When user will press the push button, device will reset, otherwise it will remain on.
Pin 5:?This is the ground pin of the IC and must be associated with the negative terminal of the battery or supply voltage.
Pin 14:?This is a supply pin and must be connected to the positive terminal of the power supply. The operating voltage of this device is 5 volts.

Pin 15 & 16:?This is where crystal oscillator connected and the maximum frequency can be used is 20MHz. you can also use a 4MHz crystal but the higher the frequency of crystal used, the quicker the controller works. Also, at higher frequeny, power consumption is also higher.? Picture given below shows the circuit diagram for oscillator circuit.? Connect both pins OSC1 and OSC2 across 20MHz crystal through two 22pF capacitors.
You can also consult with the?datasheet?for further information.
I/O Pins:?There are 13 I/O pins and these pins can be configured individually either as input or as output. Each of these pins source and sinks 25mA current.

Supports ICSP:?ICSP stands for In-Circuit Serial Programming. With little careful, you can program the microcontroller deprived of eliminating it from the target board for example in-circuit. This is widely used for in-circuit programming as it contains a USART module.

PIC16F84A Memory:?This PIC microcontroller comes with enhanced EEPROM memory. It contains 64 bytes memory that is mainly used to store data and 1K program memory specifies the capacity of code you can burn inside. 68 bytes of RAM (Data Memory).

Watchdog timer:?This microcontroller has built-in Watchdog timer. There is an internal timer located under the chip. You can make this timer enable or disable by programming. The timer is mainly used to rest the microcontroller when the program goes wrong or it may enter to the infinite loop.
Registers:?There are two types of registers which are as follow here.
General Purpose Registers (GPR): These general purpose registers are used to store any arbitrary value in which you can operate.
Special Function Registers (SFR). The special function registers are used to perform various functions which can help to control the device.
Timer: PIC16F84a contains one 8-bit timer that can be utilized in both ways i.e. timer and counter. Furthermore, accompanies internal and external clock select capability.
Sleep Mode:?This mode is included the chip that produces a low current power down mode. The sleep mode can be removed using an interrupt, external reset, and watchdog timer.

Power on Reset:?This feature is utilized in various other PIC microcontrollers when it is powered on. If there arises a problem in the chip, powering on the device will dismiss it from the loop of any malfunctioning in the device.

PIC16F84a Projects:?This version of PIC controllers are mostly used in students projects where the main concern is automation. This is also used in Central heating projects, Production of the temperature data logger, and gas sensor projects. Also used in security systems and setting up serial communication with other devices.

Compilers:?PIC controller has different compilers MPLAB C18 Compiler and MikroC Pro for a compiler. The code written in the compiler creates a hex record that is transferred on the PIC Microcontroller.

Ram Memory Banks: the RAM is consist of four banks. Before accessing any register during the time of programming or program writing, you must need to select the particular bank which contains that register. Handling banks may be steep if you write the code in assembly language.
USART module:?this microcontroller enhances with the USART module.
Flash Memory:?This consist of Flash memory based on 8-bit microcontroller packs. The same microcontroller device can be used for prototyping and production.

blocks.text: This is a 1 Channel 5V Solid State Relay Module. A solid-state relay (SSR) is just what it sounds like; an IC that acts like a mechanical relay. They allow you to control high-voltage AC loads from lower voltage DC control circuitry. They accomplish this by using infrared light as the ‘contact,’ a solid-state relay is really just an IR LED and a photo Triac sealed up into a little box. Solid-state relays have several advantages over mechanical relays.

A Solid State Relay is similar to 1 Channel 5V Relay Module Solid State High-Level SSR DC Control 250V 2A with Resistive to a mechanic relay where it can be controlled through a digital signal. Solid State Relay generates no noise and has a much longer lifespan compared to the traditional mechanic relay.

When the input logic voltage is applied to the coil, the NC will disconnect from the COM breaking the conductivity between the two. At the same time, the NO will connect with the COM allowing conductivity between them. Depending on your wiring this will turn on or off the connected load.

When the input logic voltage is applied to the coil, the NC will disconnect from the COM breaking the conductivity between the two. At the same time, the NO will connect with the COM allowing conductivity between them. Depending on your wiring this will turn on or off the connected load.
High level and low level of meaning

High-level trigger refers to the signal trigger end (IN) had a positive voltage and the negative pole of the power supply is usually between, and the triggering end of a trigger connected with the positive pole of a power supply, when the trigger end has a positive voltage or reached the trigger voltage, the relay is attracted.

Low-level trigger refers to the signal triggering voltage between the end and the negative electrode of the power supply is OV, or trigger terminal voltage lower voltage than the positive power supply voltage, low to can trigger, make the relay, is usually the cathode of the power supply and the triggering end of a trigger mode connection, so that the relay is attracted.

blocks.text: TP4056 1A Li-ion lithium Battery Charging Module With Current Protection – Type C

This TP4056 1A Li-Ion Battery Charging Board Type C with Current Protection is a tiny module, perfect for charging single cell 3.7V 1 Ah or higher lithium-ion (Li-Ion) cells such as 16550s that don’t have their own protection circuit. Based on the TP4056 charger IC and DW01 battery protection IC this module will offer 1A charge current then cut off when finished.

Furthermore, when the battery voltage drops below 2.4V the protection IC will switch the load off to protect the cell from running at too low of a voltage – and also protects against over-voltage and reverse polarity connection (it will usually destroy itself instead of the battery) however please check you have it connected correctly the first time.

Manufactured under fully machinery processing. Each module is tested OK before shipment from Micro ohm so it has high reliability for the best performance. In conclusion, it is a special design for a single lithium battery charging. TP4056 Other features include the current monitor, under-voltage lockout, automatic recharge, and two status pin to indicate charge termination and the presence of an input voltage.
Connect Type C cable for power, or 5V DC to pads marked IN and IN- on the left-hand side of the module
Connect cell to charge to B /B- pads on the right-hand side of the module.
A load (something for the battery to power) can be connected to the OUT /OUT- pads on the right-hand side
The red LED indicates charging in progress, the green LED indicates charging has finished.
Never charge your battery at a rate greater than 1C.
1. Ampere meter can only be connected to a 5v input end of the module.
2. It is better than the charging current is 37% of the battery capacity. If you charge the battery of 1000mAh, a current of 400mAh is enough.
3. The connection wire should not be too thick.
4. Make sure the connect point is good.
5. If the input voltage is too high, like 5.2v, the current will be less than 1000mA, it is normal. It is protection function, auto-subtract the charging current to avoid burn damage to the chip.

blocks.text: ESP32-C3 Mini WIFI BLE5 Development Module for IoT Applications

The ESP32-C3 Mini WIFI BLE5 Development Module is a space-efficient and powerful development board designed for modern IoT and wireless applications. Based on the ESP32-C3 RISC-V 32-bit single-core processor, it delivers strong computing capabilities while maintaining ultra-low power consumption.

It features Wi-Fi 2.4GHz and Bluetooth 5 (LE) connectivity, robust security features, and a compact surface-mount design, making it suitable for wearables, smart devices, and embedded wireless projects. The board integrates 4MB of flash memory, onboard antenna for enhanced signal, multiple GPIOs, ADCs, and industry-standard serial interfaces like UART, I2C, and SPI.

name: TP4056 18650 3.7V 4.2V Battery Charging Module with Integrated DC Boost Converter Module Type c
desc: TP4056 18650 3.7V 4.2V Battery Charging Module with Integrated DC Boost Converter module type c

blocks.text: TP4056 18650 3.7V 4.2V Battery Charging Module with Integrated DC Boost Converter Module Type c

This module is a small single cell lithium battery charging module that also includes a 1A step-up (boost) converter for powering a large range of applications. The module will charge most types of a single cell (3.7) LiPo batteries from either 4 to 7.5V power supply input, or from a standard 5V USB port/adapter. A battery charge and standby LED are also included for visual indication.

Besides battery charging capabilities this module also includes an adjustable boost converter which is capable of stepping up the attached battery voltage from 4.5 to 24V with a maximum supply current of 1A.
Exquisite detail and long service life.
Module TP4056 DIY kit parts. Can be used for multimeter, converted to lithium-battery charging.

desc: FNIRSI DPOX180H is a professional portable 2-in-1 dual-channel digital phosphor oscilloscope and DDS signal generator featuring 180MHz analog bandwidth , 500MSa/s real-time sampling , up to 50,000 wfm/s waveform refresh rate and a high-contrast 2.8-inch IPS display . It combines digital phosphor visualization, 5mV sensitivity, ZOOM time base, X-Y mode, FFT, digital triggering, waveform storage, USB data export and a built-in 20MHz DDS signal generator in one compact handheld instrument.

blocks.text: 180MHz Digital Phosphor Oscilloscope + DDS Signal Generator

The DPOX180H is a compact 2-in-1 handheld test instrument combining a dual-channel digital phosphor oscilloscope with a DDS signal generator. It is designed for electronics development, troubleshooting, education, field service and waveform analysis where portability and fast visual feedback are important.
50,000 wfm/sHigh waveform refresh rate for capturing low-probability events.
20MHz DDSIntegrated DDS function signal generator with multiple waveforms.

The DPOX180H uses digital phosphor technology to make signal activity easier to interpret visually. Waveforms can be displayed using grayscale or color-temperature visualization, helping reveal waveform density, intermittent events and changes in signal behavior.
Its refresh rate can reach 50,000 waveforms per second, making it easier to detect abnormal or low-probability signals that may be difficult to see on slower instruments.
ZOOM, X-Y, FFT and Cursor Measurement

The ZOOM time-base function provides an additional magnified time base for detailed inspection of selected waveform sections. The instrument also supports X-Y display, roll mode, simple FFT spectrum viewing and manual cursor measurements for frequency, period and amplitude analysis.

The digital trigger system supports Auto, Normal and Single trigger modes with rising and falling edge triggering. Adaptive trigger suppression and adjustable automatic bandwidth limitation help stabilize waveforms when working with noisy signals.

The integrated DDS generator supports 14 standard function waveforms plus a user-defined chopping waveform. Sine-wave output can reach up to 20MHz, while other supported waveform types can reach up to 10MHz. Frequency adjustment is available in 1Hz steps.
The chopping-wave function can capture part or all of a measured waveform and reuse it as a custom generator output.

The DPOX180H can save up to 90 screenshots and 250 waveform data sets in its local storage. It can also store up to 500 customized chopped-wave signals. Saved data can be browsed directly on the instrument, while USB connectivity allows image export and system firmware updating.

With a standard lower-current supply, Raspberry Pi 5 normally limits the total current available to its USB peripherals to a nominal 600mA.

When the Raspberry Pi 5 detects the supported 5V / 5A USB-C PD profile, the system can automatically increase this nominal USB current limit to approximately 1.6A, giving connected peripherals significantly more available power.
The adapter is not limited to its special Raspberry Pi 5 output mode. It also provides standard USB Power Delivery profiles for compatible USB-C PD devices.
Why Is It Called a 27W Supply If 5.1V × 5A Is 25.5W?

The Raspberry Pi-specific high-current profile provides 5.1V at 5A, which corresponds to approximately 25.5W. The product is marketed as a 27W USB-C Power Supply because its standard USB-PD profiles can deliver the full 27W, for example 9V at 3A or 12V at 2.25A.
This distinction is normal and is reflected in Raspberry Pi’s official technical specifications.

The supply accepts an input range of 100–240VAC at 50–60Hz. This specific X9597 version uses a fixed European Type C plug, so the physical mains connector must be compatible with the socket in the country where it will be used.
The USB-C output cable is permanently attached to the adapter and has a nominal length of approximately 1.2 meters. The official Raspberry Pi product brief specifies a 17AWG cable.

The supply is specifically designed for Raspberry Pi 5, but the additional USB-PD profiles also allow it to be used with many compatible third-party USB-C Power Delivery devices that support one of the available voltage and current combinations.
The connected device determines which supported Power Delivery profile is negotiated. A device will not automatically receive 5A unless the correct compatible power profile is negotiated.

blocks.text: BMP280 3.3V Barometric Pressure & Altitude Sensor Module (I2C/SPI)

The BMP280 3.3V Barometric Pressure & Altitude Sensor Module is a reliable breakout board that brings Bosch’s well-known BMP280 pressure sensor into an easy-to-use format for makers and professional prototyping. The BMP280 measures absolute air pressure with high resolution, and by using standard altitude formulas, it can also estimate relative altitude changes.

Unlike “5V modules” that sometimes include extra regulators or level shifting, this version is intended for 3.3V operation. That makes it the best match for modern microcontrollers such as ESP32, Raspberry Pi, STM32, RP2040, and other 3.3V logic platforms.
If your project needs consistent pressure readings, fast response, and low power consumption, the BMP280 3.3V module is one of the most practical choices for IoT and embedded applications.
Choosing a 3.3V-native BMP280 module helps you avoid common wiring mistakes and improves long-term stability in sensor projects:
Correct sensor supply range without stressing the chip
Better compatibility with 3.3V logic boards (no risky 5V pull-ups on I2C lines)
Reduced chance of noise issues compared to unstable conversions
3.3V operating module for safe use with 3.3V MCUs

الميزة هنا أن هذا الإصدار مخصص للعمل على 3.3 فولت، وبالتالي يناسب بشكل ممتاز المتحكمات الحديثة مثل ESP32 وRaspberry Pi وSTM32 وRP2040 وغيرها من الأنظمة التي تعمل بمنطق 3.3 فولت.
لو مشروعك يحتاج قراءات ضغط مستقرة، استهلاك منخفض، وتوصيل سهل عبر I2C أو SPI، فـ BMP280 3.3V اختيار عملي جدًا لمشاريع إنترنت الأشياء والأنظمة المدمجة.

توافق ممتاز مع لوحات 3.3 فولت بدون مشاكل “Pull-ups” على 5 فولت

blocks.text: GY-273 3-Axis Magnetic Field Sensor Magnetometer GY273 HMC5883

The GY-273 module is based on the Honeywell HMC5883 IC for low-field magnetic sensing with a digital interface for applications such as low cost compassing and magnetometry. The HMC5883 includes state-of-threat, high-resolution QMC118X series magneto-resistive sensors plus an ASIC containing amplification; automatic degaussing strap drivers, offset cancellation, and a 12-bit ADC that enables 1° to 2° compass heading accuracy. The I2C serial bus allows for an easy interface.

The HMC5883 utilizes Honeywell’s Anisotropic Magnetoresistive (AMR)technology that provides advantages over other magnetic sensor technologies. These anisotropic, directional sensors feature precision in-axis sensitivity and linearity.

These sensors’ solid-state construction with very low cross-axis sensitivity is designed to measure both the direction and the magnitude of Earth’s magnetic fields, from milli-gauss to 8 gausses. Honeywell’s Magnetic Sensors are among the most sensitive and reliable low-field sensors in the industry.

blocks.text: MPU9250 9-Axis Gyro Accelerometer Magnetometer Sensor Module

MPU9250 9-Axis Attitude Gyro Accelerator Magnetometer Sensor Module features the MPU9250, which is a multi-chip module (MCM) consisting of two dies integrated into a single QFN package. One die houses the 3-Axis accelerometer and gyroscope. The other die houses the AK8963 3-Axis magnetometer. Hence, the MPU-9250 is a 9-axis Motion Tracking device that combines a 3-axis accelerometer, gyroscope and magnetometer, and a Digital Motion Processor (DMP). It is based on I2C Address, Address: 0x68 by default, 0x69 if AD0 is pulled high.

The MPU-9250 also features an embedded temperature sensor. This module includes pull-up resistors on the SDA, SCL, and nCS lines, pull-down resistors on the FSYNC and AD0 lines, and an onboard 3.3V voltage regulator allowing you to power the module from 5V sources such as an Arduino. If you desire to power the module from 3.3V you can bridge the solder jumper next to the voltage regulator to bypass the regulator.

The MQ-9 Carbon Monoxide Methane LPG Gas Sensor Module is a compact semiconductor gas-detection board designed to respond to carbon monoxide and combustible gases including methane, propane and LPG. It combines an MQ-9 SnO₂ sensing element with an onboard comparator, sensitivity potentiometer, power indicator and digital-output indicator.

The module provides both an analog output for monitoring changes in sensor response and an adjustable digital output for threshold-based alarms. It can be integrated with Arduino boards, microcontrollers, alarm circuits and environmental-monitoring projects.

blocks.text: The MQ-9 uses tin dioxide, or SnO₂, as its sensitive material. Its conductivity is relatively low in clean air and increases as the concentration of target gases rises. The raw MQ-9 sensing element uses different heater conditions for carbon-monoxide and combustible-gas response. Common four-pin modules are normally powered from a 5V input and may not automatically implement a precision high/low heater-control cycle. Applications requiring selective or quantitative measurement should use suitable heater control, calibration and signal processing.

blocks.text: KOOCU KC-109 5 Inch Precision Electrical Cutter

KOOCU KC-109 5 Inch Precision Electrical Cutter is a compact precision cutting tool designed for electronics repair, PCB work, wire trimming, model making, 3D printer filament cleanup, and other light-duty cutting tasks that require accuracy in tight spaces. With its slim body, sharp angled cutting head, spring-loaded return action, and comfortable blue insulated grip, this cutter is a practical choice for technicians, hobbyists, makers, students, and repair workshops.

The KOOCU KC-109 is made for precise small cutting jobs rather than heavy industrial cutting. Its 5 inch size makes it easy to hold and control, especially when working around crowded circuit boards, electronic components, small wires, jumper leads, plastic model parts, or fine repair areas where larger cutters are difficult to use. The angled head helps reach into narrow spaces, allowing the user to trim close to the surface with better visibility and better access.

The tool features a sharp micro cutting jaw suitable for trimming soft copper wire, electronic component legs, small aluminum wire, thin cable ends, and similar soft materials. The 45 degree angled jaw gives improved access inside compact assemblies and makes the cutter very useful for PCB maintenance, soldering work, prototyping, Arduino projects, electronic kits, and general bench repair.

The spring-loaded mechanism automatically reopens the jaws after each cut, reducing hand fatigue during repetitive use. This is especially useful when cutting many component leads, cleaning excess wire after soldering, or trimming several small parts in one session. The lightweight design and comfortable handle also make the tool easier to use for longer periods without applying unnecessary pressure.

The handle is covered with blue insulated non-slip rubber or TPR material for a more secure grip. The shape of the handle helps provide better control while cutting small pieces. The cutter is compact enough to fit inside a technician tool bag, electronics repair drawer, makerspace kit, or mobile service toolkit.

This tool is commonly useful for cutting soft wires, trimming component legs after soldering, cleaning small plastic supports, cutting 3D printer filament, preparing jumper wires, and working on light hobby projects. It should not be used for steel wire, thick cable, nails, hard metal, or live electrical circuits, because this type of precision cutter is designed for soft material and detailed work only.

هذه القصافة ليست مخصصة للقطع الثقيل، لكنها ممتازة في الأعمال الدقيقة التي تحتاج إلى تحكم ووضوح. حجمها الصغير مقاس ٥ بوصة يجعلها سهلة الإمساك والاستخدام داخل الأماكن الضيقة، خصوصًا عند التعامل مع لوحات الدوائر المطبوعة، أطراف المقاومات والمكثفات، الأسلاك الرفيعة، وصلات المشاريع، وبعض أعمال النماذج والطباعة ثلاثية الأبعاد.

رأس القصافة يأتي بزاوية تقريبية ٤٥ درجة، وهذا يساعد المستخدم على الوصول إلى الأماكن المزدحمة بالمكونات أو القريبة من سطح اللوحة. هذا التصميم مفيد جدًا بعد اللحام، لأن الفني غالبًا يحتاج إلى قص أرجل المكونات بشكل قريب ونظيف بدون إتلاف اللوحة أو المكونات المجاورة.

القصافة مزودة بآلية سوستة داخلية تفتح الفك تلقائيًا بعد كل قصّة. هذه الميزة تقلل إجهاد اليد أثناء الاستخدام المتكرر، خصوصًا عند قص عدد كبير من أطراف المكونات أو تجهيز مجموعة أسلاك في وقت واحد. كما أن المقبض الأزرق المغطى بمادة عازلة ومقاومة للانزلاق يساعد على ثبات الأداة في اليد وتحسين التحكم أثناء العمل.

قلم التجليخ والتلميع الكهربائي ما آنت دي ١ هو أداة دقيقة صغيرة الحجم مصممة لأعمال التجليخ، التلميع، الصنفرة، الحفر الخفيف، النقش، التشطيب، التنظيف، والقص البسيط في المشروعات اليدوية وأعمال الصيانة الخفيفة. يتميز بتصميم رفيع يشبه القلم، مما يجعله سهل التحكم عند العمل على التفاصيل الصغيرة، خصوصًا في صيانة الموبايلات، الهوايات، الأعمال اليدوية، المجوهرات، الخشب، البلاستيك، الراتنج، الشمع، والأسطح المعدنية الخفيفة.

تم تصميم ما آنت دي ١ للمستخدم الذي يحتاج أداة دوارة صغيرة وخفيفة يمكن التحكم بها مثل القلم. المنتج يأتي مع مجموعة رؤوس متعددة، وكابل شحن، ومفتاح ألنكيه صغير لتغيير وتركيب الإكسسوارات. يدعم القلم مستويات سرعة مختلفة لاختيار السرعة المناسبة حسب طبيعة الخامة ونوع العمل. كما يحتوي على منطقة عرض ذكية توضح مستوى الطاقة، مستوى السرعة، حمل التشغيل، وتنبيه الحمل الزائد، مما يساعد المستخدم على متابعة حالة الأداة أثناء العمل.

هذا القلم الكهربائي مناسب للأعمال الدقيقة التي يصعب تنفيذها بأداة كبيرة الحجم. الصور المرسلة توضح استخدامه في التلميع، الحفر، التجليخ، التشطيب، والعمل على الأسطح الصغيرة. يمكن استخدامه مع خامات مناسبة مثل الخشب، المعادن الخفيفة، الأحجار الصغيرة، الشمع، البلاستيك، الراتنج، قطع الهوايات، بعض أجزاء أغلفة الموبايل، والأسطح التي تحتاج تشطيبًا دقيقًا. دعم رؤوس بقطر ٢.٣٥ مليمتر يجعله مناسبًا مع أنواع كثيرة من الرؤوس الصغيرة المستخدمة في الأدوات الدوارة الدقيقة.

blocks.text: Mijing SW-03 Rosin Atomizer Mainboard Short Circuit Detector Pen

The Mijing SW-03 Rosin Atomizer Mainboard Short Circuit Detector Pen is a specialized diagnostic tool used in electronic repair to help locate short circuits visually. It is especially useful for mobile phone motherboard repair, tablet PCB troubleshooting, and compact board diagnostics where the fault area is too small to detect by touch or visual inspection alone.

During short-circuit diagnosis, technicians often inject controlled voltage into the suspected power rail and then look for the component or area that heats first. The Mijing SW-03 Rosin Atomizer Mainboard Short Circuit Detector Pen helps make this heat visible. It atomizes small particles of rosin and produces smoke that can be directed over the board. When the smoke passes over the hot component, the behavior of the smoke and rosin residue helps reveal the faulty area faster.

This tool is not a thermal camera replacement, but it is a practical, affordable, and bench-friendly short-circuit detection aid. It is useful when working under a microscope and can save time during fault tracing, especially on dense motherboards where power ICs, capacitors, filters, and small SMD components are located very close together.
The main purpose of the Mijing SW-03 Rosin Atomizer Mainboard Short Circuit Detector Pen is to assist with short-circuit detection by using rosin smoke as a visual indicator.

Instead of applying heat directly with a soldering iron, the technician places small rosin particles inside the atomizer chamber. When the pen is powered through USB and the button is pressed, the internal coil heats the rosin and creates visible smoke. This smoke is then directed toward the suspected board area.

When the board is powered through a current-limited power supply, the shorted area normally heats faster than the surrounding area. The rosin smoke helps show where the heat is concentrated, making the short easier to find.

blocks.text: Mechanic 900M-T-TI Superfine Straight Soldering Tip is a very fine precision soldering iron tip designed for micro soldering, jumper wire work, IC pin repair, PCB maintenance, mobile phone repair, and delicate electronics servicing. Its ultra-sharp straight needle-style end helps technicians reach very small soldering points with improved control, making it suitable for repair jobs where standard soldering tips are too large or not accurate enough.

This tip is especially useful for fine bridge soldering, jumper wire installation, repairing broken pads, working around small SMD components, and touching narrow IC legs without affecting nearby parts. The slim straight shape gives the user better visibility around the solder joint, which is important when working under a microscope or magnifying lamp.

The 900M series design makes it compatible with many soldering stations and soldering irons that use 900M-type tips. It is a practical replacement tip for repair technicians who need a sharp, accurate, and reliable tool for detailed soldering tasks on phones, laptops, tablets, motherboards, control boards, and electronic modules.

سن كاوية ميكانيك رفيع مستقيم للحام الدقيق

سن كاوية ميكانيك الرفيع المستقيم هو سن لحام دقيق جدًا مصمم لأعمال الصيانة الدقيقة مثل لحام الأسلاك الرفيعة، إصلاح أرجل الدوائر المتكاملة، صيانة لوحات الهواتف، إصلاح المسارات، والعمل على المكونات الصغيرة جدًا. يتميز بطرف مدبب شديد الرفع يساعد الفني على الوصول إلى نقاط لحام صغيرة لا يمكن التعامل معها بسهولة باستخدام السنون العادية الأكبر حجمًا.

يعتبر هذا السن مناسبًا جدًا لأعمال لحام الجسور الرفيعة، تركيب أسلاك التعويض، إصلاح البادات المقطوعة، ولمس أرجل المكونات الصغيرة دون التأثير الكبير على الأجزاء المجاورة. التصميم المستقيم الرفيع يمنح رؤية أفضل حول نقطة اللحام، خصوصًا عند العمل تحت ميكروسكوب أو عدسة تكبير داخل ورش صيانة الإلكترونيات والهواتف.

هذا السن من فئة السنون المتوافقة مع كاويات ومحطات اللحام التي تستخدم نفس مقاس عائلة تسعمائة إم، لذلك فهو اختيار عملي كقطعة بديلة للفنيين الذين يحتاجون إلى سن دقيق ومناسب للأعمال الحساسة في صيانة الهواتف واللاب توب والتابلت واللوحات الإلكترونية ووحدات التحكم.

desc: Handheld 125KHz RFID Copier Reader Writer with 5 Cards and 5 Tags A portable, stand-alone reader and writer for compatible unencrypted 125KHz ID cards. blocks.text: Handheld 125KHz RFID Copier Reader Writer with 5 Cards and 5 Tags

Handheld 125KHz RFID Copier is a compact, stand-alone tool for reading the identification code from compatible unencrypted low-frequency cards and writing that code to a supported writable card or key tag. The package includes 5 cards and 5 key tags, giving technicians and authorized users a practical starter set for backups, access-control maintenance, compatibility testing, and RFID learning.

Important compatibility notice: This device is not a universal card copier. It is intended only for compatible unencrypted 125KHz ID credentials. It does not copy 13.56MHz, NFC, MIFARE, encrypted, protected, rolling-code, banking, national-ID, SIM, or secure smart cards. Confirm the frequency, chip type, and writability of the original credential before purchasing.

The copier works without a computer, application, cable, or external programmer. A dedicated READ button captures the code from a compatible original credential, while the WRITE button transfers it to compatible writable media. The front panel includes Power, Pass, and Busy indicators, and the antenna area is positioned at the upper section of the housing. A side power switch and audible feedback support simple field operation.

The lightweight ABS enclosure has a contoured handheld shape for workshops, service visits, access-control testing, and educational demonstrations. Power is supplied by two AAA batteries, allowing the unit to operate away from a bench supply. Batteries are not included.

blocks.text: DC-DC Adjustable Step-Up Boost Converter 150W 6A (10V-32V to 12V-35V)

The DC-DC Adjustable Step-Up Boost Converter 150W 6A is a high-power voltage regulator module designed to increase a lower DC input voltage to a higher adjustable DC output voltage. It is ideal for electronics projects, battery-powered systems, automotive applications, DIY power supplies, LED systems, and other circuits that require a stable boosted voltage.

This module accepts an input voltage from 10V to 32V DC and boosts it to an adjustable output voltage from 12V to 35V DC. It can deliver up to 6A output current, making it suitable for medium to high-power applications. Under natural cooling, the module can provide up to 100W maximum output power, while with enhanced cooling and proper heatsinking, it can reach up to 150W real output power.

With a conversion efficiency of up to 94%, this boost converter offers reliable performance for energy-sensitive applications. It also features low no-load current, fast dynamic response, and stable voltage and load regulation, making it a practical choice for engineers, technicians, and makers.

This board is commonly used in systems where the available input voltage is lower than the required operating voltage, such as boosting 12V battery systems to higher voltages for equipment, charging setups, and regulated DC power applications.
This module does not include reverse polarity protection or short-circuit protection, so it is recommended to add a fuse or suitable protection circuit at the input side for safer operation.

تعمل هذه الوحدة بجهد دخل يتراوح من 10 فولت إلى 32 فولت تيار مستمر، وتوفر جهد خرج قابلًا للتعديل من 12 فولت إلى 35 فولت تيار مستمر. كما يمكنها توفير تيار خرج يصل إلى 6 أمبير، مما يجعلها مناسبة للتطبيقات المتوسطة والعالية القدرة. وعند استخدام التبريد الطبيعي يمكنها تقديم قدرة خرج تصل إلى 100 وات كحد أقصى، بينما يمكن أن تصل إلى 150 وات فعليًا عند تحسين التبريد واستخدام مشتت حراري مناسب.

تتميز هذه الوحدة بكفاءة تحويل تصل إلى 94%، ما يساعد على تحسين الأداء وتقليل الفقد في الطاقة. كما تتميز أيضًا باستهلاك منخفض في وضع عدم التحميل، واستجابة ديناميكية سريعة، وثبات جيد في تنظيم الجهد والحمل، وهو ما يجعلها مناسبة للمهندسين والفنيين والهواة في التطبيقات العملية المختلفة.

تُستخدم هذه الوحدة عادة عندما يكون جهد المصدر أقل من الجهد المطلوب لتشغيل الدائرة أو الجهاز، مثل رفع جهد بطارية 12 فولت إلى مستوى أعلى لتشغيل أجهزة معينة أو لاستخدامها في تطبيقات الشحن ومصادر الطاقة المنظمة.
هذه الوحدة لا تحتوي على حماية من القصر ولا حماية من عكس القطبية، لذلك يُنصح بتركيب فيوز أو دائرة حماية مناسبة على طرف الدخل للحفاظ على سلامة التشغيل.

desc: 16-Channel 12-bit PWM/Servo Driver I2C interface PCA9685 for Arduino Raspberry Pi Adjustable frequency PWM up to about 1.6 KHz 12-bit resolution for each output – for servos, that means about 4us resolution at a 60Hz update rate Configurable push-pull or an open-drain output The output enable pin to quickly disable all the outputs Terminal block for power input Reverse polarity protection on the terminal block input Green power-good LED

blocks.text: If you want to make a robot which has lots of moving parts or if you want to control too many LEDs with PWM outputs, then the limited PWM outputs of your microcontroller would be a big problem for you. To overcome this problem, the only thing you should do is to get a 16-Channel 12-Bit PWM/Servo Driver.
You can control 16 free-running PWM outputs with 16-Channel 12-Bit PWM/Servo Driver using only 2 pins. You can even chain up 62 breakouts to control up to 992 PWM outputs.
It’s an I2C-controlled PWM driver with a built-in clock. That means you do not need to continuously send it to signal to tie up your microcontroller, it is completely free running!

It is 5V compliant, which means you can control it from a 3.3V microcontroller and still safely drive up to 6V outputs. This is good when you want to control white or blue LEDs with 3.4 forward voltages. 6 address select pins so you can wire up to 62 of these on a single I2C bus, a total of 992 outputs.

3 pin connectors in groups of 4 so you can plug in 16 servos at once

There are no phase sequence tables, the high-frequency control interface programming etc. The application of A4988 interface is very suitable for a complex microprocessor is not available or overload. In the stepping operation, the chopping control in the A4988 automatically selects the current decay mode (slow or mixed). The mix decay current control scheme can reduce the audible motor noise, increased step accuracy, and reduced power consumption.
Provide internal synchronous rectification control circuitry, in order to improve the pulse width modulation (PWM) power consumption during operation.

Internal circuit protection includes thermal shutdown with hysteresis, under-voltage lockout (UVLO) and crossover current protection. Don’t need special power-up sequencing. كاوية اللحام الكهربائية الديجيتال ٦٠ وات ٢٢٠ فولت هي أداة عملية مناسبة لأعمال صيانة الإلكترونيات، لحام الأسلاك، تركيب وفك المكونات الإلكترونية، إصلاح البورد، وتجهيز الوصلات الصغيرة داخل الورشة أو المنزل. تأتي الكاوية بتصميم مباشر يعمل بدون محطة لحام منفصلة، مع شاشة صغيرة وأزرار تحكم لرفع أو خفض درجة الحرارة، مما يجعلها أفضل من الكاويات التقليدية ذات الحرارة الثابتة.

هذه الكاوية مناسبة للمستخدم الذي يحتاج إلى أداة لحام خفيفة وسهلة الاستخدام مع إمكانية التحكم في الحرارة. تعتمد على قدرة ٦٠ وات وتعمل على جهد ٢٢٠ فولت، لذلك يمكن استخدامها في أعمال اللحام اليومية مثل لحام أطراف الأسلاك، تركيب المقاومات والمكثفات والمكونات الصغيرة، إصلاح نقاط اللحام الضعيفة، وتلحيم أطراف البورد في المشاريع الإلكترونية.

الكاوية تحتوي على طرف لحام مدبب يساعد على الوصول إلى الأماكن الضيقة والنقاط الصغيرة على البوردة. هذا الطرف مناسب للأعمال الدقيقة التي تحتاج إلى تحكم أفضل، مثل لحام أطراف المكونات الصغيرة أو تنظيف نقطة لحام قبل إعادة تثبيتها. كما أن العلبة توضح أن الكاوية تدعم أطراف لحام قابلة للتغيير من نظام ٩٣٦، وهذا يجعلها عملية لأن المستخدم يستطيع تغيير شكل الطرف حسب نوع الشغل.

وجود شاشة وأزرار تحكم على اليد يجعل الاستخدام أكثر مرونة. يستطيع المستخدم ضبط الحرارة حسب نوع القصدير وحجم نقطة اللحام بدلًا من الاعتماد على حرارة واحدة طوال الوقت. في الأعمال الصغيرة يمكن استخدام حرارة أقل لتقليل خطر تلف البوردة، أما في الوصلات الأكبر أو الأسلاك السميكة نسبيًا فيمكن رفع الحرارة حسب الحاجة مع الالتزام بالاستخدام الآمن.

desc: 2-Axis joystick Bluetooth / Serial interface I2C interface nRF24L01 interface Nokia 5110 LCD interface Interface connector Power switch to switch between 3.3 and 5V

blocks.text: This JoyStick Shield Module Robotics Control is an Uno compatible shield that allows you to turn an Arduino Uno or compatible into a game console or robotic controller. 3.3V to 5V Gamepad Joystick Shield Module Game Rocker Button Controller Expansion Board For Arduino Simulated Keyboard Mouse Module.

The shield sits on top of your Arduino and turns it into a simple controller. 7 momentary push buttons ( 4 big buttons + 2 small buttons + joystick select button ) and a two-axis thumb joystick gives your Arduino functionality on the level of old Nintendo controllers.

The X-Axis potentiometer of the joystick is connected to A0. The Y-Axis potentiometer is connected to A1. The analog inputs on a microcontroller read values over a range of 0-1023 (for typical 10-bit ADC inputs). The X-Axis and Y-Axis controls should read around 512 (midpoint) when the control is at rest. As the joystick is moved, one or both of the controls will register higher or lower values depending on how the control is being moved. The joystick also has a button ‘K’ which is activated by pressing the joystick down. This button is connected to D8.

There are a total of 6 buttons on the board (not including the one on the joystick) labeled A-F. The 4 large buttons are typically used for up/down/left/right or similar functions. The two smaller buttons are typically used for less commonly used functions such as ‘select’ or ‘start’ since they are less accessible / less likely to be pressed accidentally. All buttons have pull-up resistors and pull to ground when pressed.
The RX/TX lines are brought out to a separate 4-pin female header along with 3.3V and Ground. This can be used for connecting a 4-pin 3.3V Bluetooth device or a TTL serial device.

The I2C SDA and SCL lines are brought out to a separate 4-pin male header along with 5V and Ground. This is in addition to the normal A4/A5 location of these lines. This allows for easy attachment of I2C devices.
This connector allows a nRF24L01 RF transceiver module to be plugged in.
This female header connector is designed to mount the Nokia 5110 LCD that was originally designed for Nokia phones and provides a 48×84 pixel matrix.
This interface occupies the same D9-D13 pins as the nRF24L01, so you can’t use both at the same time.

This dual row yellow male header connector provides another point of access to all the buttons, joystick pots, 3.3V, 5V and Ground. The pin-out of this connector is labeled on the board to the left of the connector.

blocks.text: PWM DC Motor Speed Controller 4.5V–35V 5A 90W Manual Speed Control Module

The PWM DC Motor Speed Controller 4.5V–35V 5A 90W is a practical and compact control module for adjusting the speed of DC brushed motors in a simple and efficient way. By using PWM control, this module changes the motor speed without causing the large power loss associated with basic resistive control methods, which helps improve efficiency and reduce unnecessary heat generation.

This controller supports a wide input voltage range from 4.5V to 35V DC, making it suitable for many low-voltage and medium-voltage motor control applications. It can be used with different DC power sources and a wide variety of small to medium brushed DC motors, depending on the motor’s voltage and current requirements. The built-in rotary potentiometer knob allows smooth manual adjustment of the output duty cycle, which directly changes the motor speed from low to high in a controlled manner.

With a rated output current of up to 5A and a maximum power handling of 90W, this speed controller is suitable for many hobby, DIY, robotics, educational, and light industrial applications. It is commonly used in fans, blowers, pumps, small tools, model vehicles, robotic systems, and automation experiments where variable speed control is needed.

The module features a compact PCB design with screw terminal connections for both the DC input and motor output, making installation straightforward and practical. Based on the provided data, it operates at a PWM frequency of around 20kHz and supports a duty cycle adjustment range of 1% to 100%, allowing responsive and flexible motor speed tuning.

This controller is intended for DC brushed motors only and should not be connected directly to AC mains power. It is also important to observe correct input polarity during wiring. If the motor rotates in the opposite direction from what is expected, the output wires to the motor can be reversed to change the direction.

تُعد دائرة التحكم في سرعة موتور DC من 4.5 إلى 35 فولت PWM 5A 90W وحدة عملية ومناسبة للتحكم في سرعة مواتير التيار المستمر ذات الفرش بطريقة سهلة وفعالة. تعتمد هذه الدائرة على تقنية PWM، وهي طريقة فعالة لتغيير سرعة الموتور دون الفقد الكبير في الطاقة الذي يحدث في طرق التحكم التقليدية، مما يساعد على تحسين الكفاءة وتقليل الحرارة الناتجة أثناء التشغيل.

تدعم هذه الدائرة مدى واسع من جهد التشغيل يبدأ من 4.5 فولت وحتى 35 فولت تيار مستمر، مما يجعلها مناسبة لعدد كبير من التطبيقات الإلكترونية والمشروعات المختلفة. ويمكن استخدامها مع مصادر تغذية متعددة ومع عدد كبير من مواتير التيار المستمر الصغيرة والمتوسطة، بشرط أن تكون ضمن حدود الجهد والتيار المسموح بها. كما أن وجود مقاومة متغيرة بمقبض دوار على اللوحة يسمح بضبط السرعة يدويًا بسهولة وبشكل سلس حسب الحاجة.

توفر الوحدة تيار خرج يصل إلى 5 أمبير مع قدرة قصوى 90 وات، مما يجعلها مناسبة للعديد من التطبيقات مثل الروبوتات، والمراوح، والمضخات الصغيرة، وتجارب الأتمتة، والمشروعات التعليمية، والدوائر التجريبية، وبعض الأدوات الصغيرة التي تحتاج إلى التحكم في سرعة الموتور بشكل مرن.

تأتي الدائرة بتصميم صغير الحجم مع أطراف توصيل لولبية لدخل التغذية وخروج الموتور، مما يسهل عملية التوصيل والتركيب. ووفقًا للبيانات المتوفرة، تعمل الدائرة بتردد PWM حوالي 20 كيلوهرتز، مع مجال ضبط لنسبة التشغيل من 1% إلى 100%، وهو ما يتيح تحكمًا جيدًا في سرعة الموتور من السرعة المنخفضة إلى السرعة الأعلى.

هذه الوحدة مخصصة للاستخدام مع مواتير التيار المستمر ذات الفرش فقط، ولا يجب توصيلها مباشرة بتيار متردد. كما يجب التأكد من توصيل القطبية بشكل صحيح لتجنب تلف الدائرة. وإذا كانت جهة دوران الموتور عكس المطلوب، يمكن ببساطة عكس طرفي خرج الموتور لتغيير الاتجاه.

In this paragraph, I’m going to discuss “what is power supply”
A power supply is an electrical device that supplies electric power to an electrical load.
The primary function of a power supply is to convert electric current from a source to the correct voltage, current, and frequency to power the load.
As a result, power supplies are sometimes referred to as electric power converters.
Some power supplies are separate standalone pieces of equipment, while others are built into the load appliances that they power.
Examples of the latter include power supplies found in desktop computers and consumer electronics devices.

It helps with fresh tape/adhesive traces. For cured residue, combine with appropriate remover and a plastic scraper, then finish with a new cube.

Re-using spreads contaminants. Single-use is recommended for quality control.

blocks.text: The Official Raspberry Pi 5 Active Cooler provides an alternative cooling solution for users who wish to use their Raspberry Pi 5 under sustained heavy load without a case. It combines a large aluminum metal heatsink with a variable-speed blower, again powered and controlled via the fan connector, and attaches to the Raspberry Pi 5 PCB via sprung pins into a pair of mounting holes.

blocks.text: Compact Step-Down Transformer 220VAC to 6V-0-6V AC 300mA – 3 Wire Center-Tapped Output

This compact step-down transformer converts a 220V AC mains input into a center-tapped 6V-0-6V AC output through three secondary wires. It is suitable for low-power electronic circuits, educational kits, signal-processing projects, and small power-supply designs that require a symmetrical low-voltage AC source.

Each outer secondary wire provides approximately 6V AC relative to the center-tap wire, while the voltage measured between the two outer wires is approximately 12V AC. After adding a suitable rectifier, smoothing capacitors, and voltage regulation, the transformer can be used to build single-rail or positive and negative DC power supplies.

blocks.text: GY-53 VL53L0X Laser ToF Flight Time Ranging Sensor Module – High Precision Time-of-Flight Distance Measurement with PWM & Serial Output

The GY-53 VL53L0X Laser ToF Flight Time Ranging Sensor Module is a state-of-the-art distance sensor utilizing ST’s patented FlightSense™ technology to deliver unparalleled accuracy in distance measurement, independent of target size, color, or reflectivity.

This compact module integrates the VL53L0X sensor with a built-in 2.8V regulator, signal level shifter, and breakout board design, allowing easy integration with a wide range of systems, including Arduino, STM32, 51 MCU, and other microcontroller platforms.

Unlike conventional ultrasonic or IR sensors, the VL53L0X employs a precise laser-based Time-of-Flight (ToF) method to measure the time light takes to bounce back from the object, providing accurate and reliable distance readings with a narrow field of view.
It also supports basic gesture detection use-cases, making it ideal for robotics, automation, smart home devices, and energy-saving applications.

blocks.text: Pluggable Terminal Block 2 Pin KF2EDGR-5.08-2P Right Angle 5.08mm (Rozetta Plug-in)

Pitch 5.08 mm (0.2″), 2 poles, tidy horizontal cable exit, and a robust PBT housing. Ideal for power I/O, drivers, sensor hubs, and quick board swaps. Female plug (2-pin): body length ~17.6 mm, body height ~15.2 mm, internal stack refs 9.2/12.5 mm, width grows with poles (5.08 mm × N).
Right-angle male header (2-pin): depth ~22.75 mm, height ~15.5 mm, body width ~8.5 mm, pin pitch 5.08 mm, end offsets 3.54 mm.
(All in mm; use drawings for footprints and keep-outs.)
⚙️ 1) Footprint: Place 2 holes on a 5.08 mm center; keep the header close to the board edge for cable clearance.
⚙️ 2) Solder header: Wave or hand-solder; inspect fillets.
⚙️ 3) Prepare wires: Strip ~6–7 mm; insert and tighten screws.
⚙️ 4) Mate parts: Push the plug straight onto the header until fully seated.
⚙️ 5) Service: To replace the board, just pull the plug—your harness stays intact.
💡 Label polarity (+/–) on silkscreen near the header.
💡 Leave ≥2 mm between adjacent blocks for screwdriver access.
💡 Use ferrules on fine-strand leads for repeatable clamping.
💡 Add a cable tie-point for strain relief when the harness is heavy.

Enamelled Copper Soldering Wire is a specialized type of soldering wire used in various applications, particularly in electronics and electrical work. Enamelled soldering wire features a copper core, which is an excellent conductor of electricity. This core is coated with an insulating enamel layer. The copper core is coated with a layer of enamel, which serves as electrical insulation. This insulation prevents short circuits and electrical leakage when soldering. Enamelled copper wire is convenient for soldering in applications where electrical connections need to be made while keeping the conductors insulated from each other.

Enamelled copper soldering wire comes in various diameters and gauges to accommodate different applications and soldering requirements. Thicker wires are suitable for high-current applications, while thinner wires are used for precision soldering. The copper core ensures excellent heat transfer during soldering, allowing for efficient and reliable solder joints. Some enamelled copper soldering wires may have a flux core, which aids in soldering by promoting the flow and adhesion of solder to the copper core. Enamelled copper soldering wire is used in various electrical and electronic applications, including coil winding, transformer winding, motor rewinding, and other wiring tasks.

MECHANIC UV Curing Solder Mask Ink in Black is a specialized solder mask ink used in PCB manufacturing to insulate and protect specific areas of the board. Its UV curing capability, electrical insulation, and black color make it a valuable tool in ensuring reliable and efficient soldering and PCB protection in both DIY and professional electronics applications.

name: Raspberry Pi 4 Case with Fan Place Black Color High Quality (Fan Not Included )
desc: NOTE: Raspberry Pi And Fan Not Included.

blocks.text: Since the launch of the Raspberry Pi 4 Model B single-board computer, there are many enclosure or case for it. I like this particularly because it is lightweight, made with ABS, easy to assemble (no screw needed, just snap and fit) and it need cooling fan (requires 4 easy mounting screws) because the Raspberry Pi 4B need it 🙂
We love this case since the version for Raspberry Pi 3B and 3B+, now it’s finally being updated to be compatible with the Raspberry Pi 4 Model B board. And it takes the cooling into consideration.

The case comes in three main parts so you can snap on (no screw). There is a base plane, where you should place the Raspberry Pi 4 board (remove the microSD card first), the middle part which is a rectangular shape part that has opening for connectors (USB ports, Ethernet port, micro HDMI, USB Type C, Audio/Vidoe jack, etc) and partial of the top side; and the last part is the top cover with an opening and mounting holes for cooling fan. The user is free to remove the top cover and access to the connectors of the camera, display, and GPIO.
This case’s smart design and customizability make it a worthy addition to the Pi case genre! The opening allows additional heatsink for the processor, RAM and USB controller:
Note: This product is just the case. It does not come with Raspberry Pi or heatsinks.
Note: The gap between the top cover and middle part is purposely designed to allow airflow for ventilation and cable (GPIO, Camera, Display) access.
In case you are asking about the bottom of the case, here it is. You can access to the MicroSD card easily 🙂
The cooling fan will require mounting with the screws and nuts provided and connect the connector to Pin 4 (Red to 5V) and Pin 6 (Black to GND) as shown in the picture:

We have done the stress test on Raspberry Pi 4 Model B 4GB board. The test is carried out to compare the temperature performance of the Raspberry Pi 4 with this nice ABS case, Fan ON and Fan Off. This is just one of the many methods you can use to benchmark the thermal performance of the enclosure or heatsink. The test consists of two parts which are cooling and continue with stress test. The stress test loads the CPU to 100% and logs the temperature. We have also updated the EEPROM firmware of Raspberry Pi 4 Model B to 000137ad (date: 10 Sep 2019), the thermal performance improved significantly:
As you can see from the chart, the cooling fan plays an important role in keeping the Raspberry Pi cool 🙂 So make sure the fan is there and working if you like this enclosure/case.

Provide flexibility to use the top cover or not
Abandon space for extra heatsink if you want
Stick on rubber feet for case stability
Designed for Raspberry Pi 4 Model B

blocks.text: MaAnt Ant936 Series 900M Soldering Iron Tips – I / J / SK

MaAnt Ant936 Series 900M Soldering Iron Tips are universal replacement soldering iron heads designed for technicians, repair workshops, electronics labs, and micro-soldering applications. This variable product includes selected tip shapes from the Ant936 series, giving users the ability to choose the most suitable soldering head according to the repair task, soldering area, component size, and working angle.

The available variations are 900M-T-I, 900M-T-J, and 900M-T-SK. Each variation is designed for a different soldering style: the I tip is suitable for fine straight-point soldering, the J tip is suitable for curved precision soldering in narrow areas, and the SK knife-style tip is suitable for wider contact soldering, drag soldering, bridge correction, and more flexible repair work. This makes the product a practical choice for users who want one product page that covers multiple soldering tip options without creating separate listings for every shape.

The MaAnt Ant936 series is made with a red copper core for fast heat conduction and stable temperature response. The tip structure uses multilayer electroplating to improve surface durability, oxidation resistance, tin wetting behavior, and long service life. A built-in stainless steel pipe helps reduce the chance of the inner wall oxidizing and sticking to the heating core, making replacement easier and helping protect the soldering iron heater during maintenance.

These soldering tips are suitable for most 936-type soldering stations and soldering irons that use compatible 900M-style tips. They are commonly used for phone board repair, laptop motherboard maintenance, SMD component soldering, IC pin touch-up, jumper wire work, connector soldering, bridge cleaning, and general electronics repair.

سنون كاوية ما أنت فئة تسعمائة إم للحام والصيانة الدقيقة

سنون كاوية ما أنت من فئة أنت تسعمائة ستة وثلاثين هي سنون بديلة شاملة مصممة لأعمال الصيانة الإلكترونية، وورش إصلاح الهواتف، والمعامل، وأعمال اللحام الدقيق. المنتج هنا يتم إعداده كمنتج متعدد الاختيارات، بحيث يختار العميل شكل السن المناسب حسب نوع الصيانة، مساحة اللحام، حجم المكون، وزاوية الوصول إلى نقطة العمل.

المقاسات المتاحة لدينا هي: سن مستقيم رفيع، وسن منحني رفيع، وسن سكينة رفيع. كل شكل له استخدام عملي مختلف؛ السن المستقيم مناسب للنقاط الصغيرة جدًا وأرجل المكونات الدقيقة، والسن المنحني مناسب للوصول إلى الأماكن الضيقة والزوايا الصعبة، أما سن السكينة فهو مناسب للحام بالسحب، وإصلاح الجسور، والكونكتورات، والنقاط التي تحتاج مساحة تلامس أكبر مع القصدير.

تم تصميم هذه الفئة بلب من النحاس الأحمر للمساعدة في توصيل الحرارة بسرعة وثبات أثناء العمل. كما تعتمد على طبقات طلاء متعددة لتحسين مقاومة الأكسدة، وتحسين قابلية التقصدير، وزيادة العمر التشغيلي للسن عند الاستخدام الصحيح. وجود ماسورة داخلية من الاستانلس يساعد على تقليل التصاق السن بقلب التسخين، مما يجعل عملية تغيير السن أسهل ويقلل خطر تلف السخان أثناء الاستبدال.

تصلح هذه السنون للعديد من كاويات ومحطات اللحام المتوافقة مع نفس المقاس المستخدم في فئة تسعمائة إم، وتستخدم بكثرة في صيانة لوحات الهواتف، وصيانة اللوحات الإلكترونية، ولحام المكونات السطحية الصغيرة، وإصلاح أرجل الدوائر المتكاملة، وتركيب أسلاك التعويض، وتنظيف جسور القصدير، وأعمال الصيانة العامة.

blocks.text: 24V 15Ah High Drain Rechargeable Lithium-ion Battery Pack – 30A Max Discharge with 6S5P Design

24V 15Ah High Drain Rechargeable Lithium-ion Battery Pack is designed for applications that need a practical balance between strong output power, useful runtime, and portable size. With a rated 15Ah capacity and up to 30A maximum discharge current, this battery pack is suitable for 24V systems that require stable current delivery under load, especially devices that need higher startup current or continuous high-drain performance.

The battery provides a nominal 24V output and reaches approximately 25.2V when fully charged. This makes it suitable for many 24V DC applications such as electric mobility projects, LED lighting systems, portable workshop tools, routers, security systems, robotics, and custom electronic builds. Its 15Ah capacity gives longer runtime than smaller 24V packs, while the 30A high-drain output gives the battery enough current headroom for demanding loads within the rated limit.

This model is built in a professional 6S5P lithium-ion configuration using 30 total cells. The 6-series structure provides the required 24V class output, while the 5-parallel arrangement helps distribute load current across multiple cells. This design supports improved voltage stability, better current sharing, and reduced stress on individual cells during high-drain operation.

The integrated BMS protection circuit helps improve safety and reliability by supporting protection against overcharge, over-discharge, short circuit, and excessive current conditions. This makes the battery more suitable for repeated practical use in mobile, workshop, backup, and DIY applications when used with a compatible 24V lithium-ion charger and within the specified electrical limits.
Why Choose This 24V 15Ah High Drain Battery?

This battery is a strong middle option between compact lower-capacity packs and larger heavy battery packs. It provides more runtime than a 10Ah battery while staying more portable than larger 20Ah or 40Ah packs. The 30A maximum discharge rating makes it useful for applications that need a strong current response, including motors, LED systems, power tools, and backup systems that require dependable 24V output.

blocks.text: XUDA A5 Mini Wireless CarPlay Android Auto USB Adapter 2 in 1 Smart Mini Box

XUDA A5 Mini Wireless CarPlay Android Auto USB Adapter 2 in 1 Smart Mini Box is a compact plug-and-play wireless adapter designed to convert supported factory wired CarPlay or wired Android Auto systems into a wireless experience. Instead of connecting your phone with a cable every time you enter the car, this mini USB adapter allows compatible vehicles to connect wirelessly after the first pairing setup.

The adapter is made for cars that already support original wired Apple CarPlay or wired Android Auto through the vehicle USB port. It does not add CarPlay or Android Auto to cars that do not already have the wired function. Once installed and paired, it helps keep the car interior cleaner, reduces cable clutter, and allows easier access to maps, music, calls, messages, voice control, and compatible driving apps through the original car screen.

With a small USB-disk-style body, the A5 Mini can be plugged directly into the car USB port in the center console, dashboard, or armrest box depending on the vehicle design. Its compact size makes it less intrusive than cable-based adapters, while the wireless connection uses WiFi and Bluetooth pairing for convenient daily use.

HY410 Thermal Grease 20mL Heatsink Compound Paste is a thermal compound supplied in a syringe-style applicator for improving heat transfer between electronic components and heatsinks. It is designed to fill the tiny air gaps between surfaces, helping heat move more efficiently from the component body to the heatsink or cooling plate.

This thermal grease is suitable for processors, graphics chips, power transistors, voltage regulators, LED heatsinks, laptop maintenance, electronics repair, and general cooling applications. The syringe package makes the paste easier to apply in controlled amounts, especially during repair work, heatsink installation, or routine thermal paste replacement.

blocks.text: WAGO F14 Wire Connector 1 In 4 Out – Compact Spring Lever Distribution Connector
WAGO NV-F14 Wire Connector 1 In 4 Out

The WAGO NV-F14 Wire Connector is a practical and compact solution for electrical installations that require one incoming wire to be distributed into multiple outgoing lines safely and neatly. With its 1 input and 4 output configuration, this connector is especially useful for branch wiring, parallel distribution, and organized cable routing in compact electrical setups.

This WAGO wire connector uses a spring lever clamping mechanism, allowing wires to be inserted and locked quickly without twisting, soldering, or using screw terminals. This makes installation faster, reduces wiring effort, and simplifies future maintenance or rewiring. Each conductor is clamped individually, which helps provide secure wire holding and stable long-term electrical contact.

blocks.text: ✅ Product type: Solder wire for electronics work
✅ Purpose: Clean, controlled solder feeding for PCB pads, small joints, jumpers, and fine-pitch rework where you want steady flow and predictable bead size.
Why this solder wire fits precision work
✅ Fine diameter control (0.3mm): Supports accurate feeding into small joints without overloading the pad with excess solder.
✅ Sn63/Pb37 alloy behavior: The 63/37 alloy is widely used in electronics work where you want consistent wetting and smooth joint formation under proper technique and temperature control.
✅ 40g roll size: Practical weight for a bench kit—enough to handle frequent repairs while staying compact for tool bags and service calls.
✅ Reduced cleanup stress: When the solder amount is easier to control, post-solder cleanup and inspection become simpler—especially around tight components and clustered pads.
✅ Better visual inspection: Fine solder feeding helps keep joints neat, which supports inspection for bridges, cold joints, and uneven fillets.
✅ Controlled solder volume: 0.3mm wire supports “small-in, small-out” feeding—useful for micro pads, fine traces, and compact connectors.
✅ Smooth joint shaping: Sn63/Pb37 supports a clean fillet when the pad, lead, and tip contact are correct and the joint is heated evenly.
✅ Less accidental bridging: Fine wire helps you avoid pushing too much solder into adjacent pads, especially on dense boards.
✅ Good for jumpers and fly wires: When building tiny solder anchors for jumper wire routing, the smaller diameter helps keep anchors tight and tidy.
✅ Consistent workflow: A stable solder feed rate makes your hand technique easier to repeat across many joints.
🔌 Mobile phone repair and micro soldering where tight layouts demand precise solder quantity.
⚙️ PCB assembly and rework on small pads and compact component spacing.
🧠 Connector pins and shield tabs where you want controlled flow and a neat finish.
🧰 Jumper wire anchoring for trace repair, fly-line work, and micro pad rebuilding.
🛡️ Service centers and field technicians who need a compact roll that covers many job types.
✅ Surface prep: Keep pads and leads clean before soldering.
✅ Tip condition: Use a well-tinned tip to keep heat transfer stable.
✅ Heat the joint, not the solder: Touch the tip to both pad and lead so they rise together to soldering temperature.
✅ Feed solder into the joint: Use the 0.3mm wire to feed the exact amount needed—stop as soon as the fillet forms.
✅ Remove solder first, then tip: This helps avoid pulling solder or creating spikes.
✅ Let the joint settle: Keep the board steady while the joint transitions from molten to solid.
✅ Match solder feed to pad size: Fine pads need fine feed; 0.3mm supports that balance.
✅ Avoid flooding: If a joint looks bulky, reduce feed time instead of increasing heat.
✅ Use stable hand bracing: Brace your hands on the bench to keep the feed consistent.
✅ Inspect under light: Look for smooth fillets, proper wetting, and no bridges.
✅ Rework carefully: For rework, remove excess solder first, then reflow with controlled feeding.
✅ Fine-pitch IC edges: Helps manage solder quantity near adjacent pins.
✅ Small passives: Keeps solder from creeping up too high on tiny terminations.
✅ Delicate pads: Reduces the chance of overheating by minimizing repeated feeding and reflow.
✅ Tight ground areas: Supports quick, targeted solder placement when the joint heats correctly.
✅ Compact connectors: Helps you avoid bulky joints that interfere with connector seating or shielding.
✅ Works with common soldering stations and handheld irons when tip size, heat stability, and joint contact are correct.
✅ Suitable for bench setups that prioritize precision feeding and clean joint appearance.
✅ Fits routine electronics soldering tasks that require Sn63/Pb37 composition, 0.3mm diameter, and 40g quantity.
✅ Keep the roll clean and protected from dust and oils to maintain consistent solder feeding.
✅ Store with your soldering consumables so the wire stays easy to pull and doesn’t kink or snag.
✅ If your work involves dense pads and small joints, choosing a 0.3mm solder wire supports better control.
✅ If you want consistent joint formation under good technique, Sn63/Pb37 is a clear choice for many electronics benches.
✅ A 40g roll keeps your kit compact while still supporting frequent day-to-day repairs.

مضخة هواء ضغط سلبي 12 فولت موديل واي بي 555-60 إيه بي إم

تُعد مضخة الهواء ذات الضغط السلبي 12 فولت موديل واي بي 555-60 إيه بي إم خيارًا عمليًا وفعالًا للتطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى توليد تفريغ هوائي ثابت أو ضغط سلبي موثوق أو تدفق هواء مستمر. تعتمد هذه المضخة على تصميم غشائي مع محرك قوي من فئة 555، مما يمنحها توازنًا جيدًا بين الحجم والأداء وقوة الشفط، لذلك فهي مناسبة للأنظمة الاحترافية والمشروعات الهندسية المتقدمة على حد سواء.

تُستخدم هذه المضخة في عدد كبير من التطبيقات التي تعتمد على الشفط أو حركة الهواء المنظمة، مثل الأجهزة الطبية المساعدة، ومعدات المعامل، وأنظمة أخذ العينات، ووحدات المناولة بالشفط، وأنظمة التحكم الهوائي الصغيرة، وأعمال الأتمتة والروبوتات. ويساعد التصميم الغشائي على توفير أداء مستقر مع إحكام جيد، مما يجعلها مناسبة للأنظمة التي تحتاج إلى ضغط سلبي منتظم أثناء التشغيل.

تعمل المضخة ضمن نطاق جهد من 6 فولت إلى 12 فولت، وتوفر ضغط هواء يصل إلى 80 كيلوباسكال، مع درجة تفريغ أكبر من سالب 50 كيلوباسكال، ومعدل تدفق هواء بدون حمل أكبر من 17 لترًا في الدقيقة. هذه المواصفات تجعلها مناسبة لمجموعة واسعة من الاستخدامات في الشفط ونقل الهواء والقياس والمعالجة الهوائية. كما أن حجمها المدمج يسهل دمجها داخل الأجهزة صغيرة المساحة أو الأنظمة المحمولة أو المشروعات المخصصة.

وتتميز المضخة بسهولة التوصيل مع الخراطيم بفضل أقطار مدخل ومخرج الهواء المناسبة، إلى جانب بنية ميكانيكية جيدة تساعد على الاستخدام المتكرر داخل أنظمة المختبرات والتحكم الصناعي والتطبيقات البيئية ومشروعات النماذج الأولية. سواء كنت تعمل على تطوير نظام شفط مخصص، أو ترغب في بناء مشروع يعتمد على التفريغ الهوائي، أو تحتاج إلى مضخة مدمجة لنظام هندسي صغير، فإن هذا الموديل يقدم أداءً عمليًا في حجم مناسب.

name: Arduino Uno R3 Board without Cable High Quality
desc: Arduino Uno R3 Board without Cable High Quality Micro-controller : ATmega328. Operating Voltage : 5V. Input Voltage (recommended) : 7-12V. Digital I/O Pins : 14 (of which 6 provide PWM output). Analog Input Pins : 6.

blocks.text: BUY Arduino Uno R3 Board without Cable in Egypt

The Uno R3 without Cable is a micro-controller board base on the ATmega328 (datasheet). It has 14 digital input/output pins (of which 6 can be used as PWM outputs); 6 analog inputs, a 16 MHz ceramic resonator, a USB connection, a power jack, an ICSP header, and a reset button.It contains everything need to support the microcontroller; simply connect it to a computer with a USB cable or power it with an AC-to-DC adapter or battery to get started.“Uno” means one in Italian and is the name to mark the upcoming release of Arduino 1.0. The Uno and version 1.0 will be the reference versions of Arduino, moving forward. The Uno is the latest in a series of USB Arduino boards and the reference model for the Arduino platform; for a comparison with previous versions, see the index of Arduino boards.

Note: The Uno R3 reference design can use an Atmega8, 168, or 328, Current models use an ATmega328, but an Atmega8 is shown in the schematic for reference. The pin configuration is identical on all three processors.
The Uno R3 can be powered via the USB connection or with an external power supply. The power source is selected automatically.

External (non-USB) power can come either from an AC-to-DC adapter (wall-wart) or battery. The adapter can be connected by plugging a 2.1mm center-positive plug into the board’s power jack. Leads from a battery can be inserted in the Gnd and Vin pin headers of the POWER connector.

The board can operate on an external supply of 6 to 20 volts. If supplied with less than 7V, however, the 5V pin may supply less than five volts and the board may be unstable. If using more than 12V, the voltage regulator may overheat and damage the board. The recommended range is 7 to 12 volts.
The power pins are as follows

VIN. The input voltage to the Arduino board when it’s using an external power source (as opposed to 5 volts from the USB connection or another regulated power source). You can supply voltage through this pin, or, if supplying voltage via the power jack, access it through this pin.

5V.This pin outputs a regulated 5V from the regulator on the board. The board can be supplied with power either from the DC power jack (7 – 12V), the USB connector (5V), or the VIN pin of the board (7-12V). Supplying voltage via the 5V or 3.3V pins bypasses the regulator, and can damage your board. We don’t advise it.
3V3. A 3.3 volt supply generated by the onboard regulator. The maximum current draw is 50 mA.

IOREF. This pin on the Arduino board provides the voltage reference with which the microcontroller operates. A properly configured shield can read the IOREF pin voltage and select the appropriate power source or enable voltage translators on the outputs for working with the 5V or 3.3V.
The ATmega328 has 32 KB (with 0.5 KB used for the bootloader). It also has 2 KB of SRAM and 1 KB of EEPROM (which can be read and written with the EEPROM library).
Input and Output of Arduino uno

Each of the 14 digital pins on the Uno can be used as an input or output, using pinMode(), digitalWrite(), and digitalRead() functions. They operate at 5 volts. Each pin can provide or receive a maximum of 40 mA and has an internal pull-up resistor (disconnected by default) of 20-50 kOhms. In addition, some pins have specialized functions:
Serial: 0 (RX) and 1 (TX). Used to receive (RX) and transmit (TX) TTL serial data. These pins are connected to the corresponding pins of the ATmega8U2 USB-to-TTL Serial chip.
External Interrupts 2 and 3. These pins can be configured to trigger an interrupt on a low value, a rising or falling edge, or a change in value. See the attachInterrupt() function for details.
PWM: 3, 5, 6, 9, 10, and 11. Provide 8-bit PWM output with the analogWrite() function.
SPI: 10 (SS), 11 (MOSI), 12 (MISO), 13 (SCK). These pins support SPI communication using the SPI library.
LED: 13. There is a built-in LED connected to digital pin 13. When the pin is HIGH value, the LED is on, when the pin is LOW, it’s off.

The Uno R3 has 6 analog inputs, labeled A0 through A5, each of which provides 10 bits of resolution (i.e. 1024 different values). By default, they measure from ground to 5 volts, though is it possible to change the upper end of their range using the AREF pin and the analogReference() function. Additionally, some pins have specialized functionality:
TWI: A4 or SDA pin and A5 or SCL pin. Support TWI communication using the Wire library.
There are a couple of other pins on the board:
AREF. A reference voltage for the analog inputs. Used with analogReference().
Reset. Bring this line LOW to reset the microcontroller. Typically used to add a reset button to shields which block the one on the board.
See also the mapping between Arduino pins and ATmega328 ports. The mapping for the Atmega8, 168, and 328 is identical.

The Uno R3 has a number of facilities for communicating with a computer, another Arduino, or other microcontrollers. The ATmega328 provides UART TTL (5V) serial communication, which is available on digital pins 0 (RX) and 1 (TX). An ATmega16U2 on the board channels this serial communication over USB and appears as a virtual com port to software on the computer. The ’16U2 firmware uses the standard USB COM drivers, and no external driver is needed. However, on Windows, a .inf file is required. The Arduino software includes a serial monitor which allows simple textual data to be sent to and from the Arduino board. The RX and TX LEDs on the board will flash when data is being transmitted via the USB-to-serial chip and USB connection to the computer (but not for serial communication on pins 0 and 1).
A SoftwareSerial library allows for serial communication on any of the Uno’s digital pins.

The ATmega328 also supports I2C (TWI) and SPI communication. The Uno R3 software includes a Wire library to simplify use of the I2C bus; see the documentation for details. For SPI communication, use the SPI library.

شاشة سيارة ملونة قابلة للطي مقاس ٤٫٣ بوصة تعمل على ١٢ فولت موديل زد دي إكس ٤٤٤ هي شاشة صغيرة وعملية مخصصة للاستخدام داخل السيارة، وتستخدم غالبًا مع كاميرات الرجوع للخلف أو أنظمة مراقبة الفيديو البسيطة داخل المركبات. حجم الشاشة ٤٫٣ بوصة يجعلها مناسبة لعرض صورة الكاميرا بوضوح كافٍ بدون أن تشغل مساحة كبيرة على تابلوه السيارة.

تأتي الشاشة بتصميم قابل للطي، بحيث يمكن فتحها عند الحاجة وإغلاقها بعد الاستخدام. هذا التصميم يساعد على توفير المساحة داخل السيارة، كما يساعد في حماية سطح الشاشة من الخدوش والأتربة عند عدم الاستخدام. لذلك تعتبر اختيارًا مناسبًا لمن يريد شاشة كاميرا خلفية صغيرة لا تظل مرفوعة طوال الوقت.

تعمل الشاشة على جهد ١٢ فولت، وهو الجهد الشائع في أنظمة كهرباء السيارات. كما تحتوي على توصيلات سلكية للطاقة وإشارة الفيديو، مما يجعلها مناسبة للتوصيل مع كاميرا خلفية متوافقة أو مصدر فيديو مناسب حسب طريقة التركيب. يمكن استخدامها مع كاميرا خلفية، كاميرا أمامية، كاميرا جانبية، أو أي نظام فيديو بسيط متوافق مع السيارة.

بفضل جسمها الخفيف وزر التشغيل البسيط والتصميم القابل للطي، يمكن تركيبها في السيارات والمركبات الصغيرة وبعض تطبيقات الصيانة ومشروعات السيارات المعدلة. وهي مناسبة للعملاء الذين يحتاجون شاشة اقتصادية وبسيطة لعرض صورة الكاميرا بدون الحاجة إلى شاشة كبيرة أو نظام ترفيهي كامل.

It is commonly available with orange lever handles, depending on stock and production batch.

The part is marked B10K on the bottom (linear, 10 kΩ). Your measurements: body length 88 mm, body width 15 mm, body thickness 8 mm (without shaft), and shaft length 8 mm (from body top to shaft tip). name: CD4067 16-channel Analog Multiplexer/Demultiplexer

blocks.text: CD4067 is a part of the CD4000 IC series. CD4067 CMOS analog multiplexers/DE multiplexers are digitally controlled analog switches having low ON impedance, low OFF leakage current, and internal address decoding. The CD4067 is a 16-channel multiplexer with four binary control inputs, A, B, C, D, and an inhibit input, arranged so that any combination of the inputs selects one switch. A logic “1” present at the inhibit input turns all channels off. The IC is designed to operate over a temperature range of 0 to 70°C. The output of the IC always comes in TTL which makes it easy to work with other TTL devices and microcontrollers. The IC also constitutes a wide array of features such as thermal overload protection & ESD protection.

A multiplexer is a combinational logic circuit that switches one of several input lines to a single common output line. The select lines determine which input is connected to the output, and also to increase the amount of data that can be sent over a network within a certain time. It is also called a data selector.

A decoder/demultiplexer is a combinational logic circuit & an integral part of todays consumer scale electronics. It is designed to switch one common input line to one of several separate output lines. So, A demultiplexer converts a serial data signal at the input to a parallel data at its output lines.

تم تصنيع الأدوات من فولاذ قوي مقاوم للاستخدام المتكرر، مما يمنحها متانة جيدة وعمر خدمة عمليًا مع الاستخدام الصحيح. كما أن مفتاح الراشيت يساعد على تسريع عملية الربط والفك، خاصة في الأماكن التي تحتاج إلى حركة مريحة ومتكررة، بينما تساعد وصلات الإطالة والوصلة المرنة على الوصول إلى المواضع الضيقة أو غير المباشرة.

ومن أهم مميزات هذا الطقم أنه يأتي داخل شنطة حفظ صلبة تساعد على تنظيم كل قطعة في مكانها، وتحافظ على الأدوات من الفقد أو التبعثر، كما تسهّل نقلها واستخدامها في أي مكان. لذلك فهو مناسب جدًا للفنيين الذين يحتاجون إلى عدة متنقلة، وكذلك للمستخدم المنزلي الذي يريد مجموعة أدوات مرتبة وسهلة التخزين.
إذا كنت تبحث عن طقم عدة عملي ومتكامل يغطي أغلب أعمال الفك والربط والصيانة الخفيفة والمتوسطة، فإن هذا الطقم المكون من 46 قطعة يقدم لك حلاً مناسبًا يجمع بين التنوع وسهولة الحمل والتنظيم الجيد.
