It is widely used in robotic arms, RC cars, boats, aircraft models, pan-tilt systems, steering assemblies, and automation projects where stable motion and dependable torque are important.

One of the key advantages of the MG995 is its full metal gear construction, including brass-based gear components for improved wear resistance and longer service life under repeated movement and load. Compared with lighter hobby servos, the MG995 is better suited for projects that involve heavier linkage systems or frequent directional changes.

The servo uses a standard 3-wire interface and is easy to control from common platforms such as Arduino, Raspberry Pi, servo testers, and RC receivers. The wire mapping is standard and clearly shown in the uploaded diagram: orange for PWM signal, red for VCC, and brown for ground. The control method is based on PWM at 50Hz, which makes integration simple in most hobby and embedded systems.

According to the uploaded PDF, the MG995 features a stable and shock-proof dual ball bearing design, which helps support smoother output shaft movement and better mechanical stability during operation. The same document lists a 30cm cable, approximate dimensions around 40.7 × 19.7 × 42.9 mm, and a weight of about 55g, making it suitable for standard servo brackets and common robotics assemblies.

The AD20P-1230A is a miniature centrifugal brushless DC pump. Inside, an electronically commutated motor spins a magnetically coupled impeller. With 240 liters per hour of rated maximum flow and a 3-meter maximum head, it neatly bridges the gap between tiny aquarium pumps and heavier industrial units.

🧪 Fluid compatibility: fresh water or similar low-viscosity, non-flammable liquids. Avoid solvents, strong acids/alkalis, or hot fluids beyond operating limits.

⚖️ Flow vs. head: as system restriction rises, flow falls. At 0 m head you can approach the Qmax 240 L/H; near 3 m vertical rise the stream tapers. For best real-world results, keep total dynamic head under ~2 m.
🔇 Acoustics: brushless design and small rotor mass keep noise low—mount on rubber pads to decouple any residual vibration.

🛑 Do not run dry. Water also cools and lubricates the impeller; dry-running can damage the pump.
🔁 Periodic rinse: if you see reduced flow, flush the inlet and check for scale or algae.

The QTR-8RC Line Following Reflectance IR Sensor Array is a powerful and efficient tool designed for line following applications in robotics. This sensor array consists of 8 infrared (IR) emitter-detector pairs arranged in a row, which can detect the reflectance of surfaces. It is primarily used in robotics for line following, maze solving, and edge detection tasks. The QTR-8RC is capable of providing a digital signal output for each of the 8 sensors, making it ideal for use with microcontrollers.
Key Features of QTR-8RC Line Following Reflectance IR Sensor Array
8 IR Sensors: Features 8 pairs of IR emitters and detectors arranged in a single row.
Digital Output: Provides a digital high/low output indicating reflectance detected by each sensor.
Adjustable Sensitivity: Allows adjustment of sensitivity by modifying the distance between the sensor array and the surface
Compact Design: Small and lightweight, making it easy to integrate into various robotic platforms.
Low Power Consumption: Efficient power usage suitable for battery-operated robots.
Technical Specifications of QTR-8RC Line Following Reflectance IR Sensor Array
Number of Sensors: 8 pairs of IR emitters and detectors
Dimensions: Compact size for easy integration
Response Time: Fast response suitable for high-speed line following
Mechanical Specifications of QTR-8RC Line Following Reflectance IR Sensor Array:
Sensor Arrangement: 8 sensors aligned in a single row
Mounting Holes: Includes holes for secure mounting on robotic platforms
Dimensions: Compact design for seamless integration into robots
Weight: Lightweight construction ideal for mobile robots
Schematic Diagram, Connection, Wiring, and Pinout of QTR-8RC Line Following Reflectance IR Sensor Array
Pin Configuration: Each sensor has a dedicated output pin, along with power and ground pins.
Connection: Connect the sensor array to a microcontroller using the provided pins.
Wiring: Ensure proper wiring for power, ground, and signal connections to the microcontroller.
Datasheet of QTR-8RC Line Following Reflectance IR Sensor Array
For detailed technical specifications and electrical characteristics, refer to the QTR-8RC datasheet.
Applications of QTR-8RC Line Following Reflectance IR Sensor Array
Line Following Robots: Ideal for creating robots that follow lines on a surface.
Maze Solving Robots: Suitable for robots designed to navigate mazes by detecting paths.
Edge Detection: Can be used to detect edges and prevent robots from falling off surfaces.
Position Sensing: Useful in applications where the position of a robot relative to a surface needs to be determined.

name: TEC1-12715 40x40mm Thermoelectric Cooler 15A Peltier Module
desc: TEC1-12715 40x40mm Thermoelectric Cooler 15A Peltier Module Model number: TEC1-12715 Operating Voltage: 12V Maximum Voltage- Umax (V) : 15V Maximum Current- Imax (A) : 15A Maximum Power : 230 W Power Cord: 25cm.

blocks.text: The TEC1-12715 40x40mm Thermoelectric Cooler 15A Peltier Module is the simple application of Peltier Thermoelectric Effect. The module features 127 semiconductor couples in the area of 40mmx40mm.

Thermoelectric coolers also are known as TEC or Peltier Module create a temperature differential on each side. One side gets hot and the other side gets cool. Therefore, they can be used to either warm something up or cool something down, depending on which side you use. You can also take advantage of a temperature differential to generate electricity.

This Peltier works very well as long as you remove the heat from the hot side. After turning on the device, the hot side will heat quickly, the cold side will cool quickly. If you do not remove the heat from the hot side (with a heat sink or other device), the Peltier will quickly reach stasis and do nothing. We recommend using an old computer CPU heatsink or another block of metal to pull heat from the hot side. We were able to use a computer power supply and CPU heatsink to make the cold side so uncomfortable we could not hold our finger to it.

A thermoelectric cooling (TEC) module is a semiconductor-based electronic component that functions as a small heat pump. By applying the DC power source to a TEC, heat will be transferred from one side of the module to the other. It creates a cold and hot side. They are widely used in industrial areas, for example, computer CPU, CCDs, portable refrigerators, medical instruments, and so on.
Also Known as Thermoelectric cooling modules, Thermoelectric modules, Peltier modules, Thermoelectric cooling module.
Do not exceed Imax or Vmax when operating a module.
Please carry out moisture protection options (sealing) in final application use.
Failure rate based on longtime testings: 0.2%.
Important Note!! Heat side requires heat sink all the time. “ Do not run this device with a power supply more than a few seconds without a heatsink mounted to the device! ”
Features of TEC1-12715 40x40mm Thermoelectric Cooler 15A Peltier Module
Easy transition between the hot side to the cool side and vice-versa just by reversing the polarity of the supply.
Should use with a heat sink.

blocks.text: FNIRSI SWM-10 Portable Intelligent Spot Welding Machine with Color Screen and Power Bank Function

The FNIRSI SWM-10 Portable Intelligent Spot Welding Machine is a compact and practical solution for users who need fast, stable, and portable spot welding for battery work. It is designed for battery pack building, nickel strip welding, mobile phone battery repair, cylindrical cell pack assembly, and power bank maintenance, while also offering the added convenience of power bank functionality.

This model uses double-pulse spot welding technology, which helps improve welding stability and firmness. The first pulse helps prepare the welding surface, while the second pulse delivers the main welding energy for a stronger and more consistent weld. The manual also explains adjustable parameters including preheat time, main pulse time, interval time, and number of connection points, allowing the user to fine-tune the welding behavior according to the material and thickness.

The SWM-10 is equipped with a color display that gives a clear view of key operating information such as welding status, battery voltage, temperature, battery level, warning icons, and welding settings. It also shows charging and discharging information when used as a power bank. The interface is designed to make setup and monitoring easier during real work.

With its 5000mAh built-in battery, the device is suitable for field work, workshop use, and mobile battery maintenance tasks. It supports Type-C charging and USB-A output, making it useful not only as a welding machine but also as a portable backup power source for small USB devices.

According to the manual, the SWM-10 can weld nickel sheet, iron sheet, and stainless steel sheet, with a recommended welding thickness of 0.1mm to 0.25mm and a maximum welding current of 1200A. It also includes multiple built-in reminders and protections, including warnings related to over-temperature, low voltage, and short circuit.

This makes the FNIRSI SWM-10 a strong choice for technicians, hobbyists, battery builders, and repair users who need a portable and intelligent spot welding tool with flexible settings and easy operation.

تُعد ماكينة اللحام النقطي المحمولة FNIRSI SWM-10 حلًا عمليًا ومتميزًا لكل من يحتاج إلى جهاز لحام نقطي صغير الحجم وسهل الحمل وقادر على تقديم أداء ثابت في أعمال بناء باكات البطاريات، ولحام شرائط النيكل، وصيانة بطاريات الهواتف، وتجميع الخلايا الأسطوانية، وإصلاح وحدات الباور بانك. كما أنها لا تعمل فقط كماكينة لحام، بل توفر أيضًا وظيفة باور بانك للاستخدام العملي اليومي.

يعتمد هذا الجهاز على تقنية اللحام النبضي المزدوج، وهي تقنية تساعد على جعل اللحام أكثر ثباتًا وقوة. حيث تساهم النبضة الأولى في تهيئة سطح اللحام، بينما تنفذ النبضة الثانية عملية اللحام الأساسية بطاقة مناسبة للحصول على نقطة لحام أكثر إحكامًا واستقرارًا. كما يتيح الجهاز ضبط عدد من الإعدادات المهمة مثل زمن التسخين المسبق، وزمن النبضة الرئيسية، وزمن الفاصل بين النبضات، وعدد نقاط التوصيل المتتابعة، مما يمنح المستخدم مرونة أعلى حسب نوع الشريحة المعدنية وسُمكها.

يأتي SWM-10 مزودًا بشاشة ألوان تعرض بشكل واضح حالة اللحام، وجهد البطارية، ودرجة الحرارة، ومستوى الشحن، والتنبيهات، بالإضافة إلى إعدادات اللحام نفسها. كما تعرض الشاشة معلومات الشحن والتفريغ عند استخدام الجهاز كباور بانك، وهو ما يجعل متابعة حالة الجهاز والإعدادات أسهل أثناء العمل.

يحتوي الجهاز على بطارية داخلية بسعة 5000mAh، مما يجعله مناسبًا للاستخدام في الورشة أو أثناء التنقل أو في أعمال الصيانة الميدانية. ويدعم الشحن عبر Type-C بالإضافة إلى خرج USB-A، لذلك يمكن استخدامه أيضًا كمصدر طاقة متنقل لشحن بعض الأجهزة الصغيرة عبر USB.

وبحسب الدليل، يمكن للجهاز لحام شرائح النيكل، والحديد، والاستانلس ستيل، مع سماكة لحام مناسبة من 0.1 مم إلى 0.25 مم، وبأقصى تيار لحام يصل إلى 1200 أمبير. كما يتضمن الجهاز تنبيهات وحمايات ذكية مرتبطة بـ ارتفاع الحرارة، وانخفاض الجهد، والقصر الكهربائي، مما يساعد على تحسين الأمان أثناء التشغيل.
لذلك تعتبر FNIRSI SWM-10 اختيارًا مناسبًا جدًا للفنيين والهواة ومن يقومون ببناء وصيانة بطاريات الليثيوم، خاصة لمن يريدون ماكينة لحام نقطي محمولة، ذكية، سهلة الضبط، وعملية في الاستخدام.

blocks.text: BMS 3S 8A Lithium Battery Protection Board for 18650 Cells 11.1V / 12.6V BMS

The 3S 8A Lithium Battery Protection Board is a compact and practical BMS module designed for 3-cell lithium-ion battery packs using cells such as 18650, 26650, and similar 3.6V / 3.7V lithium cells. It is used to protect the battery pack during charging and discharging, helping improve safety and battery life in portable and DIY power projects.

This board is suitable for 3S battery configurations, where three lithium cells are connected in series to form an 11.1V nominal pack with a 12.6V fully charged voltage. It provides essential protection functions including overcharge protection, over-discharge protection, overcurrent protection, and short-circuit protection with automatic recovery.

Its compact triangular PCB design makes it easy to install in custom battery packs, portable power solutions, backup battery systems, DIY electronics, and rechargeable lithium projects. The module is especially useful for makers and technicians building battery-powered devices that require stable cell protection and balanced safety operation.

This protection board is intended for lithium-ion battery packs only and should be used with the correct charger and proper pack wiring. For best performance, the board should be installed carefully with correct B+, B1, B2, B- battery connections and P+ / P- charge-discharge terminals.

يأتي هذا الموديل بتصميم يثبت على الرأس مع حزام قابل للضبط، مما يساعد على ارتدائه بشكل مريح وثابت أثناء الاستخدام لفترات أطول. كما يحتوي على إضاءة ليد مدمجة تساعد على تحسين الرؤية في الأماكن ذات الإضاءة الضعيفة وتوجّه الضوء مباشرة إلى منطقة العمل، مما يسهل رؤية التفاصيل الدقيقة بشكل أفضل.

يحتوي المنتج على عدة عدسات قابلة للتبديل، بحيث يمكن اختيار درجة التكبير المناسبة حسب نوع المهمة المطلوبة. وهذا يجعله مناسبًا لمجموعة واسعة من الاستخدامات، بداية من الفحص العام وحتى الأعمال الدقيقة التي تحتاج إلى رؤية أوضح وأقرب. كما يمكن ضبط زاوية العدسة لتحسين وضع الرؤية أثناء العمل، إلى جانب إمكانية تعديل مقاس الحزام ليتناسب مع المستخدم.

تم تصنيع المنتج من مواد عملية تشمل بلاستيك قوي وعدسات شفافة وأجزاء ضبط معدنية، ليقدم توازنًا جيدًا بين المتانة وسهولة الاستخدام. لذلك فهو مناسب للهواة والفنيين والعاملين في الصيانة، وكذلك لمن يقومون بأعمال دقيقة تحتاج إلى تكبير وإضاءة في نفس الوقت.

desc: A DIY 4DOF acrylic robot arm kit with unassembled chassis, screw set, and 4 SG90 180° servo motors, available in transparent and black colors, ideal for robotics learning, Arduino projects, and motion control experiments. طقم ذراع روبوت أكريليك DIY بعدد 4 درجات حركة، يأتي غير مُركب ويشمل الشاسية، طقم المسامير، و4 سيرفو SG90 بزاوية 180 درجة، ومتوفر باللونين الشفاف والأسود، ومناسب للتعليم ومشروعات الأردوينو والروبوتات.

blocks.text: DIY Acrylic 4DOF Robot Arm Kit with 4× SG90 180° Servo Motors – Transparent / Black

The DIY Acrylic 4DOF Robot Arm Kit is a practical and educational robotic arm set designed for students, makers, hobbyists, and robotics enthusiasts who want to build and understand a functional robotic manipulator from scratch. This kit offers a compact and mechanical arm structure with 4 degrees of freedom, allowing the arm to move through multiple axes for grabbing, lifting, positioning, and basic pick-and-place style movements.

The arm structure is made from precision laser-cut acrylic parts, giving the kit a clean appearance, lightweight body, and good mechanical flexibility for educational and experimental use. It is available in two color options: Transparent and Black, so the customer can choose the version that best matches the project style or preferred appearance.

This kit comes with the mechanical chassis unassembled, which makes it ideal for learning how robotic arm systems are built and how each joint interacts mechanically with the others. The package includes the acrylic body parts, a complete screw set, and 4 pieces of SG90 180° servo motors required to move the arm joints and gripper mechanism.

With its 4DOF structure, the robotic arm can perform several interesting movements such as base rotation, arm lifting, forearm motion, and gripper opening and closing. This makes it suitable for training, demonstrations, school projects, STEM activities, Arduino-based robotics experiments, and introductory automation concepts.

This kit is especially useful as a hands-on introduction to robotics, mechanics, servo control, and motion coordination. It helps users understand joint motion, arm geometry, assembly sequencing, and mechanical design. It can also be expanded later with a controller board, Arduino, joystick module, or custom programming setup depending on the intended application.

This kit is delivered unassembled, and correct assembly is very important for smooth motion and proper servo alignment. The assembly guide included in the reference material starts with checking the kit components, then building the base, installing the first servo, assembling the left and right arms, integrating the arm with the chassis, adding the intermediate support, fixing the arm onto the base, installing the bearing rod, mounting the final servo, assembling the clamp/gripper, and finally arranging the servo wiring.

A key point during assembly is servo angle calibration before tightening the acrylic parts. The guide repeatedly highlights that some servo positions must be adjusted before final fixing, especially in the left arm, right arm, base integration, and clamp steps, to ensure the arm rotates freely and the gripper opens and closes correctly. The document also warns that the servo body can be very close to the acrylic, so screws should be tightened carefully to avoid cracking the parts.

يُعد طقم ذراع الروبوت الأكريليك 4 درجات حركة خيارًا ممتازًا للطلاب والهواة وصناع المشاريع وكل من يريد الدخول إلى عالم الروبوتات بشكل عملي وممتع. هذا الطقم يتيح لك بناء ذراع روبوت ميكانيكي من الصفر، مع تصميم مدمج وعملي يوفر 4 درجات حركة تسمح للذراع بالتحرك في أكثر من اتجاه لتنفيذ حركات مثل الرفع والخفض والدوران والفتح والغلق.

تم تصنيع أجزاء الذراع من الأكريليك المقطوع بدقة بالليزر، مما يمنح المنتج شكلًا مرتبًا ووزنًا خفيفًا ومناسبة جيدة للتطبيقات التعليمية والتجارب العملية. كما يتوفر المنتج بلونين: شفاف وأسود، بحيث يمكن للعميل اختيار اللون المناسب حسب شكل المشروع أو التفضيل الشخصي.

يأتي هذا المنتج على هيئة كت غير مُركب، وهذه نقطة مهمة جدًا لأنها تجعل المنتج مناسبًا للتعلم العملي وفهم طريقة بناء الذراع الميكانيكي، وكيفية تركيب كل جزء، وكيفية تفاعل المفاصل مع بعضها. ويشمل الطقم الشاسية والأجزاء الأكريليك غير مركبة بالإضافة إلى طقم المسامير وعدد 4 سيرفو SG90 بزاوية 180 درجة اللازمة لتحريك المفاصل والماسك الأمامي.

بفضل تصميم 4 DOF، يستطيع الذراع تنفيذ عدة حركات أساسية مثل دوران القاعدة، ورفع الذراع، وتحريك الجزء الأمامي، وفتح وغلق الكلاب أو الماسك. وهذا يجعله مناسبًا للمشروعات التعليمية، وتجارب الأردوينو، وتطبيقات التحكم في السيرفو، والعروض العملية، ومفاهيم الحركة والالتقاط والنقل البسيط.

blocks.text: DRV8825 Stepper Motor Driver with Aluminum Heat Sink
The DRV8825 Stepper Motor Driver with Aluminum Heat Sink is a breakout board for TI’s DRV8825 microstepping bipolar stepper motor driver.

The module has a pinout and interface that are nearly identical to those of the stepper motor driver carriers, so it can be used as a higher-performance drop-in replacement for those boards in many applications.

The features adjustable current limiting, overcurrent, and overtemperature protection, and six microstep resolutions (down to 1/32-step). It operates from 8.2 – 45 V and can deliver up to approximately 1.5 A per phase without a heat sink or forced air flow (rated for up to 2.2 A per coil with sufficient additional cooling).
Simple step and direction control interface
Six different step resolutions: full-step, half-step, 1/4-step, 1/8-step, 1/16-step, and 1/32-step
Adjustable current control lets you set the maximum current output with a potentiometer. Hence lets you use voltages above your stepper motor’s rated voltage to achieve higher step rates
Intelligent chopping control that automatically selects the correct current decay mode (fast decay or slow decay)
Built-in regulator (no external logic voltage supply needed)
Can interface directly with 3.3 V and 5 V systems
Over-temperature thermal shutdown, over-current shutdown, and under-voltage lockout
4-layer, 2 oz copper PCB for improved heat dissipation
Exposed solderable ground pad below the driver IC on the bottom of the PCB

blocks.text: Relay 8 Channel 5V Module with Optocoupler Isolation – 10A Relay Board for Arduino, Raspberry Pi & Automation

The 8 Channel 5V Relay Module with Optocoupler Isolation is a practical and powerful interface board used to switch multiple electrical loads safely through low-voltage control systems. It is designed for makers, students, engineers, technicians, and automation developers who need an easy and dependable way to control relays from popular development boards and embedded systems.

This module provides 8 independent relay outputs, allowing a single control board to manage several devices at the same time. It can be driven directly by many microcontroller platforms such as Arduino, Raspberry Pi, AVR, PIC, ARM, and STM32 boards, making it suitable for both educational and professional applications.

One of the major advantages of this board is its optocoupler isolation, which helps separate the control side from the relay power side. This improves safety, reduces electrical interference, and helps protect sensitive controller circuits from noise and switching disturbances. Because of this, the module is well-suited for automation systems where stable and secure switching is important.

Each relay channel supports a load of up to 10A at 250VAC or 10A at 30VDC, making this board suitable for a wide range of switching applications including lighting control, motors, pumps, solenoids, fans, alarms, home automation devices, and other electrical equipment. The board uses low-level triggering, which makes it easy to activate each relay using standard digital outputs from 3.3V or 5V logic systems.

The module is also equipped with status indicator LEDs for each channel, allowing the user to monitor relay activity quickly during testing and operation. The onboard JD-VCC jumper gives flexibility in relay coil power configuration, while the standard 2.54mm pin spacing allows convenient connection using jumper wires and development cables.

This 5V 8 channel relay board is an excellent choice for users building smart switching circuits, industrial test systems, home control panels, automated prototypes, learning projects, and multi-load control applications where reliable isolation and simple wiring are required.

من أهم مميزات هذه اللوحة أنها مزودة بعزل ضوئي Optocoupler، وهو ما يساعد على فصل دائرة التحكم عن دائرة تشغيل الريليه. هذا الفصل يقلل من تأثير التشويش الكهربائي ويحسن مستوى الأمان ويحمي دوائر التحكم الحساسة من الإشارات غير المرغوبة أو تأثير الأحمال أثناء التشغيل والفصل.

blocks.text: XH W1209 12V Digital Temperature Controller Module W/ Display and NTC Temp Sensor
This is XH W1209 12V Digital Temperature Controller Module W/ Display and NTC Temp Sensor.

W1209 Mini thermostat Temperature controller is low-cost 12V Temperature controller with 7-segment display and 3 switch keypad for setting temperature and other parameters. The module features an NTC thermistor temperature sensing and has an accuracy of 0.1 C.

The XH W1209 digital temperature controller Module W/ Display and NTC Waterproof Temperature Sensor is an incredibly low cost yet highly functional thermostat controller. With this module, you can intelligently control power to most types of electrical devices based on the temperature sensed by the included high accuracy NTC temperature sensor.
We can display the current temperature in degrees Centigrade via its 3 digits seven-segment display and the current relay state by an onboard LED.
The thermostat will display the current temperature in °C by default. When in any other mode making no input for approximately 5 seconds will cause the thermostat to return to this default display.

To set the trigger temperature press the button marked ‘SET’. The seven-segment display will flash. You can now set a trigger temperature (in °C) using the ‘+’ and ‘-‘ buttons in 0.1° increments. If we didn’t press any buttons for approximately 2 seconds the trigger temperature will be store and the display will return back to the current temperature.

To set any parameter first long press the ‘SET’ button for at least 5 seconds. The seven-segment display should now display ‘P0’. This represents parameter P0. Pressing the ‘+’ or ‘-‘ buttons will cycle through the various parameters (P0 to P6). Pressing the ‘SET’ button whilst any of these parameters are displayed will allow you to change the value for that parameter using the ‘+’ and ‘-‘ buttons. When finished setting a parameter press the set button to exit that option. If no buttons are pressed for approximately 5 seconds the thermostat will exit the parameter options and will return back to the default temperature display.
Setting the cooling or heating parameter P0

The parameter P0 has two settings, C and H. When setting to C (default) the relay will energize when the temperature is reached. Use this setting if connecting to an air-conditioning system. When set to H the relay will de-energize when the temperature is reached. Use this setting if controlling a heating device.

This sets how much change in temperature must occur before the relay will change state. For example, if set to the default 2oC and the trigger temperature has been set to 25oC, it will not de-energize until the temperature falls back below 23oC. Setting this hysteresis helps stop the thermostat from continually triggering when the temperature drifts around the trip temperature.
Setting the upper limit of the thermostat parameter P2
This parameter limits the maximum trigger temperature that can be set. It is useful as a safety to stop an excessively high trigger temperature from accidentally being set by the user.
Setting the lower limit of the thermostat parameter P3
This parameter limits the minimum trigger temperature that can be set. It is useful as a safety to stop an excessively low trigger temperature from accidentally being set by the user.
Setting temperature offset correction parameter P4

Should you find there is a difference between the displayed temperature and the actual temperature; (for instance, if the temperature probe is on a long run of cable) you can make minor corrections to the temperature reading with this parameter.
Setting the trigger delay parameter P5
To reach trigger temperature this parameter allows for delaying switching of the relay. The parameter can be set in one-minute increments up to a maximum of 10 minutes.
Setting the high-temperature alarm parameter P6

Setting a value for this parameter will cause the relay to switch off when the temperature reaches this setting. The seven-segment display will also show ‘—‘ to indicate an alarm condition. The relay will not re-energize until the temperature falls below this value. The default setting is OFF.
Note: The 12v relay module may differ in the manufacturer’s name & type from the image.

blocks.text: DC 5.5×2.1mm Male Power Plug to 2-Pin Screw Terminal Adapter for CCTV Camera & DC Wiring

The DC 5.5×2.1mm Male Power Plug to 2-Pin Screw Terminal Adapter is a simple and highly useful solution for DC power connections in electronics, surveillance systems, LED installations, and low-voltage power applications. It is designed to provide a clean, professional, and secure way to connect bare wires directly to devices or boards that use a standard 5.5×2.1mm DC power jack.

This adapter combines a 2.1mm male DC barrel plug with a 2-pin screw terminal block, making it ideal for quick wiring jobs where soldering is not desired. One side plugs directly into a compatible DC power jack, while the other side allows easy connection of stripped wires using a small screwdriver. This makes installation faster, cleaner, and more convenient for technicians, makers, and installers.

The screw terminal side is clearly intended for positive and negative wire connection, based on the common center-positive DC configuration used by most CCTV cameras, LED devices, development boards, and low-voltage electronics. This helps reduce wiring mistakes and makes the adapter especially practical for quick field installation, maintenance work, prototyping, and test setups.

This adapter is a very useful choice if you need to connect a battery pack, DC power supply, or bare power wires to a board that has a DC input jack. It is commonly used with CCTV cameras, LED light strips, Arduino-compatible boards, development boards, routers, access control devices, and many other electronic systems that use a 5.5×2.1mm barrel jack.

One of the biggest advantages of this connector is that it eliminates the need for electrical tape, splicing, crimping, or soldering, while still providing a firm and dependable connection. It also has a compact body with plastic construction and basic strain relief, helping improve durability during normal use.

Its small size and easy screw-terminal design make it a practical accessory for workshops, repair benches, field installation kits, and educational electronics projects. Whether you are building a custom DC power cable, testing a circuit, or powering a module from a wired supply, this adapter provides a neat and effective solution.

يُعد محول جاك طاقة دي سي ذكر 5.5×2.1 مم إلى طرفين بمسمار من الحلول العملية جدًا لتوصيل الطاقة في الأنظمة الإلكترونية، وكاميرات المراقبة، وشرائط الإضاءة، والتطبيقات منخفضة الجهد. تم تصميم هذا المحول ليمنح المستخدم طريقة سهلة ومرتبة وآمنة لتوصيل الأسلاك العارية مباشرة مع الأجهزة أو اللوحات التي تحتوي على مدخل طاقة من المقاس القياسي 5.5×2.1 مم.

يجمع هذا المنتج بين فيشة طاقة ذكر مقاس 2.1 مم وبين طرفين تثبيت بمسمار، مما يجعله مناسبًا لأعمال التوصيل السريع التي لا تحتاج إلى لحام. يتم توصيل أحد الطرفين مباشرة بمدخل الطاقة المناسب، بينما يتم تثبيت الأسلاك في الجهة الأخرى بسهولة باستخدام مفك صغير، وهو ما يوفر وقتًا وجهدًا أثناء التركيب.

تم تصميم طرفي التوصيل لربط الموجب والسالب بطريقة واضحة، وفق التوصيل الشائع الذي يكون فيه الطرف الأوسط موجبًا، وهو النظام المستخدم في كثير من كاميرات المراقبة، وشرائط الإضاءة، ولوحات التطوير، ومشاريع التغذية المستمرة. وهذا يساعد على تقليل أخطاء التوصيل ويجعل القطعة مناسبة جدًا لأعمال التركيب السريع والصيانة والاختبار.

blocks.text: DC 5.5×2.1mm Female Power Jack to 2-Pin Screw Terminal Adapter for CCTV Camera & Power Wiring

The DC 5.5×2.1mm Female Power Jack to 2-Pin Screw Terminal Adapter is a simple yet highly useful connector for anyone working with CCTV systems, DC power supplies, LED devices, small electronics, or custom power cabling. It is designed to make DC wiring easier, faster, and more professional, especially in installations where reliability and clean cable routing matter.

This adapter combines a standard 5.5×2.1mm female barrel jack with a 2-pin screw terminal block, making it easy to connect bare wires directly to devices or boards that require a DC barrel connection. Instead of soldering wires or using complicated connector assemblies, you can simply insert the wire into the screw terminal side and tighten it securely with a small screwdriver.

The screw terminal side is clearly intended for positive and negative wire connection, which helps simplify installation and reduce wiring mistakes. This makes the adapter especially useful in CCTV camera setups, surveillance systems, LED strip installations, prototype electronics, DC-powered modules, and low-voltage bench applications.

If you need to connect a battery pack, DC adapter, power distribution line, or wired power source to a board or module that uses a DC jack, this connector offers a clean and efficient solution. It is also very helpful for test setups, temporary installations, troubleshooting, and maintenance work where quick wire termination is needed.

One of the biggest advantages of this adapter is that it eliminates the need for electrical tape, wire splicing, crimping tools, or soldering, saving time during installation while still providing a secure and stable connection. Its compact shape and professional appearance make it suitable for both field installations and workshop use.

The 5.5×2.1mm female DC power jack adapter is widely used in CCTV camera power wiring because this connector size is one of the most common standards in security systems and low-voltage electronics. It can also be used in breadboard power experiments, DIY electronics, routers, LED drivers, access control devices, and many other DC-powered systems requiring quick terminal-based connection.

Whether you are installing a security camera, building a custom power cable, or creating a simple power input adapter for an electronics project, this connector is a convenient, reusable, and dependable choice.

blocks.text: 12x12x7.3mm 4 Pin Tactile Push Button Switch – Through-Hole Momentary Square Key

The 12x12x7.3mm 4 Pin Tactile Push Button Switch is a dependable momentary push switch widely used in electronic projects as a standard input button. It is designed for applications that require a compact, responsive, and durable switch for manual user control. With its through-hole mounting design, this switch is especially suitable for direct PCB installation and can also be used in prototype setups during testing and development.

This tactile switch features a 4-pin configuration and a square actuator shaft, offering a stable mechanical structure and convenient integration into a wide range of electronic designs. The switch operates with a momentary push-to-on function, meaning the contacts remain normally open and close only while the button is pressed. This makes it an excellent choice for reset buttons, menu buttons, user input keys, control interfaces, and temporary signal triggering in many devices.

One of the key advantages of this switch is its strong tactile response, which gives the user a clear and precise pressing feel. Its design supports a relatively high operating force, making it suitable for applications where a firmer press is preferred. Despite that, it still delivers smooth and accurate operation with a middle stroke of 1.05mm, helping improve user control and repeatability.

The switch is also built for long-term performance, with a mechanical and electrical life of up to 300,000 cycles, making it a practical option for products that require frequent use. Its compact size of 12mm × 12mm × 7.3mm allows easy use in dense circuit layouts without occupying excessive space.

This push button switch is commonly used in consumer electronics, telecommunications devices, test equipment, industrial controls, medical devices, home appliances, audio systems, and computer peripherals. It also works very well in educational electronics, Arduino-compatible control projects, repair tasks, and general circuit design applications.

The contacts are designed to provide good electrical conductivity, low contact resistance, and stable signal transmission. Its compact body, lightweight structure, and easy mounting style make it an efficient component for both professional and hobby electronics work.

blocks.text: IIC/I2C Serial Interface Adapter Module pcf8574 HW-061

This is a RoHS compliant I2C Serial LCD Daughter board that can be connected to a standard 16×2 or 20×4 Character Display Module that supports 4-bit mode. All Character Modules sold on our site support 4-bit mode, and nearly all commercially available 16×2 and 20×4 line character modules support it too.

This board has a PCF8574 I2C chip that converts I2C serial data to parallel data for the LCD display. There are many examples on the internet for using this board with Arduino. Do a search for “Arduino LCD PCF8574“. The I2C address is 0x3F by default, but this can be changed via 3 solder jumpers provided on the board. This allows up to 3 LCD displays to be controlled via a single I2C bus (giving each one it’s own address)

blocks.text: Arduino Nano CH340 – Soldered Pins, Mini USB Without USB Cable
The Nano CH340 Chip Board Chip without USB Cable chipboard is based on the famous Arduino platform and does all the functions of Uno, but with a smaller footprint.
The Nano equips a low-cost USB-Serial Chip that makes it less in price than Nano with FTDI USB-Serial Chip used on older versions of Arduino Nano.

The Nano is a small, complete, and breadboard-friendly board based on the ATmega328 (Arduino Nano R3). It has more or less the same functionality as the Arduino Uno but in a different package. It lacks only a DC power jack and works with a Mini-B USB cable instead of a standard one.

The Nano can be powered via the mini-USB connection, 6-20V unregulated external power supply (pin 30), or 5V regulated external power supply (pin 27). The power source is automatically selected to the highest voltage source.
The size of Nano V3.0 with CH340 Chip is only 43 mm x 18 mm; it comes with 6 PWM I/O from the total of 14 digitals I/O, 8 analog inputs, 16Mhz clock speed and 32kB of flash memory.

blocks.text: USB 2.0 Type-A to Type-C Cable 30CM for Data Transfer and Charging
Compact USB Type-A to Type-C Cable for Daily Use and Embedded Projects

The USB 2.0 Type-A to Type-C Cable 30CM is a practical short-length cable designed for reliable charging and data transfer between USB-A hosts and USB-C devices. It is an excellent choice for electronics workbenches, development environments, compact desktop setups, and portable applications where a long cable is unnecessary.

With its 30CM length, this cable is especially useful in situations that require a neat and organized connection. It helps reduce cable clutter around laptops, power banks, USB chargers, test benches, and embedded systems. The short form also makes it suitable for close-range device linking, such as connecting a microcontroller board to a computer or powering a device from a nearby adapter.
Designed for Charging and USB 2.0 Data Communication

This cable supports USB 2.0 communication, making it suitable for general-purpose connectivity tasks such as device setup, data exchange, firmware uploading, serial communication, and stable charging. It provides a data transfer rate of up to 480Mbps, which is appropriate for many development boards, USB-C peripherals, and everyday devices.

The USB Type-A male connector is compatible with common laptop and desktop USB ports, wall chargers, USB hubs, and power banks. On the other side, the USB Type-C connector is designed for modern electronic devices that use the reversible USB-C interface.
Ideal for Development Boards and Compact Electronic Setups

This cable is particularly convenient for connecting boards and modules that use a USB Type-C port for programming or power input. It is well suited for electronics hobbyists, technicians, students, and developers who need a short cable for bench work or embedded projects.
Connecting development boards to laptops or desktop computers
Powering USB-C electronic modules from a USB adapter
Charging smartphones, tablets, and small USB-C devices
Uploading code or firmware to compatible boards
Data communication with USB-C enabled devices
Creating tidy cable routing in compact spaces
Short Cable Design for Better Cable Management

One of the biggest advantages of this 30CM USB Type-A to Type-C cable is its compact size. In close-range installations, long cables can create unnecessary mess, tangling, or extra bending. This short cable helps maintain a cleaner workspace and is more practical for portable electronics kits, control boxes, power distribution setups, and product testing stations.

Based on the product image, the cable features a standard USB-A connector on one side and a USB Type-C connector on the other side, with a flexible blue outer jacket. The transparent molded connector housing gives the cable a distinctive technical appearance while also showing part of the internal wiring structure. This makes it visually suitable for workshop, maker, and prototyping environments.
Reliable Choice for General USB-C Connectivity

Whether you need a compact cable for charging, syncing, powering a development board, or linking a USB-C device to a computer, this cable offers a simple and practical solution. Its short length, standard interface combination, and support for common USB 2.0 tasks make it a useful accessory in many electronic and everyday applications.

كابل يو اس بي من النوع القياسي إيه إلى تايب سي بطول 30 سم للشحن ونقل البيانات
كابل قصير عملي لتوصيل أجهزة تايب سي بسهولة

يُعد كابل يو اس بي من النوع القياسي إيه إلى تايب سي بطول 30 سم خيارًا مناسبًا للتوصيل السريع والمرتب بين الأجهزة الحديثة التي تعمل بمنفذ تايب سي وبين أجهزة الكمبيوتر، اللابتوب، الشواحن، أو وحدات التغذية التي تعتمد على منفذ يو اس بي القياسي. وهو كابل عملي للاستخدام اليومي وكذلك لمشروعات الإلكترونيات والتجارب العملية التي تتطلب توصيلًا قريب المدى دون الحاجة إلى كابل طويل.

الطول القصير لهذا الكابل يجعله مثاليًا للأماكن الضيقة أو بيئات العمل التي تحتاج إلى ترتيب جيد للأسلاك، مثل طاولات التجارب، صناديق المشاريع، أنظمة التحكم الصغيرة، أو عند استخدام الباور بنك بالقرب من الجهاز.

يدعم هذا الكابل معيار يو اس بي 2.0، ولذلك يمكن استخدامه في الشحن وكذلك نقل البيانات بين الأجهزة المتوافقة. كما يدعم سرعة نقل بيانات تصل إلى 480 ميجابت في الثانية، وهي سرعة مناسبة للاستخدامات الشائعة مثل توصيل لوحات التطوير، رفع البرامج، تبادل الملفات، أو تشغيل الاتصال التسلسلي مع بعض الدوائر واللوحات الإلكترونية.

من جهة، يأتي الكابل بموصل يو اس بي القياسي إيه ليتوافق مع منافذ الكمبيوترات، الشواحن، وحدات التغذية، وموزعات يو اس بي. ومن الجهة الأخرى، يأتي بموصل تايب سي المناسب للعديد من الأجهزة الإلكترونية الحديثة.
مثالي للوحات التطوير والأجهزة الإلكترونية الحديثة

هذا الكابل مناسب جدًا لتوصيل اللوحات التي تعتمد على منفذ تايب سي سواء للطاقة أو للبرمجة أو لنقل البيانات. لذلك فهو خيار جيد للهواة والمهندسين والطلاب والفنيين الذين يحتاجون إلى كابل قصير وعملي أثناء التطوير أو الاختبار.

رفع الأكواد والبرامج إلى اللوحات المتوافقة
الحفاظ على ترتيب الأسلاك داخل أماكن العمل الصغيرة

من أهم مميزات هذا المنتج أن طوله 30 سم فقط، وهذا يجعله مناسبًا جدًا عند الحاجة إلى توصيل قريب بين جهازين دون وجود طول زائد يسبب تشابكًا أو مظهرًا غير مرتب. لذلك فهو مناسب لصناديق المشاريع، الطاولات التقنية، تجهيزات الاختبار، والدوائر التي تحتاج إلى توصيل مباشر وقريب.

blocks.text: DC 10A PWM Motor Speed Controller Low Voltage Adjustable Drive Module
Mini PWM DC Motor Speed Controller & LED Dimmer 5V–16V 10A

The Mini PWM DC Motor Speed Controller & LED Dimmer 5V–16V 10A is a small yet powerful control module designed for low-voltage DC applications that require stable and adjustable output. Using PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) technology, this module allows smooth control of DC motor speed as well as LED brightness, making it a practical choice for makers, technicians, and electronics developers.

Its compact PCB layout makes it especially suitable for projects where installation space is limited. Based on the dimensions visible in the product photos, the board measures approximately 30mm × 20mm × 14mm, making it easy to integrate into enclosures, robot platforms, compact control panels, and custom electronic assemblies.

The built-in rotary potentiometer offers convenient manual control. Turning the knob clockwise powers the module on and increases the output gradually, allowing nearly stepless regulation from a very low duty cycle up to almost full output. This makes it useful in applications where fine tuning is important, such as:
Mini drill or low-voltage motor control
Custom control panels and embedded systems
Designed for DC Motors and Compatible LED Dimming

This PWM controller is primarily intended for DC motor speed regulation, but it can also be used as an LED dimmer when the LED load is suitable for direct PWM-based control. It performs efficiently while minimizing unnecessary power loss, helping improve performance compared to simple resistive dimming methods.

For LED use, the connected light source must be compatible with the input voltage and control method. In some LED applications, a current-limiting resistor or proper LED driver arrangement may still be required depending on the LED type and wiring design.

This module supports an input voltage range from 5V DC to 16V DC, which makes it suitable for many low-voltage systems such as 6V, 9V, 12V, and some 15V DC setups. It can handle up to 10A continuous current under proper conditions, with a short peak current up to 20A for less than 10 seconds.

With a maximum efficiency up to 98%, the module is designed to provide effective power control with reduced heat generation compared to less efficient adjustment methods. This is especially useful in compact electronics where thermal performance matters.

From the markings shown on the module, the screw terminal block is arranged for simple connection between the power supply input and the load output. The board labeling helps identify positive and negative wiring for both sides, making installation easier for hobby and workshop use. A mounting hole design is also included for convenient fixing inside a project box or panel.

متحكم سرعة محرك تيار مستمر PWM صغير 5 فولت إلى 16 فولت 10 أمبير مع ديمر إضاءة

يُعد متحكم سرعة محرك تيار مستمر PWM صغير 5 فولت إلى 16 فولت 10 أمبير مع ديمر إضاءة من الوحدات العملية المناسبة للمشروعات التي تحتاج إلى تحكم مرن وثابت في خرج القدرة. تعتمد هذه الوحدة على تقنية تعديل عرض النبضة، وهي طريقة فعالة تسمح بتغيير سرعة المحرك أو درجة سطوع الإضاءة بشكل سلس مع كفاءة عالية.

يمتاز المنتج بحجمه الصغير، حيث توضح الصور أن أبعاد اللوحة تقارب 30 × 20 × 14 مم، مما يجعله مناسبًا جدًا للتركيب داخل العلب الصغيرة، وحدات التحكم المدمجة، أنظمة الروبوت، ولوحات التجارب والمشروعات التعليمية.

تحتوي الوحدة على مقاومة متغيرة دوارة تسمح بالتحكم اليدوي المباشر. عند تدوير المقبض في اتجاه الفتح تبدأ الوحدة في العمل، ثم يمكن زيادة الخرج تدريجيًا حتى الوصول إلى مستوى مرتفع من السرعة أو الإضاءة. هذا يجعلها مناسبة للتطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى تحكم مرن مثل:
التحكم في محركات التيار المستمر منخفضة الجهد
خفض أو رفع شدة إضاءة شرائط الإضاءة
مناسبة للمحركات ويمكن استخدامها مع الإضاءة

هذه الوحدة مصممة أساسًا للتحكم في سرعة محركات التيار المستمر، كما يمكن استخدامها كذلك في التحكم في شدة الإضاءة عند توصيل حمل ضوئي مناسب لطريقة التشغيل. وتوفر هذه التقنية أداءً أكثر كفاءة من طرق التحكم التقليدية التي تعتمد على فقد القدرة في صورة حرارة.
وعند استخدامها مع الإضاءة، يجب التأكد من أن مصدر الإضاءة مناسب للجهد المستخدم وطريقة التحكم. بعض أنواع الإضاءة قد تحتاج إلى مقاومة تحديد تيار أو دائرة تشغيل مناسبة حسب نوع الحمل وطريقة التوصيل.

If you want to add some visual output to your Arduino projects, you’ll need a display. If you need only little to display, the LCD1602 Parallel LCD Display with IIC/I2C interface is a quite good solution.

This is LCD1602 Parallel LCD Display that provides a simple and cost-effective solution for adding a 16×2 White on RGB Liquid Crystal Display into your project. The display is 16 character by 2 line display has a very clear and high contrast white text upon a blue background/backlight.

This is great blue backlight LCD display. It is fantastic for Arduino based project. This LCD1602 Parallel LCD Display with Yellow Backlight is very easy to interface with Arduino or Other Microcontrollers.

This display overcomes the drawback of LCD1602 Parallel LCD Display in which you’ll waste about 8 Pins on your Arduino for the display to get working. Luckily in this product, an I2C adapter is directly soldered right onto the pins of the display. So all you need to connect are the I2C pins, which shows a good library and little of coding.

The I2C is a type of serial bus developed by Philips, which uses two bidirectional lines, called SDA (Serial Data Line) and SCL (Serial Clock Line). Both must be connected via pulled-up resistors. The usage voltages are standard as 5V and 3.3V.

If you already have the I2C adapter soldered onto the board like in this product, the wiring is quite easy. You should usually have only four pins to hook up. VCC and GND of course. The LCD display works with 5 Volts. So we go for the 5V Pin.
The values shown on the display can be either a simple text or numerical values read by the sensors, such as temperature or pressure, or even the number of cycles that the Arduino is performing.

blocks.text: The CD4017 Decade Counter IC DIP-16 is a CMOS decade counter and decoded output integrated circuit designed for counting, sequencing, pulse distribution, and timing control in digital electronics projects. This device is widely used in LED chaser circuits, sequential switching applications, event counting systems, timer-based designs, and logic control circuits where a simple one-by-one output sequence is needed.

The CD4017 Decade Counter IC DIP-16 provides ten decoded outputs labeled from Q0 to Q9. With every valid clock pulse, the active output advances to the next output in sequence. This makes the IC an excellent choice for designers who need clean sequential logic without using a microcontroller. Because only one output is active at a time, the device is especially useful in running light effects, step-by-step control systems, and pulse counting applications.

This counter IC includes an enable input, a reset input, and a carry-out pin for cascading. The clock enable pin allows the current count to be held without losing the output state, while the reset pin returns the counter to the initial output. The carry-out function makes the IC suitable for multi-stage counting systems when more than ten steps are required. These features make the CD4017 Decade Counter IC DIP-16 a practical solution for both educational electronics and professional circuit design.

Built with CMOS technology, the IC supports low power consumption and a wide operating voltage range, making it suitable for battery-powered circuits, breadboard experiments, embedded control designs, and general-purpose digital applications. It is available in a through-hole DIP-16 package, which is convenient for prototyping, PCB assembly, and repair work.

blocks.text: TMC2208 V1.2 Silent Stepper Motor Driver Module with Heat Sink and Screwdriver
TMC2208 V1.2 Silent Stepper Motor Driver Module

The TMC2208 V1.2 Silent Stepper Motor Driver Module is a high-performance two-phase stepper motor driver designed for applications where quiet operation, smooth movement, and precise motor control are essential. It is widely used in 3D printers, CNC machines, robotics systems, and embedded motion control projects thanks to its advanced silent driving technology and compact Stepstick-compatible form factor.

One of the main advantages of the TMC2208 is its ultra-quiet motor control capability, making it an ideal choice for machines that need reduced acoustic noise during operation. This makes it especially popular in 3D printing systems, where silent performance and smoother stepper motion significantly improve the user experience.

The driver supports both Step/Dir control and UART configuration, giving users flexibility in basic installation as well as advanced tuning and adjustment. It also features MicroPlyer interpolation, allowing smoother motion by interpolating lower step resolutions up to 1/256 microstepping, which helps improve motor smoothness even when the controller pulse frequency is limited.

With support for a wide motor voltage range and practical current handling, the TMC2208 offers a balanced solution for many small and medium motion control systems. The included heat sink helps improve thermal performance, while the screwdriver makes current adjustment and setup easier during installation.
This module is a practical upgrade for users replacing older stepper drivers in order to achieve quieter movement, better precision, and improved driving quality in compatible systems.

blocks.text: 74190 Up Down Decade Counter IC DIP-16

The 74190 Up Down Decade Counter IC DIP-16 is a synchronous BCD decade counter designed for digital counting, sequencing, control logic, and timing applications. This integrated circuit can count both upward and downward through the standard BCD sequence, making it a practical choice for numeric counting circuits, presettable counters, frequency division stages, and digital control systems. The uploaded technical reference describes the 74190 family as a synchronous up/down decade counter with down/up mode control, parallel outputs, ripple clock output for cascading, and asynchronous preset capability through load control.

The 74190 Up Down Decade Counter IC DIP-16 is especially useful when a circuit must count from 0 to 9 in one direction and then be able to reverse direction when required. This makes it suitable for digital displays, event counters, timing systems, step-based control circuits, and educational digital electronics projects. Because the device is synchronous, the outputs change in a controlled way with the applied clock signal, helping improve timing consistency in logic circuits. The reference datasheet also notes that the device supports parallel outputs, count-enable control, and ripple clock output for multi-stage cascade operation.

Another important feature of the 74190 Up Down Decade Counter IC DIP-16 is its presettable input structure. The IC includes parallel data inputs and a load control pin, allowing a chosen starting value to be loaded into the counter before counting begins. This is very useful in programmable counting systems, digital step control, preset timers, and multi-stage logic designs where counting must begin from a value other than zero. The uploaded datasheet lists the decade counter version separately from the binary version and shows the 74190 as the BCD 8-4-2-1 counting variant.

This IC is supplied in a DIP-16 / PDIP-16 package, which makes it convenient for breadboard use, prototyping, educational kits, and through-hole PCB assembly. The technical document shows PDIP-16 as one of the available package styles for this family, and the operating data for the SN74190 series indicates 4.75V to 5.25V supply operation with a standard commercial temperature range of 0°C to 70°C for the 74-series version.

If you need a reliable BCD up/down counter with synchronous operation, preset loading, count enable, and cascading support, the 74190 Up Down Decade Counter IC DIP-16 is a strong option for digital logic designs, training projects, and control applications.

blocks.text: The 74121 Monostable Multivibrator IC DIP-14 is a digital timing and pulse-generation integrated circuit designed to produce a single output pulse in response to a trigger event. This type of device is commonly known as a one-shot pulse generator, and it is widely used in digital timing circuits, pulse shaping, switch debouncing, trigger conditioning, and control systems that require a single, controlled pulse output. The uploaded datasheet describes the 74121 family as a monostable multivibrator with Schmitt-trigger inputs and notes that the output pulse width can be programmed using external timing components.

blocks.text: Raindrops Detection Sensor Module with 12V Relay Module

The Raindrops Detection sensor module is used for rain detection. It is also for measuring rainfall intensity. The rain sensor can be used for all kinds of weather monitoring and translated into output signals and AO.
The rain sensor can be used to monitor a variety of weather conditions and turned into several fixed output signal and Analog output.

It includes a printed circuit board (control board) that “collects” the raindrops. As raindrops are collected on the circuit board, they create paths of parallel resistance that are measured via the op-amp. The lower the resistance (or the more water), the lower the voltage output. Conversely, the less water, the greater the output voltage on the analogue pin. A completely dry board, for example, will cause the module to output 5V.

The robot kit for raindrop, rain, humidity sensor plant leaves can be used to monitor various weather conditions and has relay outputs that directly control the motor as well as other startup and shutdown.

This Raindrops Detection Sensor Module with 12V Relay Module sensor is made of high-quality double-sided fr-04 item material with a large area of 5.0* 4.0cm and a surface coated with nickel. It has the characteristics of oxidation resistance, electrical conductivity, superior performance and long service life. It is directly equipped with power relay module for load control. you can Adjust the sensitivity distribution position and control the opening of the relay under different humidity control.

When the power is plugged in, the power indicator light is on without water sensors, relays, switches for starting related equipment, indicator lights, dripping water, relays are off, lights on and off are not on.

The charging process is divided into the following three processes: trickle mode, constant current mode and constant voltage mode. When the battery voltage is lower than 3V, the charging module is in trickle mode, and the charging current is 300mA; When the battery voltage is greater than 3V, the charging module enters the constant current mode. At this time, it is charged at full speed according to the set target current, and the power can be about 21W; When the battery voltage rises to the charging target voltage (for example, 4.2V), the charging module enters the constant voltage mode. At this time, the current gradually decreases while the battery terminal voltage remains unchanged; When the charging current decreases to the charging cut-off current, the charging ends. After charging, if the battery voltage decreases to 0.1V lower than the target voltage, the charging is automatically restarted. (Note: if the voltage exceeds 4.2V, it is normal and the battery will not be damaged. If the voltage is 4.2V, the lamp is still flashing, it means that the battery is not fully charged. Full charge is not only based on the charging voltage.)

CD4538 is the precision monostable/astable multivibrator IC that is free from false triggering. It is more reliable than the popular timer IC 555. Here the IC is wired as a short duration monostable timer using R1 and C1 as timing components. With the given values, output of IC1 remains low for three minutes. By changing the value of C1 or R1 various time intervals can be obtained.

Unlike 555 IC in the monostable mode, here in CD4530, output of IC becomes high at power on and becomes low when the trigger pin5 gets a low-to-high transition pulse. When S1 is pressed, the high going pulse triggers IC and its output goes low. This drives the load through the PNP transistor T1.Load can be an LED, Buzzer etc.

name: CD4532 8 Bit Priority Encoder IC DIP-16 Package

blocks.text: CD4532 consists of combinational logic that encodes the highest priority input (D7-D0) to a 3-bit binary code. The eight inputs, D7 through D0, each have an assigned priority; D7 is the highest priority and D0 is the lowest. The priority encoder is inhibited when the chip-enable input EI is low. When EI is high, the binary representation of the highest-priority input appears on output lines Q2-Q0, and the group select line GS is high to indicate that priority inputs are present. The enable-out (EO) is high when no priority inputs are present. If any one input is high, EO is low and all cascaded lower-order stages are disabled.

The CD4532 types are supplied in 16-lead hermetic dual-in-line ceramic packages (F3A suffix), 16-lead dual-in-line plastic packages (E suffix), 16-lead small-outline packages (M, M96, MT, and NSR suffixes), and 16-lead thin shrink small-outline packages (PW and PWR suffixes).

blocks.text: The CH340 not Soldered Nano Board R3 Chip is based on the famous Arduino platform and does all the functions of Uno, but with a smaller footprint.
Nano CH340 Not Soldered Board R3 Chip is vital for your small project where you don’t need much of a pin-outs but the small size is very important to make it look good.
The Nano equips a low-cost USB-Serial Chip that makes it less in price than Nano with FTDI USB-Serial Chip used on older versions of Arduino Nano.

The Nano is a small, complete, and breadboard-friendly board based on the ATmega328 (Arduino Nano R3). It has more or less the same functionality of the Arduino Uno but in a different package. It lacks only a DC power jack and works with a Mini-B USB cable instead of a standard one.

The Nano can be power via the mini-USB connection, 6-20V unregulated external power supply (pin 30), or 5V regulated external power supply (pin 27). The power source is automatically selected to the highest voltage source.
The size of Nano V3.0 with CH340 Chip is only 43 mm x 18 mm; it comes with 6 PWM I/O from the total of 14 digitals I/O, 8 analog inputs, 16Mhz clock speed and 32kB of flash memory.
Note:- CH340 chip might not work directly with some PC/Laptop, you will need some ch340 drivers.

blocks.text: LED 0805 Surface mount LED Warm White SMD 1 PCS

It is a Warm White Surface Mount LED. An LED is a two-lead semiconductor light source, which emits lights when activated. When an appropriate voltage is applied to the LED terminal the electrons recombine with the electron holes within the device and release energy in the form of photons, this effect is known as electroluminescence. The energy bandgap between the semiconductor determines the colour of the LED

blocks.text: G80N60UFD 600V 80A IGBT Transistor with Fast Recovery Diode (CO-PAK)

The G80N60UFD is a high-performance N-Channel IGBT (Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor) designed for demanding power switching applications. Rated at 600V and 80A, it belongs to Fairchild’s UFD series, which is optimized for low conduction losses and reduced switching losses—especially in circuits that require high-speed switching such as motor drives and inverter stages.

A key advantage of the G80N60UFD is the integrated Fast Recovery Diode (FRD) built into the same package (CO-PAK), helping simplify circuit design and improve efficiency in power conversion systems. Its low saturation voltage contributes to higher efficiency and reduced heat generation under load, while the high input impedance enables easier gate drive requirements.
Low saturation voltage: VCE(sat) ≈ 2.1V at IC = 40A
Integrated Fast Recovery Diode (FRD) in CO-PAK
High input impedance for easier gate drive
Optimized for low conduction and switching losses
G80N60UFD ترانزستور IGBT ٦٠٠ فولت ٨٠ أمبير مع دايود استرجاع سريع (CO-PAK)

القطعة G80N60UFD هي ترانزستور IGBT قناة إن مخصص لدوائر القدرة التي تتطلب تبديلًا سريعًا وكفاءة عالية. تعمل بجهد حتى ٦٠٠ فولت وتيار يصل إلى ٨٠ أمبير، وتنتمي إلى سلسلة يو اف دي المصممة لتقليل فاقد التوصيل وفاقد التبديل، وهو ما يجعلها مناسبة جدًا لمراحل القدرة في الإنفرترات ودوائر تشغيل المحركات.

من أهم مميزات هذه القطعة وجود دايود استرجاع سريع مدمج داخل نفس التغليف سي أو باك، مما يساعد على تبسيط التصميم وتحسين كفاءة دوائر تحويل القدرة. كما أن انخفاض جهد التشبع يقلل الحرارة الناتجة أثناء التشغيل، بينما تساهم مقاومة الدخل العالية في تسهيل قيادة البوابة داخل الدائرة.

blocks.text: The G30N60UFD (often listed as SGH30N60UFD or similar variants by Fairchild/ON Semiconductor) is a high-performance Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor (IGBT). It is specifically designed for high-voltage, fast-switching applications, particularly in Switching Mode Power Supplies (SMPS).
Device Type: N-Channel IGBT with an Anti-Parallel Hyperfast Diode (UFD = Ultra-Fast Diode).
Current Rating: Typically rated for 30A to 60A+ (depending on specific data sheet, e.g., 60A/600V or 30A/600V).
Fast Switching: Optimized for low on-state voltage drop and high-speed operation, featuring a fast 90ns fall time.
Low Conduction Loss: Combines the low on-state conduction losses of a bipolar transistor with the high input impedance of a MOSFET.
Integrated Diode: Includes a built-in anti-parallel diode, making it ideal for rectifier circuits.
The G30N60UFD is used in power electronics applications requiring efficient, fast switching:
SMPS (Switching Mode Power Supplies): Used in high-power supplies.
UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supplies): Used in inverter stages.
Motor Drives: Used in industrial motor control systems.
Induction Heating: Used in high-frequency heating applications.

The G30N60UFD is a robust 600V IGBT designed for industrial-grade power conversion where efficiency and speed are critical, such as in motor control, solar inverters, and high-frequency power supplies.

desc: FQPF4N60 is a 600V N-Channel power MOSFET in insulated TO-220F package, rated for 2.6A and 36W, with low gate charge (15nC), fast rise time (45ns), and Coss 70pF. blocks.text: FQPF4N60 600V N-Channel Power MOSFET (Enhancement Mode) – TO-220F

The FQPF4N60 is a high-voltage N-channel power MOSFET designed for stable and efficient switching in power control circuits. With a 600V drain-to-source voltage rating and up to 2.6A drain current, it is commonly used in offline power stages, high-voltage DC switching, and compact SMPS designs where dependable high-voltage performance is required.

This MOSFET supports 36W maximum power dissipation, making it suitable for moderate-power applications when proper heatsinking and PCB copper area are considered. It also features a low total gate charge (Qg = 15nC) which helps reduce gate-drive losses and improves overall switching efficiency. Fast switching behavior is supported by a 45ns rise time, while a low output capacitance (Coss = 70pF) helps minimize switching stress and improves transient response in high-voltage converter designs.

With RDS(on) up to 2.2Ω (maximum), the device provides predictable conduction performance for high-voltage switching tasks. It also supports ±30V gate-source voltage and a 150°C maximum junction temperature, ensuring reliable operation in demanding thermal environments. The device comes in an insulated TO-220F package, offering practical mounting and electrical isolation benefits for power applications.
FQPF4N60 موسفت قدرة قناة N – 600 فولت – باكيدج TO-220F (تشغيل بالتعزيز)

يُعد FQPF4N60 ترانزستور MOSFET قدرة قناة N مصمم للعمل بكفاءة داخل دوائر التبديل والتحكم في القدرة ذات الجهد العالي. يتميز بتحمل جهد حتى 600 فولت بين المصرف والمصدر مع تيار مصرف أقصى 2.6 أمبير، مما يجعله مناسبًا لتطبيقات مثل مزودات الطاقة الأوفلاين، دوائر التبديل عالية الجهد، وتصميمات SMPS المدمجة التي تحتاج مكوّنًا يعتمد عليه في تحمل الجهد.

يوفر الموسفت قدرة تبديد قصوى 36 وات (وفق ظروف التبريد والتركيب)، لذلك يناسب تطبيقات القدرة المتوسطة عند استخدام تبريد جيد وتصميم PCB مناسب. كما أن شحنة البوابة المنخفضة (Qg = 15 نانو كولوم) تساعد على تقليل فاقد قيادة البوابة وتحسين كفاءة التبديل. ويدعم أداء تبديل سريع بفضل زمن صعود 45 نانو ثانية، مع سعة خرج منخفضة (Coss = 70 بيكو فاراد) تقلل إجهاد التبديل وتحسن الاستجابة العابرة في دوائر محولات الجهد العالي.

تصل مقاومة التشغيل RDS(on) إلى 2.2 أوم كحد أقصى، لتقديم أداء توصيل متوقع في مهام التبديل عالية الجهد. كما يدعم جهد بوابة حتى ±30 فولت ودرجة حرارة وصلة قصوى 150°م لثبات أعلى في ظروف التشغيل الصعبة. يأتي في باكيدج TO-220F المعزول الذي يوفر ميزة العزل الكهربائي وسهولة التركيب في تطبيقات القدرة.

blocks.text: The STB21NM60N, commonly marked as B21NM60N, is a high-voltage N-Channel Power MOSFET designed for demanding power switching applications. With a 600V drain-source rating (VDS) and up to 17A drain current (ID), it’s well-suited for high-power SMPS stages, PFC circuits, inverter sections, motor drives, and other high-voltage conversion designs that require strong current handling.

Built in a D2PAK (surface-mount) package, this MOSFET supports efficient thermal transfer to the PCB copper area, enabling robust power dissipation when properly laid out. It offers up to 140W maximum power dissipation under suitable thermal conditions and is rated for a maximum junction temperature of 150°C, making it reliable for heavy-duty operation.

For switching behavior, the device provides a fast rise time of up to 15ns, supporting high-efficiency switching topologies when paired with an appropriate gate driver. The total gate charge (Qg) is 66nC, which should be considered when selecting the gate driver strength and switching frequency. The output capacitance (Coss) is 110pF, impacting switching losses and EMI performance in high-voltage designs.

In conduction mode, the MOSFET features a low maximum RDS(on) of 0.22Ω, helping reduce conduction losses compared with many standard 600V MOSFETs—especially useful in higher-current paths. The gate threshold voltage (VGS(th)) is up to 4V, and the device supports up to ±25V gate-source voltage (VGS).
موسفت قدرة قناة إن 600 فولت 17 أمبير عبوة دي تو باك (STB21NM60N / B21NM60N)

إس تي بي 21 إن إم 60 إن (STB21NM60N) والموسوم غالبًا بكود B21NM60N هو موسفت قدرة بقناة إن عالي الجهد مخصص لتطبيقات التبديل الشاقة في إلكترونيات القدرة. يتحمل جهدًا حتى 600 فولت بين المصرف والمصدر، ويصل تيار المصرف إلى 17 أمبير، ما يجعله مناسبًا لمراحل القدرة في مزودات الطاقة التبديلية عالية القدرة، ودوائر تصحيح معامل القدرة، وأقسام العواكس، وبعض تطبيقات قيادة المحركات والتحويل عالي الجهد.

يأتي هذا الموسفت في عبوة دي تو باك المناسبة للتركيب السطحي، وتُساعد على نقل الحرارة بكفاءة إلى مساحة النحاس في اللوحة عند التصميم الحراري الجيد. يدعم قدرة تبديد قصوى 140 وات وفق ظروف التبريد والتصميم المناسبة، مع أقصى حرارة للوصلة 150 درجة مئوية لثبات أفضل في التشغيل المستمر.

من ناحية التبديل، يتميز بزمن صعود سريع يصل إلى 15 نانوثانية كحد أقصى لرفع الكفاءة وتقليل الفقد عند استخدام دائرة قيادة بوابة مناسبة. وتبلغ شحنة البوابة الكلية 66 نانوكولوم، لذلك يجب مراعاتها عند اختيار درايفر البوابة وتردد التبديل. كما أن سعة الخرج 110 بيكوفاراد تؤثر على الفقد أثناء التبديل والتداخل الكهرومغناطيسي في الدوائر عالية الجهد.

وفي حالة التوصيل، يقدم الموسفت مقاومة توصيل منخفضة حتى 0.22 أوم كحد أقصى لتقليل فقد القدرة أثناء مرور التيار، وهو ما يكون مهمًا جدًا في مسارات التيار الأعلى. كما أن جهد عتبة البوابة يصل إلى 4 فولت كحد أقصى، ويتحمل جهدًا بين البوابة والمصدر حتى 25 فولت.

name: JCS7N60F 600V 7A N-Channel Power MOSFET – High-Voltage Switching, TO-220MF
desc: JCS7N60F is a 600V N-Channel power MOSFET rated for 7A in TO-220MF package, with RDS(on) up to 1.2Ω, Qg 54nC, and stable high-voltage switching performance for SMPS and inverter stages. JCS7N60F موسفت قدرة قناة N بجهد 600 فولت وتيار 7 أمبير في باكيدج TO-220MF، بمقاومة تشغيل حتى 1.2 أوم وشحنة بوابة 54 نانو كولوم، مناسب لمراحل التبديل في SMPS والإنفرترات.

blocks.text: JCS7N60F 600V 7A N-Channel Power MOSFET – High-Voltage Switching, TO-220MF

The JCS7N60F is a high-voltage N-channel power MOSFET designed for robust switching in power conversion and high-energy control circuits. Rated at 600V (VDS) with up to 7A continuous drain current (ID), it is a dependable choice for high-voltage switching stages where electrical stability, thermal endurance, and consistent performance are required.

This device delivers a practical balance between switching behavior and conduction efficiency. With RDS(on) up to 1.2Ω, it helps manage conduction losses in many real-world designs, while its total gate charge (Qg = 54nC) supports stable gate-drive requirements commonly found in SMPS and inverter topologies. The MOSFET also offers predictable dynamic performance with 80ns rise time and 115pF output capacitance (Coss), which can help reduce switching stress when paired with a suitable driver and layout.

Housed in a TO-220MF package, the JCS7N60F is convenient for installation and heatsink mounting, making it suitable for power supplies, converters, inverters, and industrial switching stages operating under varying load and temperature conditions.
Rugged design: suitable for high-voltage power stages
Package: TO-220MF for easy mounting and cooling
When choosing an alternative part, ensure:
RDS(on) equal or lower (for better efficiency)
JCS7N60F موسفت قدرة قناة N – 600 فولت 7 أمبير – للتبديل عالي الجهد (TO-220MF)

يُعد JCS7N60F ترانزستور MOSFET قدرة قناة N مخصصًا للتبديل داخل دوائر القدرة وتحويل الطاقة التي تعمل بجهود مرتفعة. يتحمل حتى 600 فولت بين المصرف والمصدر (VDS) مع تيار مصرف مستمر يصل إلى 7 أمبير (ID)، لذلك يُستخدم بكفاءة في مراحل التبديل عالية الجهد التي تتطلب ثباتًا كهربائيًا، وتحملًا حراريًا جيدًا، وأداءً موثوقًا تحت ظروف تشغيل متغيرة.

يقدم هذا الموسفت توازنًا عمليًا بين كفاءة التوصيل وسلوك التبديل. تساعد قيمة مقاومة التشغيل RDS(on) حتى 1.2 أوم على تقليل فاقد التوصيل في كثير من التطبيقات الواقعية، بينما تتيح شحنة بوابة كلية Qg = 54 نانو كولوم متطلبات قيادة بوابة مستقرة في تصميمات مزودات الطاقة SMPS والإنفرترات. كما يتمتع بأداء ديناميكي متوقع مع زمن صعود 80 نانو ثانية وسعة خرج 115 بيكو فاراد (Coss)، وهو ما يساعد على تقليل إجهاد التبديل عند استخدام درايفر مناسب وتصميم PCB جيد.
يأتي JCS7N60F في باكيدج TO-220MF لتسهيل التركيب وإمكانية التثبيت على مشتت حراري، ما يجعله مناسبًا لمزودات الطاقة والمحولات والإنفرترات وتطبيقات التبديل الصناعية ذات الجهد العالي.
تبديل سريع عملي: زمن صعود 80 نانو ثانية
تصميم قوي: مناسب لمراحل القدرة عالية الجهد
عند اختيار بديل مناسب تأكد من:
RDS(on) مساوية أو أقل لتحسين الكفاءة
تشابه Qg وسرعة التبديل لتوافق الدرايفر

name: SPS03N60C3 (03N60C3) CoolMOS N-Channel Power MOSFET – 600V 3.2A (TO-251 / PG-TO251-3-11)
desc: SPS03N60C3 (03N60C3) CoolMOS N-Channel MOSFET rated for 600V and 3.2A, featuring ultra-low gate charge and fast switching in a compact TO-251 package—ideal for high-voltage switching and power supply stages. موسفت قدرة قناة إن بتقنية كول موس بجهد ٦٠٠ فولت وتيار ٣٫٢ أمبير، يتميز بشحنة بوابة منخفضة وتبديل سريع داخل تغليف تي أو ٢٥١، مناسب لمراحل التبديل في مزودات الطاقة ودوائر الجهد العالي.

blocks.text: SPS03N60C3 (03N60C3) CoolMOS N-Channel Power MOSFET – 600V 3.2A (TO-251 / PG-TO251-3-11)

The SPS03N60C3, commonly marked as 03N60C3, is a high-voltage CoolMOS N-Channel power MOSFET designed for efficient switching in compact power designs. It is optimized for fast switching performance with ultra-low gate charge, helping reduce switching losses and easing the requirements on gate driver circuits.

With a drain-source voltage rating up to 600V (and noted in some specifications as 650V at maximum junction temperature) and a continuous drain current of 3.2A, this MOSFET is a practical choice for high-voltage switching stages in power supplies, auxiliary converters, and similar applications. Its periodic avalanche capability and extreme dv/dt ruggedness support reliable operation under demanding transient conditions.
The device comes in a compact TO-251 (PG-TO251-3-11) package, making it suitable for space-efficient layouts while maintaining stable thermal and electrical performance.
Ultra-low gate charge (Qg) for efficient drive and reduced switching loss
Very fast switching behavior (low rise time)
Periodic avalanche rated for better robustness
Extreme dv/dt rated for improved reliability in fast switching stages

blocks.v: 600 V (some specs mention 650 V at TJ max)

blocks.text: ترانزستور قدرة موسفت قناة إن (كول موس) إس بي إس ٠٣ إن ٦٠ سي ٣ – ٦٠٠ فولت ٣٫٢ أمبير (تي أو ٢٥١)

القطعة إس بي إس ٠٣ إن ٦٠ سي ٣ والمعروفة بكود الطباعة ٠٣ إن ٦٠ سي ٣ هي موسفت قدرة قناة إن بتقنية كول موس مخصصة لدوائر التبديل ذات الجهد العالي مع كفاءة مرتفعة. تم تصميمها لتقديم أداء تبديل سريع مع شحنة بوابة منخفضة جدًا، مما يقلل فاقد التبديل ويسهّل قيادة البوابة في الدوائر العملية.

تدعم هذه القطعة جهدًا حتى ٦٠٠ فولت (ويُذكر في بعض المواصفات ٦٥٠ فولت عند أقصى حرارة للوصلة) مع تيار تشغيل مستمر يصل إلى ٣٫٢ أمبير، لذلك فهي مناسبة لمراحل التبديل في مزودات الطاقة، وحدات التحويل المساعدة، ودوائر التحكم ذات الجهد العالي. كما تتميز بقدرة تحمّل جيدة للنبضات والارتفاعات المفاجئة بفضل تصنيف الانهيار الدوري ومقاومة عالية لتغير الجهد السريع.
وتأتي في تغليف تي أو ٢٥١ المدمج، ما يجعلها مناسبة للتصميمات الصغيرة مع الحفاظ على استقرار الأداء الكهربائي والحراري.

name: FQPF15N60 N-Channel Power MOSFET Transistor 600V 15A
desc: FQPF15N60 N-Channel Power MOSFET (600V, 15A) for high-voltage switching in SMPS, DC-DC converters, inverters, and motor drives, featuring RDS(on) up to 0.5Ω and PD up to 312W with proper heatsinking. موسفت قدرة بقناة إن بجهد 600 فولت وتيار 15 أمبير مناسب لمزودات الطاقة التبديلية والعواكس ودوائر قيادة المحركات، مع مقاومة توصيل حتى 0.5 أوم وقدرة تبديد عالية عند استخدام تبريد مناسب.

blocks.text: The FQPF15N60 (often referred to as 15N60) is a high-voltage N-Channel Power MOSFET engineered for power conversion and switching applications that demand strong voltage margin and reliable current handling. With a 600V drain-source rating (VDS) and 15A continuous drain current (ID), it is commonly used in high-voltage switching stages where efficiency and thermal stability are critical.

This MOSFET helps improve converter efficiency thanks to its low on-state resistance, with RDS(on) up to 0.5Ω, reducing conduction losses compared to many standard high-voltage devices in similar classes. It is also designed for robust thermal operation, offering high power dissipation capability up to 312W (with appropriate heatsinking and thermal conditions) and a maximum junction temperature of 150°C, which supports dependable operation in industrial and power-supply environments.

For switching performance, the FQPF15N60 has a gate threshold voltage up to 4V (VGS(th)), a total gate charge (Qg) of 270nC, and rise time up to 200ns. These parameters should be considered when selecting a gate driver and switching frequency, especially in higher-power SMPS or inverter designs. The output capacitance (Coss) is 270pF, which also influences switching losses and EMI behavior in fast-switching topologies.
Strong thermal capability: PD up to 312W (with proper cooling)
Reliable operation at elevated temperature: TJ max 150°C
Suitable for high-voltage switching & power conversion
When choosing a compatible replacement, select a MOSFET with:
Similar or lower RDS(on) and comparable Qg
Matching package and pinout according to your PCB/heatsink design
موسفت قدرة قناة إن 600 فولت 15 أمبير (FQPF15N60)

إف كيو بي إف 15 إن 60 (FQPF15N60) المعروف أيضًا باسم 15N60 هو موسفت قدرة بقناة إن مخصص لتطبيقات التبديل والتحويل عالي الجهد في إلكترونيات القدرة. يتحمل جهدًا حتى 600 فولت بين المصرف والمصدر، مع تيار مستمر حتى 15 أمبير، لذلك يُستخدم بكثرة في مراحل القدرة التي تتطلب كفاءة عالية واعتمادية وثباتًا حراريًا جيدًا.

يساعد هذا الموسفت على تقليل الفقد أثناء التوصيل بفضل مقاومة توصيل منخفضة حيث تصل مقاومة التوصيل حتى 0.5 أوم كحد أقصى، وهو ما يساهم في رفع كفاءة دوائر التحويل. كما يدعم التشغيل القاسي حراريًا بفضل قدرة تبديد عالية تصل إلى 312 وات عند توفير تبريد مناسب، بالإضافة إلى أقصى حرارة للوصلة 150 درجة مئوية، مما يجعله مناسبًا للبيئات الصناعية ومزودات الطاقة عالية الجهد.

من ناحية التبديل، يصل جهد عتبة البوابة إلى 4 فولت كحد أقصى، وتبلغ شحنة البوابة الكلية 270 نانوكولوم، ويصل زمن الصعود إلى 200 نانوثانية. هذه القيم مهمة عند اختيار درايفر البوابة وتحديد تردد التبديل. كما أن سعة الخرج 270 بيكوفاراد تؤثر على الفقد أثناء التبديل وعلى التداخل الكهرومغناطيسي في الدوائر السريعة.
