name: FQPF12N60C 600V N-Channel Power MOSFET – 12A (High-Efficiency Switching)
desc: FQPF12N60C is a 600V 12A N-Channel MOSFET with fast switching, low gate charge (typ. 48 nC), and RDS(on) 0.65Ω @ VGS=10V—ideal for SMPS, Active PFC, and half-bridge lamp ballast designs. FQPF12N60C هو 600V 12A N-Channel MOSFET يتميز بتبديل سريع وQg منخفضة (typ. 48 nC) وRDS(on) 0.65Ω @ VGS=10V، مناسب لتطبيقات SMPS وActive PFC ودوائر half-bridge.

blocks.text: The FQPF12N60C is a high-voltage N-Channel enhancement mode power MOSFET designed for efficient and reliable high-speed switching. Built using Fairchild’s proprietary planar stripe DMOS technology, it is engineered to minimize RDS(on), improve switching behavior, and withstand high-energy stress during avalanche and commutation events.

With a 600V drain-source rating and a 12A current capability, the device is well suited for power designs that demand stable performance and efficiency. Its low gate charge supports easier gate driving and reduced switching losses, while the improved dv/dt capability enhances ruggedness in demanding switching environments.
This MOSFET is commonly used in high-efficiency SMPS, Active PFC stages, and electronic lamp ballast circuits based on half-bridge topology.
High-voltage switching and power conversion stages
FQPF12N60C ترانزستور 600V N-Channel MOSFET – 12A للتبديل عالي الكفاءة

القطعة FQPF12N60C هي N-Channel enhancement mode power MOSFET مخصصة لدوائر الجهد العالي التي تتطلب تبديلًا سريعًا وكفاءة تشغيل مرتفعة. يتم تصنيعها باستخدام تقنية Fairchild المتقدمة planar stripe DMOS، والتي تم تطويرها لتقليل RDS(on) وتحسين أداء التبديل، مع القدرة على تحمّل النبضات العالية في وضع avalanche وأثناء عمليات التحويل والتبديل.

تدعم هذه القطعة جهدًا يصل إلى 600V مع تيار حتى 12A، وتتميز بـ Qg منخفضة مما يساعد على تقليل فاقد التبديل وتسهيل قيادة البوابة. كما أن تحسين dv/dt capability يجعلها أكثر تحمّلًا في دوائر التبديل السريع والبيئات الصناعية.
تُستخدم غالبًا في مزودات الطاقة عالية الكفاءة SMPS، ودوائر Active PFC، ودوائر بالاست إلكترونية للمصابيح المعتمدة على تصميم half-bridge.
تحمّل أفضل لتغيرات الجهد السريعة improved dv/dt capability
دوائر تصحيح معامل القدرة Active PFC
مراحل تحويل القدرة والتبديل بجهد عالي

name: 7N70C (SIF7N70C) 700V 7A N-Channel Power MOSFET – High-Voltage Switching
desc: 7N70C (SIF7N70C) is a 700V 7A N-Channel power MOSFET with Qg 24 nC and RDS(on) up to 1.35Ω, available in TO-220 / TO-220FP / TO-262 / TO-263 packages for high-voltage switching applications. 7N70C (SIF7N70C) هو 700V 7A N-Channel power MOSFET بقيمة Qg 24 nC وRDS(on) حتى 1.35Ω، ويتوفر بتغليفات TO-220 وTO-220FP وTO-262 وTO-263 لتطبيقات التبديل بجهد عالي.

blocks.text: The 7N70C (type designator: SIF7N70C) is a high-voltage N-Channel power MOSFET designed for efficient switching in circuits operating up to 700V. With a continuous drain current capability of 7A, it is suitable for high-voltage power stages in SMPS, converters, and industrial switching applications where reliability and thermal performance are essential.

This MOSFET is built to handle demanding switching conditions while offering practical efficiency characteristics. Its RDS(on) helps manage conduction losses, and its moderate total gate charge (Qg) supports controlled switching behavior in high-voltage designs.

It is commonly available in multiple package options including TO-220, TO-220FP, TO-262, and TO-263, giving flexibility for through-hole or surface-mount power layouts depending on the design requirements.
Designed for high-voltage switching and power conversion
Multiple package options for flexible mounting
7N70C (SIF7N70C) 700V 7A N-Channel Power MOSFET للتبديل بجهد عالي

القطعة 7N70C (type designator: SIF7N70C) هي N-Channel power MOSFET مخصصة لدوائر التبديل والتحويل التي تعمل حتى 700V. تدعم تيار تشغيل مستمر حتى 7A، لذلك فهي مناسبة لمراحل القدرة في مزودات الطاقة، دوائر التحويل، وتطبيقات التبديل الصناعية التي تحتاج اعتمادية وتحمل حراري جيد.

تساعد قيمة RDS(on) على تقليل فاقد التوصيل داخل الدائرة، كما أن Qg المتوسطة تساهم في أداء تبديل منضبط في تصميمات الجهد العالي. وتتوفر هذه القطعة بعدة تغليفات مثل TO-220 و TO-220FP و TO-262 و TO-263 لتناسب طرق تركيب مختلفة حسب التصميم.
مناسبة لدوائر التبديل والتحويل بجهد عالي

name: UTC 5N50 N-channel power MOSFET Transistor
desc: UTC 5N50 N-Channel Power MOSFET (500V, 5A) using DMOS planar stripe technology for efficient high-voltage switching—ideal for PFC, SMPS, and electronic ballast circuits. موسفت قدرة بقناة إن 500 فولت 5 أمبير مناسب لتطبيقات التبديل عالي الجهد مثل تصحيح معامل القدرة ومزودات الطاقة التبديلية والبالاست الإلكتروني، بتقنية دي موس لتحسين الكفاءة.

blocks.text: The UTC 5N50 is a 500V, 5A N-Channel power MOSFET from Unisonic Technologies (UTC), designed for efficient high-voltage switching in power electronics. Built using DMOS planar stripe technology, it delivers improved switching behavior and reduced conduction losses through a low on-state resistance design—making it a practical choice for modern high-efficiency converter stages.

A key strength of the UTC 5N50 is its ability to handle high-energy avalanche events, helping improve ruggedness in real-world circuits where voltage spikes and inductive switching can occur. This combination of efficiency and durability makes it suitable for demanding applications such as active power factor correction (PFC), switched-mode power supplies (SMPS), and electronic lamp ballasts, where stable performance and safe operation are essential.
In short, if you need a dependable 500V N-channel MOSFET for high-efficiency switching topologies, the UTC 5N50 is a widely used option in its class.
موسفت قدرة قناة إن 500 فولت 5 أمبير (UTC 5N50)

يو تي سي 5 إن 50 (UTC 5N50) هو موسفت قدرة بقناة إن يتحمل 500 فولت ويصل تيار المصرف إلى 5 أمبير، من تصنيع يوني سونيك تكنولوجيز. تم تصميمه ليقدم تبديلًا عالي الكفاءة في دوائر إلكترونيات القدرة، ويعتمد على تقنية دي موس مع تصميم الشرائح المستوية لتحسين أداء التبديل وتقليل الفقد أثناء التوصيل عبر مقاومة توصيل منخفضة.

يمتاز هذا الموسفت بقدرة جيدة على تحمل نبضات طاقة عالية في وضع الانهيار، وهو ما يزيد من متانته في التطبيقات العملية التي قد تتعرض لنبضات جهد مفاجئة أو أحمال حثية. لذلك يُعد مناسبًا لدوائر مثل تصحيح معامل القدرة النشط، ومزودات الطاقة التبديلية، ودوائر تشغيل لمبات الفلورسنت أو البالاست الإلكتروني، حيث تكون الكفاءة والاعتمادية عنصرين أساسيين.

blocks.text: FQPF6N90 High-Voltage N-Channel Power MOSFET (Enhancement Mode) – TO-220F

The FQPF6N90 is a high-voltage N-channel enhancement-mode power MOSFET designed for reliable switching in high-energy power circuits. With a 900V drain-to-source rating and a 3.4A continuous drain current, it’s a strong choice for applications that require efficient control of high-voltage loads, especially in compact power supply designs.

This MOSFET supports up to 56W maximum power dissipation, making it suitable for demanding thermal conditions when properly mounted and cooled. It also features a low gate charge (Qg = 40nC) which helps improve switching efficiency, and fast switching behavior with a rise time of 80ns, supporting cleaner transitions in high-frequency power stages.

In addition, the RDS(on) up to 1.9Ω and Coss of 140pF provide predictable performance during switching, while the ±30V gate-source limit and 150°C maximum junction temperature ensure durability in real-world designs. The device comes in a TO-220F package, which offers good isolation and practical mounting for power electronics projects.
ترانزستور MOSFET قدرة عالي الجهد FQPF6N90 – قناة N (تشغيل بالتعزيز) – TO-220F

يُعد FQPF6N90 ترانزستور قدرة من نوع MOSFET قناة N بنمط التشغيل بالتعزيز، ومُصمم للعمل بكفاءة داخل دوائر القدرة ذات الجهد العالي. يتميز بتحمل جهد بين المصرف والمصدر حتى 900 فولت مع تيار مصرف أقصى 3.4 أمبير، مما يجعله مناسبًا للتحكم في الأحمال عالية الجهد داخل تطبيقات القدرة المختلفة.

يدعم هذا المكوّن قدرة تبديد حراري تصل إلى 56 وات (حسب ظروف التبريد والتركيب)، كما يتميز بشحنة بوابة منخفضة نسبيًا (40 نانو كولوم) تساعد على تحسين كفاءة التبديل وتقليل الفاقد. ويقدم أيضًا أداءً سريعًا في التبديل مع زمن صعود 80 نانو ثانية، ما يجعله مناسبًا لدوائر التقطيع ومراحل القدرة التي تعمل بترددات أعلى.

بالإضافة إلى ذلك، توفر قيمة مقاومة التشغيل حتى 1.9 أوم مع سعة خرج 140 بيكو فاراد أداءً متوقعًا أثناء التبديل، مع قدرة تحمل جهد بوابة حتى ±30 فولت ودرجة حرارة وصلة قصوى 150 درجة مئوية لزيادة الاعتمادية. يأتي في باكيدج TO-220F المعزول والعملي للتركيب في دوائر القدرة.

blocks.text: FQPF9N60 (FQPF9N60C) N-Channel Power MOSFET – 600V 9A (TO-220F Full Pack)

The FQPF9N60 (often listed as FQPF9N60C) is an N-channel enhancement mode power MOSFET engineered for high-voltage, high-speed switching applications. It is widely used in power stages where efficient switching, stable thermal performance, and reliable operation are required—such as SMPS power supplies, DC-DC converters, and motor control circuits.

Rated for a 600V drain-source voltage (VDSS) and a continuous drain current of 9A, this MOSFET is a practical choice for high-voltage switching designs. The device is commonly offered in a TO-220F Full Pack package, which provides built-in insulation, making mounting and heatsink installation safer and more convenient while supporting effective thermal management.

Its electrical behavior is optimized for switching efficiency, with characteristics typically associated with low gate charge and low on-resistance, helping reduce both switching and conduction losses in real-world applications.

blocks.text: The SSP4N60 is a high-voltage N-Channel Power MOSFET designed for efficient switching in power electronics. With a 600V drain-source rating and up to 4A continuous drain current, it’s a solid choice for offline SMPS stages, DC-DC converters, and general high-voltage switching applications.

This MOSFET comes in a TO-220 package that supports practical heat-sinking for higher power operation. It features a maximum power dissipation of 75W (with proper thermal conditions) and a maximum junction temperature of 150°C, making it suitable for demanding designs.

For gate drive and switching behavior, the device offers a total gate charge (Qg) of 25nC, supporting reasonable switching speed and driver requirements. The rise time is up to 150ns, while the output capacitance (Coss) is 40pF, helping reduce switching losses in many high-voltage converter topologies. The gate threshold voltage (VGS(th)) is up to 4.5V, and the MOSFET is rated for ±20V gate-source voltage (VGS).

On the conduction side, the maximum RDS(on) is 2.5Ω, which is typical for 600V MOSFETs in this current class and should be considered when estimating conduction losses at your operating current and temperature.
موسفت قدرة قناة إن 600 فولت 4 أمبير عبوة تي أو 220 (SSP4N60)

إس إس بي 4 إن 60 (SSP4N60) هو ترانزستور قدرة من نوع موسفت بقناة إن، مخصص لتطبيقات التبديل عالي الجهد في دوائر إلكترونيات القدرة. يتميز بقدرة تحمل جهد حتى 600 فولت بين المصرف والمصدر، مع تيار مصرف أقصى 4 أمبير، مما يجعله مناسبًا لدوائر مزوّدات الطاقة التبديلية، ومحولات التيار، ومراحل التبديل في كثير من تطبيقات القدرة.

يأتي هذا الموسفت في عبوة تي أو 220 المناسبة للتركيب مع مشتت حراري عند الحاجة، ويدعم قدرة تبديد تصل إلى 75 وات وفق شروط التبريد المناسبة. كما أن أقصى درجة حرارة للوصلة الداخلية 150 درجة مئوية لتوافق ظروف التشغيل القاسية نسبيًا في تطبيقات القدرة.

من ناحية قيادة البوابة وسلوك التبديل، يمتلك شحنة بوابة كلية 25 نانوكولوم لتوازن جيد بين سرعة التبديل ومتطلبات دائرة القيادة. كذلك يصل زمن الصعود إلى 150 نانوثانية كحد أقصى، وتبلغ سعة الخرج 40 بيكوفاراد بما يساعد على تحسين أداء التبديل في كثير من الدوائر عالية الجهد. كما أن جهد عتبة البوابة يصل إلى 4.5 فولت كحد أقصى، مع تحمل جهد بين البوابة والمصدر حتى 20 فولت.
أما في حالة التوصيل، فإن مقاومة التوصيل بين المصرف والمصدر تصل إلى 2.5 أوم كحد أقصى، وهي قيمة شائعة ضمن فئة موسفت 600 فولت بهذا التيار، ويُفضَّل مراعاتها عند حساب الفقد الحراري أثناء التشغيل.

blocks.text: LED Dimmer DC 12–24V 30A (Single-Color PWM, Knob Control, Metal Housing)

The LED Dimmer DC 12–24V 30A is a heavy-duty, single-channel PWM dimmer that gives you smooth, flicker-free brightness control for single-color LED strips, modules, and lamps. With a robust 30 A max output, it can drive long runs or parallel branches from a 12–24 V DC power supply. A tactile rotary knob provides stepless 0–100% dimming, while the aluminum housing and screw terminals make bench and field installs quick and reliable. Ideal for décor, display cases, van/RV lighting, sign boxes, workshops, and maker builds.

Connect DC power supply + to IN+, and DC – to IN- on the dimmer.

If the load is large, distribute current across multiple output branches and appropriate wire gauges.
Power sizing: Choose a PSU with at least 20% headroom (e.g., 240 W load → 12 V 20 A supply minimum; prefer 25–30 A).
Voltage choice: At equal wattage, 24 V reduces current and cable loss vs 12 V.

blocks.text: LynX PETG‑HF Filament 1.75mm (High‑Flow PETG for High‑Speed Printing, 1kg)

LynX PETG‑HF Filament 1.75mm — A toughness‑modified, high‑flow PETG engineered for reliable high‑speed printing without sacrificing layer bonding or dimensional fidelity. Delivering excellent melt flow and consistent extrusion, LynX PETG‑HF streamlines production of functional prototypes and end‑use parts on modern high‑speed FDM printers. Supplied on a 1 kg spool in 1.75 mm diameter with ±0.03 mm tolerance, it offers a clean, glossy‑to‑satin finish and dependable heat resistance for everyday shop use.
🚀 High‑flow formulation tuned for fast throughput (volumetric 18–21 mm³/s) while maintaining strong inter‑layer adhesion.
🧰 Tough + practical blend: higher impact and durability vs standard PETG; ideal for brackets, enclosures, and fixtures.
♻️ Stable processing window with broad 235–265°C nozzle range; straightforward first‑layer dialing at 240–250°C.
🧲 Bed compatibility with textured PEI and similar surfaces; excellent grip at 80–90°C with measured release after cooling.
🎯 Dimensional control via tight ±0.03 mm diameter tolerance for predictable fits and clean press‑ins.

🧪 Drying: 60°C for ~6 hours before critical jobs; store sealed with desiccant

blocks.text: LUOWEI Motherboard Fixture LW-AP01 High-Temperature Carbon Fiber (for iPhone & Android)

Meet the LUOWEI LW-AP01, a precision motherboard clamping fixture built for modern smartphone repair labs that demand repeatable alignment, high heat tolerance, and a carbon-fiber backbone that keeps weight low and rigidity high. Designed for reballing, chip removal, and micro-soldering workflows on iPhone and Android logic boards, the LW-AP01 pairs a carbon composite base with heat-resistant jaws and a fine-pitch lead screw so your board stays centered and stable under hot air.

✅ Heat-tough carbon fiber body — Carbon fiber combines high strength with low density and excellent corrosion resistance, enabling a rigid base that resists flex while remaining lightweight. It tolerates high working temperatures during hot-air rework without warping.
🔧 Adjustable clamping stroke — A guided rail and lead screw deliver smooth travel so you can center boards quickly. Markings show 15–67 mm span with a clear 53 mm travel window for repeatable setups.
🔥 High-temperature jaws — The contact blocks and insulation layers keep heat away from sensitive zones, letting you lift BGA packages or reflow shields while the board remains firmly seated.
🧲 Non-marring, anti-slip contact — Textured contact faces and a wide stance distribute clamping force to reduce board stress and avoid cosmetic damage.
📐 Universal board compatibility — Works with narrow iPhone logic boards and wider Android mainboards; open sides make room for flex tails and daughterboards.
🛡️ ESD-aware build — Carbon composite and coated hardware help mitigate static build-up in properly grounded benches.
⚙️ Swap-friendly workflow — Front-load design and a knurled adjuster let you exchange boards with minimal tool changes, ideal for batch reballing and diagnostics.
🛠️ Service-grade finish — Countersunk fasteners, chamfered edges, and a flat base keep the fixture planted on your mat or preheater.
🌡️ Hot-air friendly geometry — Angled clearances around the work zone improve airflow from your nozzle and reduce heat shadowing.
🔩 Long-life hardware — Steel lead screw and alloy clamps maintain smooth actuation over repeated cycles.
✅ Shield reflow and adhesive softening with hot air
✅ Reballing CPU/PMIC/NAND stencils with stable support
✅ Microscope-assisted tracing, probing, and continuity tests
✅ Holding small sub-boards (charging boards, RF boards) with adapters
🔬 Rigidity without mass — Less mass heats up slower and cools quicker, limiting thermal soak into areas you’re not working on.
🧯 Thermal resilience — The composite base stands firm at hot-air temps used in mobile repair, helping you keep planarity under heat.
🧼 Corrosion resistance — Flux and cleaning agents are tough on tools; the carbon base and coated hardware handle them with ease.

Meet the SUNSHINE S1 Intelligent Precision Soldering Station—a smart, color-screen, precision tweezers soldering platform built for micro-work where ordinary irons struggle. With a balanced tweezer-style heater you can heat both sides of tiny parts at once for clean, repeatable lifts and placements on fine-pitch SMD, connectors, shields, and flex assemblies. It integrates real-time digital display of voltage and current, fast-charge protocol support, low-voltage activation, and a 27-socket harness that covers the most common battery interfaces. The JTX CK9 is a professional rear camera frame remover designed to separate the glued metal/plastic camera frame from iPhone housings (X through 16 / 16 Plus / 16 Pro / 16 Pro Max) cleanly and repeatably. A rigid, CNC-machined body with precision positioning blocks and an adjustable pressure system keeps the frame square and aligned while you break the adhesive bond, reducing slip, scratches, and lens damage. blocks.text: 0.08mm High Toughness Soft Tungsten Alloy Wire 100M

0.08mm High Toughness Soft Tungsten Alloy Wire 100M is a fine, durable cutting wire supplied on a compact reel for precision mobile phone repair, screen separation, adhesive cutting, display refurbishing, and delicate maintenance work. The wire is designed with high toughness and anti-pull properties, making it suitable for controlled cutting through adhesive layers where ordinary weak wire may break easily.

This soft tungsten alloy wire is commonly used by mobile repair technicians for separating screens, cutting glue layers, removing adhesive between display assemblies, and performing controlled fine cutting tasks during phone and electronics repair. With a very thin 0.08mm diameter, it can pass through narrow adhesive gaps while helping reduce the risk of applying excessive mechanical force to the part being repaired.

The supplied spool is marked as High Toughness Soft Tungsten Alloy Wire, with the 0.08mm size selected and 100M length selected on the label. This makes it a practical workshop consumable for repeated repair jobs. The thin profile is useful when working with delicate screens, touch panels, display frames, back covers, adhesive layers, and other tight areas that require a fine cutting line.

The wire label highlights Anti-pull and High toughness, which are important characteristics for repair work because the wire needs to stay consistent while being pulled through adhesive. In mobile repair, wire stability helps the technician keep better control during separation and reduces interruptions caused by frequent wire snapping.

The reel is packed inside a sealed protective plastic package to help keep the wire clean and organised before use. This is useful for workshops because fine wire can easily become tangled if stored loosely. The reel format allows the user to pull out the needed length, cut it, and keep the remaining wire protected for future use.

This product is not an electronic component and does not require power. It is a mechanical consumable tool used together with proper repair technique, screen separator machines, heating plates, glue cutting handles, or manual separation tools depending on the repair job. For best results, adhesive should usually be softened with controlled heat before using the wire, especially with phone screens and back covers.

سلك تنجستن مرن عالي المتانة ٠٫٠٨ مم طول ١٠٠ متر لفصل الشاشات

سلك تنجستن مرن عالي المتانة ٠٫٠٨ مم طول ١٠٠ متر هو سلك رفيع مخصص لأعمال صيانة الهواتف وفصل الشاشات وقطع طبقات اللاصق بدقة. يأتي السلك على بكرة داخل تغليف واقي، وهو مناسب لفنيين الصيانة الذين يحتاجون إلى سلك رفيع يتحمل الشد أثناء فصل الشاشة أو الغطاء الخلفي أو إزالة اللاصق من الأماكن الضيقة.

هذا السلك يُستخدم كأداة مساعدة في صيانة الهواتف المحمولة، خصوصًا عند فصل الشاشات أو تمرير السلك بين طبقات اللاصق بعد التسخين المناسب. قطر السلك الرفيع ٠٫٠٨ مم يجعله مناسبًا للدخول في المسافات الضيقة بين الشاشة والفريم أو بين الغطاء الخلفي والجسم، مما يساعد الفني على تنفيذ عملية الفصل بطريقة أكثر تحكمًا من استخدام أدوات سميكة أو ضغط زائد.

الملصق الموجود على البكرة يوضح أن السلك من نوع تنجستن مرن عالي المتانة، كما يظهر اختيار مقاس ٠٫٠٨ مم واختيار طول ١٠٠ متر. هذا الطول مناسب للاستخدام المتكرر داخل الورشة، حيث يمكن للفني قص الجزء المطلوب لكل عملية والاحتفاظ بباقي السلك منظمًا داخل البكرة.

الميزة المهمة في هذا النوع من الأسلاك أنه يجمع بين الرفع والمتانة. في أعمال فصل الشاشات، السلك يحتاج إلى تحمل الشد أثناء المرور داخل طبقة اللاصق بدون أن ينقطع بسرعة. كما أن الرفع يساعد في تقليل الاحتكاك الزائد والدخول في الفواصل الضيقة، بشرط استخدامه بطريقة صحيحة ومع تسخين مناسب عند الحاجة.

وجود السلك داخل بكرة محمية بتغليف بلاستيك يساعد في الحفاظ عليه من الاتساخ والتشابك. الأسلاك الرفيعة قد تتلف أو تتعقد بسهولة إذا تم تخزينها بشكل عشوائي، لذلك وجود بكرة مخصصة يجعل المنتج مناسبًا للاستخدام اليومي في مراكز الصيانة ومحلات إصلاح الهواتف.

يُنصح باستخدام هذا السلك مع أدوات مناسبة مثل مقابض شد السلك أو أدوات فصل الشاشة أو ماكينة التسخين أو سخان هواء مضبوط حسب نوع عملية الصيانة. السلك نفسه لا يحتاج إلى كهرباء، ولكنه يحتاج إلى خبرة وتحكم أثناء السحب لتجنب قطع الفلاتات أو خدش أجزاء حساسة داخل الجهاز.

blocks.text: SUNSHINE SS-905D IP/Android Smart Power Cable (V100) – 3-Pin Boot Line

The SUNSHINE SS-905D Smart Power Cable is a professional 3-pin boot line that lets you power-on and troubleshoot iPhone and Android mainboards safely from a bench power supply. With auto-identify polarity, auto-matching battery protocol, and over-voltage protection, the SS-905D gives technicians a repeatable, damage-free way to read idle/boot current, verify short circuits, and perform software or baseband repairs without installing a physical battery. The V100 generation adopts a sustainable expansion design (module + detachable leads) and a compact controller (≈63×35 mm) with flexible PVC leads and thick pure-copper cores for stable current delivery.
✅ 3-wire, damage-free boot: B+, B-, and S (data/NTC) simulate a real battery to avoid false boots and protect PMIC/CPU.
🔌 Apple & Android coverage: dedicated battery contact holders for mainstream iPhone generations and multi-brand Android pads—no alligator clips needed.
🧠 Intelligent protections: reverse-polarity, over-voltage, and zero burn-in prevention when the PSU is mis-set or sense pin is floating.
🔄 Auto-match battery protocol: identifies the battery agreement and auto-detects positive/negative for quick startup.
🧰 1:1 precision fit: molded bases align with board pads for a secure connection that won’t lift pads or slip during probing.
🧵 Workshop-friendly build: ≈425 mm supply lead; ≈380 mm per device lead; soft PVC insulation; pure-copper conductor for low loss.
🔧 Expandable architecture: controller accepts swappable leads—keep the core and add future cable sets as models evolve.
⏱️ Faster diagnostics: instant boot lets you read standby/boot/idle current to isolate shorts, leakage, or sensor faults.

Multi-plug iPhone battery contact bases labeled by series (e.g., 6S, 7G, 8G/8P, X/XS/XS Max, 11/11P/11PM, 12/12Mini/12P/12PM, 13/13Mini/13P/13PM, 14/14Plus/14P/14PM, 15/15Plus/15P/15PM, 16/16Plus/16P/16PM).
Multi-brand Android battery bases (codes such as 1B–18B, covering HW/MI/OP/VIVO/MEIZU/LEN/LETv/ZTE/SAM/NOK/HIS/ACE families).
Exact plug count and layout follow the labeled kits shown in the product images; Apple “IP16” upgrade set is supported in V100.
📈 Current-draw diagnostics: identify abnormal boot loops, shorted rails, or baseband leaks via PSU readings.
🔋 Battery-line repair: test after replacing PMIC, Tigris/Tristar/charging ICs, or connector sockets—without installing a pack.
🧪 Software service: keep the board powered during update/restore when a test battery isn’t available.
🛡️ Data recovery: safe temporary power to dump NAND or check peripherals.
🧭 School/bench training: consistent demonstration of normal vs. faulty current curves.
🧠 Smart protections: reverse connection lockout; over-voltage guard; controller prevents instant burn when sense pin is wrong.
🧷 Selected original-style battery bases: sprung contacts and gold-tone pads for stable conduction and less resistance.
🧩 One-hand placement: the 1:1 footprint allows steady placement even under a microscope.
🧯 Safe insulation: flexible PVC jacket resists solder splashes; soft shore hardness minimizes stress on pads.
⚙️ Service-grade harness: pure-copper multi-strand wire maintains voltage under boot surge.
🔌 Connect PSU → banana leads to a regulated bench supply (set ~4.2 V current-limited).
📲 Seat the base → align the labeled base with the board’s battery pads (B+, NTC/S, B–).
▶️ Boot the board → watch the ammeter:
0.30–0.80 A spikes: SoC wake / backlight load;
steady abnormal >1 A: suspect shorted rail or peripheral.
🔁 Switch bases as you move between Apple and Android models; no soldering to pads.
Values above are illustrative; always compare with known-good references for the same chipset and board state.

Apple iPhone: 6S / 7G / 8G / 8P / X / XS / XS Max / 11 / 11 Pro / 11 Pro Max / 12 / 12 mini / 12 Pro / 12 Pro Max / 13 / 13 mini / 13 Pro / 13 Pro Max / 14 / 14 Plus / 14 Pro / 14 Pro Max / 15 / 15 Plus / 15 Pro / 15 Pro Max / 16 / 16 Plus / 16 Pro / 16 Pro Max.
Android (base codes 1B–18B): coverage across Huawei, Xiaomi, OPPO, Vivo, Meizu, Lenovo, LeTV, ZTE, Samsung, Nokia, Hisense, ACE and similar, as indicated on each base.
⚡ PSU lead length: ≈425 mm (banana to controller).
🧯 Set limits first: 4.20 V with 1–2 A current limit before connecting the board.
🧲 No battery in parallel: remove or disconnect the physical battery to avoid back-feed.
🔍 Probe sequence: if current spikes immediately to the limit, disconnect—inspect for shorts on PP_BATT_VCC or downstream rails.
🧪 Record current curves: keep a log per model (good vs. bad) to speed future diagnostics.
♻️ Cable care: avoid sharp bends at the base; coil loosely; keep contacts clean with IPA.

blocks.text: SUNSHINE Glue Remover Knife SL-503 30W (Electric Heating Soldering Iron)

The SUNSHINE SL-503 is a specialized, 30 W electric-heated knife-tip soldering iron designed for UV/OCA glue and polarizer removal on phone and tablet LCD assemblies. Unlike a standard conical iron meant for fine solder joints, the SL-503 features a wide, flat “T-blade” that spreads controlled heat across adhesive layers, allowing you to shear-lift cured UV glue and polarizer films with far less force. This greatly reduces the risk of gouging glass, tearing flexes, or warping frames.

blocks.text: BDX33C — NPN Power Darlington Transistor (TO-220, 100V / 10A / 80W class)

The BDX33C is an NPN power Darlington transistor designed for high-gain switching and linear control in motor drivers, relay/solenoid interfaces, audio stages, and general power control. With a collector-emitter voltage rating around 100 V, continuous collector current up to 10 A, and power dissipation in the ≈80 W class (with proper heatsink), the BDX33C delivers strong current amplification with minimal base drive. It is the complementary partner to BDX34C (PNP) for push-pull designs.
✅ High current gain (Darlington) — hFE typically >750 for robust current multiplication with small base current.
🔌 Power handling — supports up to ≈10 A collector current and ≈80 W dissipation (heatsinked).
⚡ 100 V VCEO class — comfortable headroom for 12–48 V systems and inductive loads.
🧲 Low drive requirement — ideal for microcontroller or logic-level control via small driver resistor.
🛡️ Rugged power package — TO-220 with isolated mounting options and large thermal tab.
🔁 Complement available — pair with BDX34C for H-bridges and audio emitter follower stages.
🔧 DC motor and fan drivers (with flyback diode).
🔊 Audio power pre-driver or emitter follower (Darlington pair).
🔦 High-current LED strings and lamp control.
🔋 Battery tools/chargers, SMPS auxiliary stages, generic high-gain switching.

blocks.text: Design note: Darlington devices exhibit higher VCE(sat) and VBE than single BJTs. Ensure adequate headroom and thermal management.

🔧 Limit base current with a resistor; aim for IB ≈ IC/hFE with margin.
🔁 For PWM, consider switching frequency in the low-tens of kHz range due to Darlington storage times.
🧰 For logic-level control, a small NPN or MOSFET pre-driver can provide extra base current if needed.

a compact, high‑efficiency lithium battery charging and boost module purpose‑built for three‑cell (3S) 18650/Li‑ion packs. It brings modern USB‑C convenience to makers, repair technicians, and product engineers who need a fast, tidy way to charge 11.1–12.6 V battery packs from any Type‑C power adapter—while keeping safety, configurability, and reliability front and center.

✅ USB‑C input with fast‑charge negotiation — Plug into a USB‑C wall charger or power bank and the module automatically aligns to the supported fast‑charge profile to maximize the available power budget. This lets the board deliver up to 15 W to the battery pack without bulky brick supplies.

⚙️ Native 3S charging — Out of the box the default configuration supports two cells, and a simple pad short enables 3S mode (12.6 V full‑charge) for three series cells. The layout clearly labels the configuration pads and balance/BM connection so you can adapt the board to your pack architecture in minutes.

🔋 Up to 1.5 A charge current — The current set network gives you practical control of charge current to match cell capacity and thermal limits. Use the onboard resistor options or replace with your value; the reference formula (I ≈ 90 000 / Rset) makes sizing straightforward for 0.3–1.5 A ranges.

🔌 Synchronous boost‑charging core — A high‑efficiency switching architecture converts USB input power into regulated multi‑cell charging with minimal heat rise, achieving efficiency up to ~94% under typical conditions. Less wasted heat means better stability inside compact enclosures.

🛡️ Smart protections — Built‑in logic supervises input undervoltage, thermal behavior, timeout options, and fault indication. Clear LED states (red power, blue charging/full, blue flashing abnormal) keep status visible during bring‑up and service.

🧩 Balanced system awareness — The board includes a BM sense pin for inter‑cell connection when used with two cells, supporting equalization behavior in 2S mode. In 3S mode you should pair the charger with a proper 3S protection/BMS board to provide pack‑level protections and cell health management.
🧱 Tiny footprint — At roughly 32 × 18 × 5 mm, the module drops into tight projects: handheld tools, LED rigs, IoT nodes, portable speakers, and robotics where every cubic millimeter counts.

🛠️ Robust to mixed input sources: Whether you feed via Type‑C with a QC/fast‑charge adapter or via the solder pads from a DC rail, the module handles real‑world input variance gracefully. When input is below pack voltage, it enters boost state and continues charging appropriately.

💡 LED light bars and cine rigs where 12 V rails are common and fast recharge is critical between shoots.
📡 IoT gateways and edge controllers that must stay untethered and hot‑swappable during maintenance windows.

Input: USB Type‑C port or solder‑pad input. Compatible with common fast‑charge profiles for elevated input voltage/current. 5 V sources supported; fast‑charge negotiation improves delivered power headroom.
Battery: 3S Li‑ion/Li‑polymer (nominal 11.1 V, 12.6 V full). Default board ships in 2S; set configuration pads to enable 3S.
Max charge current: Up to 1.5 A (programmable). Reference: I (A) ≈ 90 000 / Rset (kΩ) using the current‑set network. Example: 100 kΩ ≈ 0.9 A; 180 kΩ ≈ 0.5 A.
Termination voltage: 4.2 V per cell (adjustable via VSET network if your chemistry requires).
Timeout (optional): 4 h at 68 kΩ, 12 h at 120 kΩ, 24 h default (no resistor).
Temperature sense (optional): Fit 100 kΩ NTC (B≈4100) with recommended network; change on‑board fixed resistor to ~82 kΩ.
Indicators: Red = power; Blue = charging; Blue off = full; Blue flashing = abnormal.

Note on balancing: Equalization behavior is supported in 2S wiring via BM connection. For 3S builds, use an external 3S BMS/protection board for cell balancing, over/under‑voltage, and pack protections.
🔧 1) Configure for 3S: Short the 3S configuration pads as indicated on the PCB silkscreen, and remove the side resistor per the standard procedure. Verify continuity and clean flux residues.

🪫 2) Wire the pack: Connect B‑ to pack negative, BM to the mid‑point between cell 2 and 3 if specified by your BMS (for 2S balance only; in 3S use BM according to your protection board’s guidance), and B+ to pack positive.

🔌 3) Provide input: Use a 15–20 W USB‑C charger for best results. Alternatively, feed the solder pads with a clean DC source within the supported range. If the input is below pack voltage the module will operate in boost mode.

Each conductor is clamped individually, helping provide secure wire retention and stable long-term electrical contact.

The WAGO LT3-12 is especially suitable for lighting circuits, junction boxes, electrical distribution boards, control panels, home automation systems, and low-voltage wiring projects that require multiple output lines from a limited number of inputs. Its panel-mount design helps create a more organized installation, especially in enclosures and compact wiring spaces where neat cable routing is important.

The housing is made from flame-retardant polycarbonate, helping improve safety and durability during operation. Inside, the conductive contact parts are made from copper alloy with tin plating, which supports reliable conductivity and stable electrical performance. The connector is also reusable, allowing wires to be disconnected and reconnected when needed without damaging the body.

Because it combines panel-mount convenience, quick lever operation, multi-line output, reusable design, and compact installation, the WAGO LT3-12 is a dependable choice for electricians, installers, technicians, and organized electrical distribution work.

blocks.text: Beston LR920 (AG6/371) 1.5V Alkaline Button Cell — Pack of 2

The Beston LR920 (AG6/371) is a 1.5V alkaline button cell in the compact Ø9.5 × 2.0 mm format, supplying steady power to miniature electronics. This listing is for two cells (2pcs). With a typical capacity of ≈30 mAh, LR920 is commonly used in watches, calculators, laser pointers, clocks, remote controls, toys, digital thermometers, medical testers (glucose/cholesterol), cameras, PDAs, voice recorders, and small electronic instruments. Primary alkaline chemistry means non-rechargeable, long shelf life, and reliable 1.5V output.
✅ Small & powerful: compact LR920/AG6 footprint with dependable ~30 mAh capacity.
🔋 Stable 1.5V output: smooth discharge suitable for timing and logic circuits.
🧩 Wide device fitment: matches LR920 / AG6 / L921 / 171 / 370/371 size family (note: 371/SR921 is silver-oxide—same size, different chemistry and longer runtime).

blocks.text: AS7262 6-Channel Visible Light Color Sensor Breakout — I²C / UART, 3.3–5V, On-Board LEDs

Build reliable colorimetry and spectral analytics into your projects with the AS7262 6-Channel Visible Light Color Sensor Breakout. The on-board AMS AS7262 captures narrowband reflectance from six visible bands centered around 450, 500, 550, 570, 600, and 650 nm (V/B/G/Y/O/R). It presents readings via I²C or UART, and the breakout includes level-shifting and a 3.3 V regulator, making it 3.3–5 V logic safe. Two on-board illumination LEDs, handy INT and RST pins, and a compact mounting pattern make integration straightforward across lab setups, conveyors, handheld readers, and IoT nodes.
✅ True spectral channels — Six calibrated VIS bands for repeatable color measurements and reflectance-based analytics.
🔌 Dual interfaces — Use standard I²C for microcontrollers and SBCs or UART for direct serial integration.
⚙️ 3.3–5 V ready — On-board regulation and level shifting protect the sensor and simplify wiring.
💡 On-board LEDs — Controlled illumination for consistent readings in bench tests and enclosures.
🧲 Mount-friendly — Four M2.5/M3-ish mounting holes and a tidy 0.1″ header footprint.
🧪 Data you can use — 16-bit style output registers (raw and calibrated) suitable for algorithms, thresholds, and ML models.
🧰 Field-proven pinout — Breakout silk labels for VIN, 3V3, GND, SCL, SDA, RST, INT, TX, RX, LED ease bring-up.
🧩 Flexible optics — Works in reflectance or transmission setups; pair with diffusers, cuvettes, or fiber where needed.
What you can do with it
✅ Color sorting of parts, caps, and LEDs on assembly lines.
✅ Detecting ripeness/quality proxies in visible bands for research rigs.
✅ Matching paint, filament, textile swatches, and printed media.
✅ Closed-loop LED binning and brightness/white-point calibration.
✅ Teaching spectral sensing in classrooms and workshops.

blocks.text: OSEPP Female Headers 40 Pin 10 PCS OP-LS-00006

The OSEPP Female Headers 40 Pin 10 PCS set is a practical and essential connector solution for electronics prototyping, development boards, Arduino projects, microcontroller interfacing, and custom PCB applications. Each strip is designed as a single-row female header with 40 holes and a standard 0.1 inch pitch, making it compatible with a wide range of male pin headers, development boards, and common electronics modules.

This OSEPP Female Headers 40 Pin 10 PCS pack is especially useful for makers, students, technicians, and engineers who need reliable socket-style connections in breadboard-compatible or PCB-based projects. Because each strip can be cut to the required length using standard wire cutters, it provides excellent flexibility for custom circuits, shield headers, adapter boards, sensor interfaces, and embedded development work.

The standard spacing of the OSEPP Female Headers 40 Pin 10 PCS makes these headers suitable for many common applications in digital and embedded electronics. They can be used to create removable board connections, interface expansion rows, replace worn sockets, or build neat and serviceable connections between modules and controller boards. Their single-row format also makes them convenient for organized routing and compact board design.

This product is a useful choice for development work where modularity, serviceability, and quick assembly are important. Whether you are assembling a DIY electronics project, preparing a custom interface board, expanding a development platform, or stocking workshop essentials, the OSEPP Female Headers 40 Pin 10 PCS set offers a simple and reliable connection option.

blocks.text: Super Paste Flux 40g – Multi-Purpose Soldering Flux (Tin Paste)

The Super Paste Flux 40g is a versatile tin soldering paste engineered for precision electronics, control boards, SMD/SMT/BGA rework, and field repairs. It delivers bright, fast wetting, cleans easily with alcohol, and leaves no solid residues after rework. It is halogen-free, non-corrosive, and provides strong insulation above 100 MΩ, making it safe around sensitive circuits and components .
✅ Universal, multi-purpose paste: Suitable across hobby, lab, and production benches; refills any paste-flux syringe for precise dispenses .
⚡ Fast, shiny joints: High activity promotes quick wetting and glossy finishes while minimizing dwell time on pads and leads .
🧽 Clean rework: No solid residue after reflow; wipes off with isopropyl or thinner for a spotless PCB .
🛡️ High insulation: Dielectric resistance over 100 MΩ safeguards fine-pitch ICs and sensors .
🌿 Safer chemistry: Halogen-free, non-corrosive formulation protects copper, nickel, and stainless substrates .
🧰 Broad compatibility: Works with all tin alloys and solder pastes; ideal for irons, hot-air, and rework stations .
🔌 Repair of electronic/medical devices and fine assemblies .
🧠 Control boards, PCBs, SMD/SMT—jumpers, pads, QFN/BGA pads, connectors .
🧵 Wires, terminals, copper plates/pipes; nickel and galvanized metals; stainless plates and fittings .
🔋 Spot-solder on Li-ion 3.7 V and coin/button cells (with heat-control precautions) .
✅ Clean the area (dust/oxides) and apply a tiny amount of paste only where needed.
✅ Match tip shape and iron power to joint mass; keep a damp sponge handy for tip hygiene.
✅ Rinse flux residues with alcohol or thinner after soldering for best cosmetic and measurement results .
🪫 For coin-cell negative terminals, lightly sand and smooth before soldering; never overheat cells.
🔥 Avoid dipping the iron into the jar.
🧪 Not suitable for aluminum/chrome; not for fusion/flame welding processes .
🔒 Close the can after use; keep away from children.
🚿 If eyes or wounds are contacted, rinse with plenty of water .

blocks.text: 🧼 Prep: De-grease and de-oxidize pads/parts; mask nearby plastics.
🫧 Apply: Touch a micro-dab of paste onto the joint area (brush/toothpick).
🔥 Heat: Bring the tinned tip to the joint; feed solder as needed; withdraw promptly to avoid thermal stress—especially on coin cells.
🧴 Finish: Wipe residues with IPA; inspect under light for bridges/voids; repeat if necessary.
♻️ Maintenance: Keep the lid sealed; avoid contaminating the jar with a hot tip.
🛠️ Ideal for low-voltage harness repairs, sensor leads, shield cans, USB/HDMI connector pads, RF coax pigtails, and stainless latch tabs.

🌿 تركيبة آمنة: خالٍ من الهالوجين وغير مسبّب للتآكل لحماية النحاس والنيكل والفولاذ المقاوم للصدأ .
🧰 توافق واسع: يعمل مع جميع سبائك القصدير ومعاجين اللحام، ومع مكواة اللحام والهواء الساخن ومحطات إعادة العمل .

blocks.text: Linear Slide Pot 100k 104 — 3-Pin, Short-Throw, Mechanical End-Detent

The Linear Slide Pot 100k 104 is a single-gang 100 kΩ linear slide potentiometer (code 104) with 3 pins. Your unit measurements are used as the definitive specs: body 45 mm length × 8.2 mm width, slider shaft 14.7 mm length, and a travel (stroke) of 35 mm. One end of the travel has a mechanical detent (click) region; with only 3 pins, this detent is tactile only and does not actuate an electrical switch.
✅ 100 kΩ linear (104): Predictable position-to-voltage behavior for compact mixers and controllers.
🔌 3-pin simplicity: Use as a voltage divider (3 pins) or a variable resistor (2 pins).
📏 Short-throw form factor: 35 mm travel within a 45 × 8.2 mm body—fast, space-efficient control.
🧲 Mechanical end-detent: Clear tactile feedback at one end of the stroke; no extra terminals involved.
🧩 Small slider shaft: 14.7 mm shaft length for low-profile panels and compact caps.
🎚️ Compact audio: Channel trim, send level, cue balance, FX depth.
🎛️ Synth/MIDI DIY: Filter amount, modulation depth, morph controls.
🔆 Control/education: Brightness blend, general CV input, ADC demos.
⚙️ Voltage divider: Outer pins to reference (e.g., 0–5 V), wiper (center pin) as the control voltage to your circuit or ADC.
🧪 Rheostat mode: Wiper plus either outer pin if you need variable resistance only.
🎚️ Detent behavior: The end-click is mechanical; resistance continues changing to the hard stop—no on/off switch present.
🛠️ Panel/slot alignment: Center the slot over the 35 mm travel; keep the carriage parallel to avoid rub and wear.
🧼 Care: Keep dust/flux off the track; avoid solvents on the carbon element; adjust with light force.

blocks.v: Mechanical end-detent at one end (no switch)

blocks.text: ✅ 1× Linear Slide Pot 100k 104, 3-pin, 45 × 8.2 mm body, 14.7 mm shaft, 35 mm travel, mechanical end-detent.
Is the click an on/off switch? No. It’s a mechanical detent only; there are no additional electrical terminals.
Is the taper logarithmic? No. It’s linear (code 104).
Can I read it with an MCU? Yes. Wire as a divider and read the wiper with an ADC.
Can it drive a load directly? No. Use it as a control element, not a power path.
Common terms: linear slide pot 100k, 104 slide potentiometer, 3-pin slider, short-throw fader, mechanical detent slide pot.
Linear Slide Pot 100k 104 — منزلق خطي 3 أطراف، مشوار قصير، نقرة طرفية

يعمل Linear Slide Pot 100k 104 كمنزلق مقاومة خطي 100 كيلو أوم (الترميز 104) بعدد 3 أطراف. تم اعتماد قياسات وحدتك كمرجعية نهائية: طول جسم 45 مم × عرض 8.2 مم، طول عمود منزلق 14.7 مم، ومشوار (Stroke) مقداره 35 مم. توجد نقرة ميكانيكية في نهاية أحد طرفي المشوار؛ وبما أن القطعة 3 أطراف فقط فالنقرة ميكانيكية وليست مفتاح تشغيل/إيقاف.
✅ 100 كيلو أوم خطي (104): استجابة موضع-إلى-جهد متسقة للمكسرات الصغيرة والمتحكمات.
🔌 3 أطراف بسيطة: كمقسم جهدي (3 أطراف) أو كمقاوم متغيّر (طرفان).
📏 مشوار قصير: 35 مم ضمن جسم 45 × 8.2 مم — تحكم سريع ومساحة أقل.

blocks.text: Soldering Wire 63/37, 750g Net, 2.2% Flux – Variable (0.6 / 0.8 / 1.0 mm)
Product Overview | نظرة عامة على المنتج

Meet the dependable rosin‑core soldering wire for electronics: Sn63/Pb37 eutectic alloy, 2.2% activated rosin flux, and 750 g net spool. Available in 0.6 mm, 0.8 mm, and 1.0 mm diameters, this wire wets copper pads quickly, freezes cleanly at 183 °C, and leaves minimal, easy‑to‑clean residues. It’s tuned for PCB assembly, rework, harness fabrication, and general bench soldering where consistent flow and shiny joints matter.

blocks.text: How to Choose Diameter | كيف تختار القطر
0.6 mm: fine‑pitch SMD and tiny pads.
0.8 mm: general PCB work and headers.
1.0 mm: larger pads, lugs, faster fill.
1.2 mm: heavy wiring, connectors, and ground planes; reduces feed time per joint.
1.5 mm: cable lugs, chassis tabs, and pot tinning—maximum deposition per second.
0.8 مم: الأعمال العامة على اللوحات والوصلات.
1.0 مم: بادات وأطراف أكبر وسرعة تعبئة أعلى.
1.2 مم: توصيلات سميكة وكونّكتورات وبلانات أرضي؛ يقلل زمن التغذية لكل وصلة.
1.5 مم: كوالين وأسلاك كبيرة وألسنة هيكل—أقصى ترسيب قصدير.
Set iron 320–360 °C for common work; adjust for thermal mass and tip size.
Keep tips tinned; feed solder to the joint, not the tip.
Use no‑clean flux or IPA to tidy residues if required.
Ventilate; leaded solder emits flux fumes—use extraction.
اضبط كاوية اللحام على 320–360°م للأعمال العامة وعدّل حسب الكتلة الحرارية وحجم السن.
حافظ على السن مغطّى بالقصدير وقدّم السلك إلى وصلة اللحام لا إلى السن مباشرة.
استخدم فلكس لا يحتاج تنظيف أو IPA لتنظيف البقايا عند الحاجة.
وفّر تهوية جيدة؛ أبخرة الفلكس تتطلب شفطًا/تهوية.

blocks.text: ESP32-CAM + ESP32-CAM-MB — 2MP Camera, PSRAM, microSD, USB Programmer

Build camera projects in minutes with the ESP32-CAM paired with the ESP32-CAM-MB USB programmer. The camera board integrates an ESP32-S SoC with OV2640 2 MP sensor, 4 MB PSRAM, microSD slot, and onboard Wi-Fi/BLE—great for IP streaming, snapshots, face-detection demos, and IoT imaging. The ESP32-CAM-MB provides plug-and-flash over USB with auto-download signals, no jumpers or FTDI wiring required.

Q1: Do I still need an FTDI adapter?
A: No—the ESP32-CAM-MB provides USB-to-UART and auto-reset/boot for flashing.
Q2: What power source should I use?
A: A stable 5 V USB supply (≥1 A) via the MB is recommended; camera + Wi-Fi peaks can be high.
Q3: Can I power at 3.3 V?
A: Yes, via the 3V3 pin with a regulated 3.3 V source (bypasses the onboard LDO). Ensure clean, adequate current.

Power from Micro-USB 5 V; heavy peripherals should use their own supply with common ground.

blocks.text: 4 Channel Wireless Remote Controlled Relay with Remote

The 4 Channel Wireless Remote Controlled Relay uses a 433 MHz RF receiver and a 12 V DC supply to control four independent relay outputs. Each channel provides COM/NO/NC contacts for straightforward integration in lighting, access control, pumps/valves, and DIY automation—no coding or Wi-Fi required.
✅ Four isolated channels: independent COM/NO/NC per relay.
📡 433 MHz RF link: handheld keyfob control with learn function.
🔌 12 V DC input: screw-terminal power and status indicators.
🔁 Selectable control behavior: supports momentary and toggle operation.
🧲 Learnable remotes: compatible with common fixed-code keyfobs (EV1527/PT2262 class).
🧰 Easy wiring: labeled screw terminals for power and each relay output.
⚠️ Power supply and load wiring not included.

🧲 For dry-contact triggering of controllers, use COM/NO as required by the target device.
🧯 For inductive loads (coils, motors), include suitable suppression (snubber/MOV or external contactor).
🔗 Pair a remote: press Learn, then press a button on the keyfob to bind it.
🔁 Select behavior: set momentary or toggle according to your board’s mode setting.
🧹 Clear bindings: hold Learn to erase stored remotes, then re-pair as needed.
📦 Units are function-tested for basic RF reception and relay actuation.
🧤 Observe ESD care; keep low-voltage wiring isolated from any high-voltage circuits.
Q: What power supply should I use?
A: A regulated 12 V DC supply suitable for your installation.
Q: Can I use multiple remotes?
A: Yes—learn additional keyfobs using the Learn button.
Q: Can I set different behaviors per channel?
A: If your board supports per-channel behavior, configure each channel accordingly; otherwise set a global behavior per the mode setting.

desc: QianLi Macaron 2S integrated double-pulse portable spot welder with 11-level power, Manual/Auto modes, Type-C charging , 5 V USB output , red-copper tips, clamp base, and silicone pad— unit only, no accessories . كيانلي ماكرون 2S ماكينة لحام نقطي مدمجة محمولة بنبض مزدوج بقدرة قابلة للضبط (11 مستوى) ووضع يدوي/تلقائي، شحن Type-C و مخرج USB 5 فولت مع أطراف نحاس ومشبك وقاعدة سيليكون— القطعة فقط بدون ملحقات .

blocks.text: ماكينة لحام نقطي محمولة كيانلي ماكرون 2S

QianLi Macaron 2S is a compact, integrated double-pulse spot welder designed for battery tab work on phone packs and small cell assemblies. It combines built-in welding pens, a clamp base for stabilizing tabs, and panel controls (Manual/Auto, 11-level power gear) in one handheld chassis. The 2S supports Type-C charging and provides a 5 V USB output so the unit can act as a small power bank in a pinch. With red-copper tips, heat-insulated sleeves, and a silicone work area, it delivers clean, consistent welds on thin nickel and stainless tabs typically used in electronics repair.

تُعد QianLi Macaron 2S ماكينة لحام نقطي مدمجة بنبض مزدوج مخصّصة لألسنة البطاريات في باكات الهواتف والتجميعات الصغيرة. تجمع بين أقلام لحام مدمجة، وقاعدة مشبك لتثبيت الشريط، ولوحة تحكم (وضع يدوي/تلقائي ومستويات قدرة حتى 11 تدرّج) ضمن هيكل واحد صغير. تدعم شحن Type-C وتوفّر مخرج USB بجهد 5 فولت لاستخدامها كباور بانك بسيط عند الحاجة. مع أطراف نحاس أحمر وأكمام عازلة ومنطقة عمل سيليكون، تمنح لحامات نظيفة ومتسقة على شرائط النيكل والفولاذ الرقيقة المستخدمة في صيانة الإلكترونيات.
✅ Integrated design: no external welding board required—pens dock directly into the body.
✅ Double-pulse control: pre-pulse to clean/settle contact, main pulse to form a strong nugget.
✅ 11-level power (Gear LEDs): quick, repeatable tuning for different tab thicknesses.
✅ Manual / Auto modes: auto fires when both pen tips detect metal; manual uses the side button.
✅ Red-copper tips + insulated sleeves: low resistance, comfortable handling.
✅ Type-C charging + 5 V USB output: convenient bench and field use.
✅ تصميم متكامل: لا حاجة لِلوحة لحام خارجية—الأقلام تتصل مباشرة بالجهاز.

name: QianLi Macaron Max Integrated Spot Welder
sku: QIANLI Macaron Max Spot Welding Machine
desc: Portable QianLi Macaron Max double-pulse integrated spot welder with color screen, 650 A peak, Type-C 5 V charging , and 4,000 mAh internal battery. Features red-copper pens, clamp base, silicone pad, and Auto Burn-out (for pros). Ideal for phone packs and 18650 tabs. ماكينة لحام نقطي مدمجة من QianLi Macaron Max بنبض مزدوج وشاشة ملوّنة، ذروة 650 A ، شحن Type-C 5 فولت وبطارية داخلية 4000 mAh . مزوّدة بأقلام نحاس، قاعدة مشبك، وسادة سيليكون وميزة Auto Burn-out (للمحترفين). مثالية لباكات الهواتف وأشرطة 18650 .

blocks.text: QianLi Macaron Max Integrated Spot Welder
ماكينة لحام نقطي مدمجة كيانلي ماكرون ماكس

QianLi Macaron Max is a portable, integrated double-pulse spot welding machine designed for precision battery work and micro-fabrication. The all-in-one chassis combines a color control screen, an adjustable clamp base, and a heat-resistant silicone workpad—so you don’t need extra fixtures. With 650A peak output, dual-pulse control (preheat + main pulse), and a 4,000 mAh high-C internal battery, it delivers stable, repeatable welds on nickel tabs and small packs, whether you’re repairing smartphone batteries (iPhone 11–15 Pro Max fixture option), assembling 18650 cells, or tackling delicate sensors and nickel strips.

تأتي QianLi Macaron Max كـ آلة لحام نقطي محمولة مدمجة بميزة النبض المزدوج مخصصة لأعمال البطاريات الدقيقة والتجميعات الصغيرة. تجمع الهيكلية الكل-في-واحد بين شاشة ملوّنة للتحكم، قاعدة تثبيت قابلة للضبط، ومنطقة عمل سيليكون مقاومة للحرارة—بدون الحاجة لملحقات إضافية. بقدرة ذروة حتى 650 أمبير، وتحكم نبضي مزدوج (تسخين تمهيدي + نبضة رئيسية)، وبطارية داخلية 4000 mAh عالية المعدّل (C)، توفّر لحامات ثابتة ومتكررة على شرائط النيكل والباكات الصغيرة، سواء لإصلاح بطاريات الهواتف (خيار قوالب بطاريات iPhone 11–15 Pro Max)، أو تركيب خلايا 18650، أو أعمال الشرائط الدقيقة.
Why it stands out | لماذا تتميّز
✅ Integrated design: pen leads, clamp, and UI in one compact body—less wiring, less setup.
✅ All parameters on a color screen: tune Preheat (ms), Pulse (ms), HtGap (ms), and Times (continuous spots) in real time.
✅ Double-pulse welding: the preheat pulse clears oxides and stabilizes contact; the main pulse forms a firm, consistent weld.
✅ Red-copper terminals & insulated sleeves: low resistance, fast heat dissipation, comfortable handling.
✅ Auto burn-out (advanced): controlled pulse sequence for stubborn joints—use by experienced technicians only.
✅ Type-C charging, internal 4,000 mAh battery: bench-friendly and field-ready.
✅ تصميم متكامل: أقلام اللحام، المِشبك، وواجهة التحكم داخل جسم واحد—أسلاك أقل وتجهيز أسرع.
✅ تحكم كامل عبر شاشة ملوّنة: ضبط Preheat، Pulse، HtGap وTimes مباشرًا مع العرض اللحظي.
✅ لحام نبضي مزدوج: نبضة تمهيد لإزالة الأكسيد وتثبيت التلامس، تليها نبضة رئيسية تُكوّن لحامًا قويًا ومتناسقًا.
✅ أطراف نحاس أحمر مع عوازل حرارية: مقاومة منخفضة وتبديد حرارة أسرع وإمساك مريح.
✅ ميزة Auto Burn-out (متقدمة): تتابع نبضي خاص للوصلات الصعبة—مخصّصة للمحترفين.
✅ شحن Type-C وبطارية داخلية 4000 mAh: مناسبة للطاولة والموقع الميداني.
Battery tab welding on phone packs, 18650/21700, and small Li-ion/Li-Po modules.
BMS lead attachment and nickel strip joining (typ. ≤ 0.12 mm stainless, thin nickel tabs).
Repairing iPhone 11–15 Pro Max batteries (with the optional fixture board).
Custom prototyping: wearables, compact power packs, robotics sensors.
لحام شرائط البطاريات في باكات الهواتف، خلايا 18650/21700 والوحدات الصغيرة Li-ion/Li-Po.
تثبيت أسلاك الـBMS وربط شرائط النيكل (عادةً حتى 0.12 مم للفولاذ الرقيق وشرائط النيكل الرفيعة).
صيانة بطاريات iPhone 11–15 Pro Max (مع قالب التثبيت الاختياري).
النمذجة المخصّصة: الأجهزة القابلة للارتداء، الباقات المدمجة، وحساسات الروبوت.
Operation steps (quick start) | خطوات التشغيل السريعة
Place the cell on the silicone pad; position the tab under the welding base clamp.
Adjust parameters using ▲/▼ and OK: set Preheat, Pulse, HtGap, and Times to match your tab thickness.
Press the welding pen firmly for solid contact; trigger the weld and verify the nugget. Repeat for the pattern needed.
ضع الخلية على وسادة السيليكون وثبّت الشريط تحت مشبك القاعدة.
اضبط القيم عبر الأزرار ▲/▼ وزر OK: حدّد Preheat وPulse وHtGap وTimes حسب سُمك الشريط.
اضغط قلم اللحام بإحكام لضمان التلامس الجيد؛ نفّذ اللحام وتحقق من النتيجة. كرر وفق النمط المطلوب.
Pro tips for consistent welds | نصائح احترافية لثبات النتائج
Clean tabs with isopropyl alcohol; pre-press the clamp to stabilize contact.
Use shorter Preheat for thin tabs; increase Pulse slightly for thicker nickel.
Maintain pen spacing equal to tab width and keep tips sharp; dress tips with the included file.
For multi-spot seams, use Times mode to speed consistent patterns.
نظّف الشرائط بالكحول الأيزوبروبيلي؛ اضغط المِشبك مسبقًا لزيادة ثبات التلامس.
قلّل Preheat للشرائط الرقيقة؛ وارفع Pulse قليلًا مع النيكل الأسمك.
حافظ على مسافة طرفي القلم مساوية لعرض الشريط وأبقِ الأطراف حادة؛ أعِد تشكيلها بالملف المرفق.
للحامات المتتالية، استخدم وضع Times لتسريع النمط المتجانس.
Safety & battery notes | السلامة وملاحظات البطارية
Eye protection and fume ventilation are mandatory. Avoid welding near flammables.
Auto burn-out is for skilled users; incorrect use may damage tabs or cells.
Built-in Li-poly battery (4,000 mAh)—charge via 5 V Type-C only. Shipping restrictions may apply.
ارتدِ نظارات حماية واحرص على تهوية الدخان، وابتعد عن المواد القابلة للاشتعال.
ميزة Auto Burn-out للمحترفين فقط؛ سوء الاستخدام قد يضرّ الشريط أو الخلية.
تحتوي على بطارية ليثيوم بوليمر 4000 mAh—اشحنها عبر Type-C بجهد 5 فولت فقط. قد تنطبق قيود شحن/شحن-ونقل.

desc: Gasket‑sealed waterproof project enclosure —external 158×90×40 mm , injection‑molded body with screw‑down lid, perimeter seal, and PCB bosses. Ready for cable glands and outdoor‑friendly installs when sealed correctly. علبة مشاريع محكمة الجوان —مقاس خارجي 158×90×40 مم ، جسم مصبوب وغطاء يُثبت بالمسامير مع جوان محيطي وقواعد تثبيت للـPCB. جاهزة لتركيب جلب الكابلات وتناسب الاستخدامات الخارجية المغطاة عند إحكام الإغلاق.

blocks.text: Product Overview | نظرة عامة على المنتج

English: A compact, gasket‑sealed waterproof project enclosure sized 158 × 90 × 40 mm for housing electronics, power modules, and small IoT nodes. The box features a rigid body, a screw‑down lid with perimeter seal, and internal bosses for PCB mounting, making it ideal for field installations, sensor junctions, and DIY prototypes.

العربية: علبة مشاريع مقاومة للماء بغطاء يُثبت بالمسامير وحلقة إحكام محيطية، بحجم 158 × 90 × 40 مم مناسبة لحماية الإلكترونيات ووحدات الطاقة وعُقد IoT الصغيرة. تتضمن قواعد تثبيت داخلية للوحات PCB، ما يجعلها ملائمة للتركيبات الميدانية وصناديق التوصيل والنماذج الأولية.
✅ Water‑resistant sealed lid with a continuous gasket to help keep out dust and splashes (outdoor‑friendly when installed correctly).
✅ Rigid enclosure for impact resistance and long service life.
✅ PCB standoffs—multiple bosses inside for secure board mounting with self‑tapping screws.
✅ Cable‑entry friendly—flat sidewalls accept glands/conduits (drill to suit); smooth surfaces for labels.
✅ Compact footprint—fits control panels and tight spaces while still offering usable internal volume.
✅ غطاء محكم الإغلاق مع جوان محيطي لمنع الغبار ورشاشات الماء (ملائم للاستخدام الخارجي عند التركيب الصحيح).
✅ هيكل صلب يقاوم الصدمات ويوفر عمر خدمة طويل.
✅ قواعد تثبيت للوحات داخلية لتثبيت PCB بمسامير حفر ذاتي.
✅ سهل تمرير الكابلات—جوانب مستوية تناسب جلب الكابلات/الداكت (يُثقب حسب الحاجة) مع أسطح ملساء للملصقات.
✅ حجم مدمج يناسب اللوحات الضيقة مع حجم داخلي عملي.
English: Environment‑exposed sensors, Wi‑Fi/LoRa nodes, power supply junctions, button/LED control stations, motor/relay interface boxes, marine and workshop projects, educational kits.
العربية: حساسات معرّضة للبيئة، عقد Wi‑Fi/LoRa، صناديق توصيل مزوّدات الطاقة، وحدات أزرار/لمبات، واجهات محركات وريليات، مشاريع بحرية وورش، وحقائب تعليمية.

English: The enclosure body and lid are injection‑molded from durable engineering plastic (commonly ABS; some batches may use ABS+PC). A silicone/foam gasket sits in a channel to seal the lid. Four (or more) stainless‑look screws secure the cover. Internal bosses accept M2.6–M3 self‑tapping screws (user‑supplied) for mounting PCBs or rails.

العربية: يُشكّل جسم العلبة والغطاء بالحقن من بلاستيك هندسي متين (غالبًا ABS؛ وقد تتوفر دفعات ABS+PC). توجد حشية سيليكون/فوم داخل مجرى لإحكام الغطاء. يثبت الغطاء 4 مسامير (أو أكثر) بمظهر ستانلس. تحتوي الداخل على قواعد تثبيت تقبل براغي ذاتي الحفر M2.6–M3 لتثبيت اللوحات أو السكك.

English: For best sealing, ensure the gasket is seated, surfaces are clean, and screws are tightened evenly. When adding cable glands, select IP‑rated glands and drill undersized pilot holes before tapping. For wall mounting, use external tabs (if present) or run screws through diagonal holes in the base; use stand‑offs to keep the PCB clear of mounting screws.

العربية: لضمان أفضل إحكام، تأكد من وضع الجوان بشكل صحيح ونظافة الأسطح وشدّ المسامير بشكل متساوٍ. عند تركيب جلب كابلات، استخدم جلبًا ذات تصنيف IP واحفر فتحات إرشادية أصغر قبل تثبيتها. للتثبيت على الحائط، استخدم ألسنة التثبيت الخارجية (إن وُجدت) أو ثقوب القاعدة، مع فواصل تباعد لتفادي ملامسة مسامير التثبيت للوحة.

English: With an external height of ~40 mm, typical usable internal height after lid lip/gasket is around 32–34 mm. Internal plan area is about (158 − walls) × (90 − walls); expect ~145 × 77 mm clear area (approx., varies by batch). Always verify against your board/mechanics.

العربية: مع ارتفاع خارجي ~40 مم، يكون الارتفاع الداخلي الفعلي بعد حافة الغطاء/الجوان عادة 32–34 مم. المساحة الداخلية التقريبية (158 ناقص سماكة الجوانب) × (90 ناقص السماكة)؛ توقّع حوالي 145 × 77 مم (تقريبية وتختلف حسب الدفعة). يُنصح بالتحقق وفق لوحتك وآليتك.

blocks.text: This is 13.56MHz RFID IC Key Tag. The RFID technology is used for sensing and identifying tagged people and objects for access control, automation, and a whole range of different applications.

Operating on a frequency of 13.56MHz, these tokens are all pre-programmed with unique ID numbers to communicate wirelessly with RFID Readers over distances of around 1 Meter or less. This means you can attach it to vehicles or items, keyrings or even pets’ collars to keep track of the location via an array of readers in the office, warehouse or home.

Each RFID Tag comes attached to a small keyring, within a little blue housing. This 13.56MHz RFID Tag makes them easy to distribute while maintaining a fair amount of discretion. Additionally, the process of matching tags to readers is also very simple as well, as all you have to do is tell the RFID Reader that you are adding a token, and then hold the token nearby. Then, when the token passes by the reader, the system can identify and log the ID number and time, or can even open up doors or other access ways automatically.

This basic RFID tag works in the 13.56MHz RF range and comes with a unique 32-bit ID. It is not re-programmable. This blank, smooth, and mildly flexible RFID tag is ready for your logo (or hand-drawn scribble).

blocks.text: بوت قصدير SWDT‑31C بقدرة 250 واط وسعة 800 جم

The SWDT‑31C Solder Pot is a compact, bench‑top tin melting furnace designed for dip soldering, lead pre‑tinning, stripping enamel wire, and connector tinning. Rated at 250 W, it features a titanium‑coated stainless‑steel crucible for excellent corrosion resistance and long service life. The analog rotary thermostat (1–9) lets you set an operating range of approx. 200–450 °C (392–842 °F), while the rocker power switch with light makes status obvious. A heavy, stable steel chassis with ventilation slots and non‑slip rubber feet keeps the pot steady and cool on the bench. Typical capacity is ~800 g of solder alloy, ideal for production cells and repair shops.

يُعد SWDT‑31C بوت قصدير مكتبيًا مدمجًا لعمليات الغمر بالقصدير، وقبلنة/تغطيس أطراف الأسلاك، ونزع طلاء الأسلاك المُمَلكة، وتلحيم القوابس والكونّكتورات. قدرته 250 واط ويحتوي على وعاء من الستانلس مطلي بالتيتانيوم لمقاومة عالية للتآكل وعمر طويل. يتيح مُنظم حرارة تناظري دوّار (1–9) ضبط درجة التشغيل ضمن حوالي 200–450 °م (392–842 °F) مع مفتاح تشغيل مضيء لبيان الحالة. هيكل فولاذي ثقيل ثابت مع شقوق تهوية وأقدام مطاطية مانعة للانزلاق يحافظ على الاستقرار على الطاولة. السعة النموذجية نحو 800 جم من سبيكة القصدير، ما يجعله مناسبًا لخطوط الإنتاج وورش الصيانة.

How to Use (Step‑by‑Step) | طريقة الاستخدام (خطوة بخطوة)
Placement: Set the unit on a flat, non‑flammable surface with clear airflow around the vents.
Fill: Place solder bars or pellets into the crucible. Start with smaller pieces for faster melt.
Power & Warm‑up: Switch ON, set dial to 5–6 for initial melt; wait until alloy is fully liquid.
Set temperature: Adjust between ~200–450 °C depending on alloy and flux. Keep the surface dross‑free by skimming.
Flux: Apply appropriate liquid flux to workpieces (e.g., Special Liquid Flux 250 mL).
Dip: Immerse the part 1–3 s or until wetting completes. Withdraw at a slight angle to shed excess solder.
Post‑process: Allow to cool; clean residues as per flux type (no‑clean typically requires none).
الوضع: ضع الجهاز على سطح مستوٍ غير قابل للاشتعال مع تأمين تهوية حول الفتحات.
الملء: ضع قضبان/حبيبات القصدير داخل الوعاء، وابدأ بقطع صغيرة لتسريع الانصهار.
التشغيل والتسخين: حوّل المفتاح إلى ON واضبط القرص على 5–6 للبدء؛ انتظر حتى يذوب السبيك بالكامل.
ضبط الحرارة: عدّل بين ~200–450 °م حسب السبيكة والفلكس. أبقِ السطح خاليًا من الخبث بإزالته.
الفلكس: ضع فلكس سائل مناسب على القطع (مثل Special Liquid Flux 250 mL).
الغمر: اغمر القطعة 1–3 ثوانٍ أو حتى يكتمل الترطيب، واسحب بزاوية خفيفة للتخلّص من الفائض.
ما بعد المعالجة: اتركها لتبرد؛ نظّف البقايا وفق نوع الفلكس (اللا‑تنظيف غالبًا لا يحتاج).
Tips for Better Results | نصائح لتحسين النتائج
Keep solder level half to two‑thirds full for thermal stability.
Preheat thick lugs with a hot‑air gun for uniform wetting.
Use a stainless skimmer to remove dross; avoid scraping the titanium coating.
For tinning stranded wires, twist tightly and dip with flux to prevent fraying.
Label the dial positions that match your alloy (e.g., Sn63/Pb37 ~250–260 °C).
حافظ على مستوى القصدير بين النصف والثلثين لاستقرار حراري.
سخّن الأطراف السميكة مسبقًا بالهواء الساخن لتحسين الترطيب.
استخدم أداة من الستانلس لإزالة الخبث؛ تجنّب خدش طبقة التيتانيوم.
عند تغطيس أسلاك متعددة، لُفّها بإحكام واستخدم فلكس لمنع التنسيل.
علّم مواضع القرص الموافقة لسبائكك (مثل Sn63/Pb37 نحو 250–260 °م).
Molten solder is hot; wear heat‑resistant gloves, eye protection, and use fume extraction when working with active fluxes.
Do not overfill the crucible; maintain clearance to prevent spatter.
Keep liquids away; never introduce wet parts into molten metal.
Unplug before maintenance; unit remains hot for minutes after power‑off.
Observe local electrical standards (grounded outlet, correct voltage variant 110–120 V or 220–240 V per model).

blocks.text: 125kHz RFID Key Fob – Blank (No Printed ID) – Blue 35×28×4mm – Rewritable

This 125kHz RFID key fob is a compact proximity tag designed for everyday access-control workflows such as doors, gates, elevators, lockers, and staff attendance systems. It’s blank (no printed ID), which makes it ideal for clean inventory management, custom labeling, or client-specific numbering.

The housing is small and lightweight (35×28×4mm) and includes a metal key ring, making it easy to carry on a keychain without bulk. The internal RFID chip is rewritable, meaning the tag can be electronically encoded and updated for authorized systems using compatible 125kHz encoding solutions.

If you’re building or maintaining a controlled-entry system, RFID fobs are popular because they’re fast, convenient, and durable. For a simple background on the technology, see this external reference on radio-frequency identification (RFID) (DoFollow):

A 125kHz RFID fob is typically passive (no battery). When the user brings it close to a compatible reader, the reader’s electromagnetic field powers the tag momentarily, allowing it to transmit its stored identifier or data.

blocks.text: FNIRSI DSO-TC3 3-IN-1 Handheld 500KHz 10MS/s Digital Oscilloscopes Signal Generator Transistor Tester | جهاز اختبار محمول 3‑في‑1

The FNIRSI DSO‑TC3 packs three practical bench tools into a rugged handheld body: a digital oscilloscope, a smart component/transistor tester, and a function signal generator. It is designed for technicians, hobbyists, and students who need a fast way to see waveforms, identify components, and inject test signals without carrying multiple instruments. The scope section samples at 10MSa/s with an analog bandwidth of 500kHz, sufficient for audio, PWM control, power‑electronics drive signals, microcontroller clocks in the tens of kilohertz, and general repair tasks. A bright color display, Auto capture, and RUN/HOLD keys make one‑hand operation effortless.

The tester section automatically identifies BJTs (NPN/PNP), MOSFETs (N/P‑channel), JFETs, IGBTs, diodes and Zeners, SCRs and TRIACs, and measures resistors, capacitors, and inductors, presenting pin mapping and key parameters. Utility readouts include battery voltage (0.1–4.5V), input voltage (0–40V), temperature via DS18B20 (0–85°C), humidity/temperature via DHT11 (0–60°C / 5–95% RH), and NEC IR remote code decoding.

The built‑in generator outputs six waveforms—sine, square, pulse, triangle, ramp, DC—with frequency adjustable from 1Hz to 100kHz, amplitude about 0–3.3V, and duty cycle 0–100% for square/pulse. This combination makes the DSO‑TC3 an ideal grab‑and‑go tool for learning electronics, appliance repair, field commissioning, and power signal verification.

يجمع FNIRSI DSO‑TC3 بين ثلاث أدوات مختبرية عملية داخل هيكل محمول متين: راسم ذبذبات رقمي، ومختبر مكوّنات/ترانزستورات ذكي، ومولّد إشارات وظيفي. صُمّم للجدد والمحترفين الذين يحتاجون إلى طريقة سريعة لرؤية الإشارات، وتحديد المكوّنات، وحقن الإشارات دون حمل أجهزة متعددة. يعمل قسم الراسم بمعدّل أخذ عينات 10MSa/s وعرض نطاق 500 كيلوهرتز، وهو كافٍ لتجارب الصوت، وإشارات PWM، ومحركات القدرة، وساعات المتحكّمات حتى عشرات الكيلوهرتز، وأعمال الصيانة العامة. تعرض الشاشة الملوّنة بوضوح، وتتيح وظيفة Auto وأزرار RUN/HOLD التشغيل بيد واحدة بسهولة.

يعرّف قسم المختبر تلقائيًا الترانزستورات ثنائية القطب (NPN/PNP)، وMOSFET بقناتي N/P، وJFET، وIGBT، والديود وزينر، وSCR وTRIAC، ويقيس المقاومات والمكثفات والملفات مع خريطة الأرجل والبارامترات الأساسية. كما يوفّر قراءات خدمية مثل جهد البطارية (0.1–4.5 فولت)، جهد الدخل (0–40 فولت)، ودرجة الحرارة عبر DS18B20 (0–85°C)، والرطوبة/الحرارة عبر DHT11 (0–60°C / 5–95% RH)، إضافةً إلى فك ترميز ريموت بالأشعة تحت الحمراء ببروتوكول NEC.

يولّد المولّد المدمج ستة أشكال موجية—جيبي، مربّع، نبضي، مثلثي، رامب، ومباشر DC—مع تردد قابل للضبط من 1 هرتز إلى 100 كيلوهرتز، وسعة تقارب 0–3.3 فولت، ونسبة عمل 0–100% للمربّع/النبضي. بذلك يصبح DSO‑TC3 أداة مثالية وسريعة للتعلّم، وصيانة الأجهزة، والتكليف الميداني، والتحقق من إشارات القدرة.

🖥️ Display & UI: Color screen with clear grid, status bar (range, coupling, trigger), RUN/HOLD indicators, and a responsive keypad (RUN, HOLD, arrows, OK/MENU).
📈 معدل أخذ العينات الفوري: 10MSa/s (10 ملايين عيّنة/ثانية) لالتقاط إشارات التحكم والصوت بوضوح.
📡 عرض النطاق التناظري: 500 كيلوهرتز (تقريبًا −3dB)، مثالي لـPWM ومخارج الحساسات ومحركات القدرة وتجارب التعليم.
🎚️ الحساسية الرأسية (×1): 10mV/div حتى 10V/div لمشاهدة الفولت المنخفض وخطوط التغذية.

blocks.text: Special Liquid Flux 250mL | فلكس سائل 250 مل

Special Liquid Flux 250mL is a no‑clean, sprayable liquid flux formulated for dip and wave tin soldering as well as flux sprayers during PCB assembly and repair. It improves wetting, reduces defects, and yields shiny, robust joints on through‑hole and SMD components. The solution is primarily organic alcohol with a very small percentage of rosin and non‑halide activators, making it safer and more environmentally friendly. It is ideally matched for Sn63/Pb37 alloy and compatible with a wide range of PCB technologies including PCB/BGA/PGA/PPGA/SMD. The 250 mL bottle is sufficient for many boards when used with dip/wave processes.

فلكس سائل 250 مل هو فلكس لا يحتاج إلى تنظيف وقابل للرش، مُصاغ لعمليات القصدير بالغمر أو بحوض الموجة وكذلك بخاخات الفلكس أثناء تجميع وصيانة الدوائر المطبوعة. يَحسّن الترطيب، ويقلّل العيوب، ويعطي لحامات لامعة ومتينة لمكوّنات الثروهول وSMD. تركيبته تعتمد أساسًا على كحول عضوي مع نسبة صغيرة جدًا من الراتنج ومنشّطات غير هالوجينية، ما يجعله أكثر أمانًا وصديقًا للبيئة. مثالي لسبيكة Sn63/Pb37 ومتوافق مع تقنيات PCB/BGA/PGA/PPGA/SMD. وتكفي عبوة 250 مل لعدد كبير من اللوحات عند استخدام تقنيات الغمر أو موجة القصدير.

Spray‑assisted assembly and PCB repair with flux sprayers.
Usage Recommendations (Very Important) | توصيات الاستخدام (مهم جدًا)
🧼 Cleanliness first: Ensure PCB surfaces and components are clean and free of dust or residues.
🧴 Apply appropriately: Coat the PCB and components with flux using a suitable method (dip, wave, spray, or mist).

Dip Soldering: Fix the PCB with a holder or crucible plier tong, then immerse in molten solder using the proper machine technique for 3–10 seconds; a slight motion (optional) helps cover all points evenly.
Wave Soldering: Preheat the PCB to activate the flux and protect from thermal shock, then move the PCB across the molten solder waves.
❄️ Cooling: Allow the PCB to cool in air until the solder solidifies.
🧽 Cleaning (optional): If needed, remove residues with alcohol or thinner.
🧼 النظافة أولًا: تأكّد من خلو سطح اللوحة ومكوّناتها من الغبار وبقايا الشحوم.
🧴 تطبيق مناسب: غطِّ اللوحة ومكوّناتها بالفلكس باستخدام طريقة ملائمة (غمر، موجة، رش أو ضباب).
اللحام بالغمر: ثبّت اللوحة بحامل أو ملقط كروسبل ثم اغمرها في القصدير المنصهر باستخدام تقنية مناسبة لمدة 3–10 ثوانٍ؛ يمكن تحريك اللوحة قليلًا (اختياريًا) لضمان تغطية جميع النقاط.
اللحام بالموجة: سخّن اللوحة مسبقًا لتنشيط الفلكس وحمايتها من الصدمة الحرارية، ثم حرّكها فوق موجات القصدير.
❄️ التبريد: اترك اللوحة لتبرد في الهواء حتى تتصلّب الوصلات.
🧽 التنظيف (اختياري): أزل أي بقايا باستخدام الكحول أو الثنر عند الحاجة.

blocks.text: Meet the DHT11 Temperature Humidity Sensor — the classic, compact, 4‑pin digital component (sensor only, not a module) that measures ambient relative humidity and temperature with a simple single‑wire interface. It operates on 3.5–5.5 V, features a stable indoor performance profile, and fits directly into breadboards thanks to its 2.54 mm pin spacing. Whether you are building a quick prototype, a classroom demo, or a budget‑friendly IoT node, this sensor keeps wiring simple and results repeatable.
✅ Breadboard‑ready pins: Standard 2.54 mm pitch and fixed orientation make wiring straightforward in tight spaces and quick labs.
🔌 Flexible supply: Works reliably from 3.5–5.5 V with very low average current, suitable for battery‑friendly data loggers.
⚙️ Single‑wire digital output: Transmits a 40‑bit frame (humidity, temperature, checksum) — no analog calibration or ADC channels required.
🌡️ Indoor‑range sensing: Temperature 0–50 °C and humidity 20–90 %RH for common room and enclosure monitoring.
🧪 Beginner‑friendly accuracy: ±2 °C temperature and ±5 %RH humidity are perfect for learning, dashboards, and non‑critical control.
🧱 Vented protective head: The blue slotted cap shields the sensing elements while allowing smooth airflow for responsive readings.
🧰 Strong ecosystem support: Works out of the box with popular microcontroller libraries and examples.
💡 Low‑power behavior: Sub‑milliamp average draw with brief peaks during conversions keeps your power budget lean.
✅ Simplicity first — one data pin, a pull‑up resistor, and you’re reading live climate values.
✅ Cost‑effective — trusted entry point for room‑level monitoring and education kits.
✅ Community‑proven — recipes and sketches are widely available for mainstream boards.
Pin 2 — DATA: Single‑wire bidirectional line. Add a 4.7–10 kΩ pull‑up to VDD near the host MCU for clean edges.
Pin 3 — NC: Not connected — leave floating.
Pin 4 — GND: Common ground with the controller.
✅ Keep the DATA wire short; long unshielded runs can degrade timing margins.
✅ If your MCU is 3.3 V and the sensor is powered at 5 V, use a level shifter or power the sensor at 3.3 V for logic safety.
✅ Place the pull‑up resistor physically close to the MCU pin to reduce ringing.
The host begins with a start pulse, after which the sensor acknowledges and shifts out 40 bits MSB‑first in this order:
8‑bit checksum (low 8 bits of the sum of the previous four bytes)
Each bit uses a fixed low time followed by a high period whose duration encodes 0 or 1. A practical sampling period is ≥ 2 seconds; reading faster can repeat older values or increase checksum errors.
Sampling period: ≥ 2 s (1 sample every 2–3 seconds is common in robust designs).
Response time: ~6–10 s for humidity steps under normal airflow.
Current: ~0.3 mA average during conversion; very low standby current.

Tip: If you need negative temperatures, sub‑zero operation, or tighter accuracy, step up to alternatives like higher‑grade digital humidity sensors. For educational builds and room monitoring, DHT11 Temperature Humidity Sensor remains an excellent fit.
✅ Arduino: Connect DATA to a digital GPIO (e.g., D2), add a 4.7–10 kΩ pull‑up to VCC, and include a well‑known DHT library. Poll no faster than every 2 seconds.
✅ ESP8266 / ESP32: Power at 3.3 V; use any available digital pin; keep wires short and stable. If Wi‑Fi tasks are heavy, avoid reading during RF bursts to reduce jitter.
✅ Raspberry Pi: Use a driver that honors microsecond timing. Ensure 3.3 V‑safe pull‑up on DATA and adequate delays between reads.
🔧 Checksum errors → Slow the polling rate, verify the pull‑up value, and shorten the cable.
🔧 Stale or fixed readings → Ensure proper start pulse width and the recommended delay between reads.
🔧 No response → Check ground reference, verify that DATA is not accidentally shorted to VDD, and confirm pin numbering.

✅ If you must mount in an enclosure, provide vent holes and a short air path to the outside.

The MH-M28 Wireless Bluetooth Audio Receiver Board Module is a low-power Bluetooth audio board designed to add wireless music reception to a wide range of audio systems and DIY electronics projects. With support for Bluetooth 4.2, this module offers fast pairing, stable signal transmission, and convenient stereo audio playback in a compact and easy-to-integrate design.

This board is especially useful for users who want to convert traditional wired audio devices into Bluetooth-enabled systems. It can be used in audio modification projects, home DIY speaker systems, compact entertainment devices, and embedded audio applications where a clean and reliable wireless audio receiver is needed.

The MH-M28 supports popular audio decoding formats including WAV, WMA, FLAC, APE, and MP3, providing high-quality stereo playback for a broad range of music files and streaming sources. Its onboard 3.5mm audio jack and clearly labeled left channel, right channel, and audio ground outputs make it suitable for feeding external amplifier circuits, powered speakers, AUX input systems, and other line-level audio applications.

The module can be powered either through the Micro USB connector or through external voltage input, including 3.7V battery supply or 5V DC input, offering flexibility for both portable and fixed installations. Its small PCB size allows easy installation inside custom enclosures, speaker cabinets, multimedia projects, and portable DIY designs.

With a maximum wireless range of up to 20 meters in an open environment, the board provides convenient wireless audio control for short-distance applications. It is a suitable choice for makers, hobbyists, repair technicians, and electronics enthusiasts looking for a simple and efficient Bluetooth audio receiver solution.
